paras.zh: 科尔·斯温德尔 (Cole Swindell) 与总部位于纳什维尔的艺术家管理公司 Make Wake Artists 签约，该公司也是卢克·库姆斯 (Luke Combs) 的代表。

paras.en: Swindell will be managed by Make Wake founder and chief navigation officer Chris Kappy and partners Dylan Wright and Michael Gonzales. Make Wake, which launched in 2015, also represents artists Jon Bellion, Flatland Cavalry, Stella Lefty and Muscadine Bloodline.
paras.zh: 斯温德尔将由 Make Wake 创始人兼首席导航官 Chris Kappy 以及合伙人 Dylan Wright 和 Michael Gonzales 管理。 Make Wake 于 2015 年推出，还代理艺术家 Jon Bellion、Flatland Cavalry、Stella Lefty 和 Muscadine Bloodline。

paras.en: Swindell has earned eight No. 1 hits on Billboard‘s Country Airplay chart to date. In 2023, he took home a trio of ACM Awards wins, including single of year and song of the year (as songwriter and artist), for his four-week Country Airplay No. 1 “She Had Me at Heads Carolina.”
paras.zh: 迄今为止，斯温德尔已经八次登上公告牌乡村音乐播放榜第一名。 2023 年，他凭借为期四周的乡村音乐节目《She Had Me at Heads Carolina》获得了三项 ACM 奖，包括年度单曲奖和年度歌曲奖（作为词曲作者和艺术家）。

paras.en: In 2027, Swindell will serve as support on Morgan Wallen‘s Last Time I Checked Tour. He’ll also perform at C2C: Country to Country in March and Wallen’s Sand in My Boots Festival in May.
paras.zh: 2027 年，斯温德尔将担任 Morgan Wallen 的 Last Time I Checked 巡演的支持人员。他还将在 3 月份的 C2C：Country to Country 和 5 月份的 Wallen's Sand in My Boots Festival 音乐节上表演。

paras.en: “I couldn’t be more excited to join the Make Wake family,” Swindell said in a statement. “I’m thankful for everything that’s happened in my career up to this point and I still feel like there’s so much more ahead. I’m fired up for this next chapter and can’t wait to get to work with the Make Wake team!”
paras.zh: 斯温德尔在一份声明中表示：“我非常高兴能够加入 Make Wake 大家庭。” “我很感谢迄今为止我职业生涯中所发生的一切，而且我仍然觉得前面还有很多事情。我为下一章感到兴奋，迫不及待地想与 Make Wake 团队合作！”

paras.en: “There are artists who achieve success and then there are artists who leave a lasting mark on country music. Cole has unquestionably done both,” Kappy said in a statement. “From his incredible catalog of hits and undeniable connection with fans to his extraordinary talent as a prolific songwriter, Cole has helped shape the sound and stories of modern country music. His ability to create songs that resonate with millions, both for himself and for other artists, is a testament to the depth of his artistry and the remarkable career he has built.
paras.zh: “有些艺术家取得了成功，有些艺术家在乡村音乐上留下了持久的印记。毫无疑问，科尔做到了这两点，”卡皮在一份声明中说。 “从他令人难以置信的热门歌曲目录和与歌迷之间不可否认的联系，到他作为多产歌曲作者的非凡才华，科尔帮助塑造了现代乡村音乐的声音和故事。他为自己和其他艺术家创作出与数百万人产生共鸣的歌曲的能力证明了他的艺术深度和他所建立的非凡职业生涯。

paras.en: “Welcoming an artist of Cole’s stature to Make Wake is a monumental moment for our company and a testament to the caliber of talent we are committed to representing. What excites us most is that despite everything he has already accomplished, we believe his greatest chapters are still ahead. We take tremendous pride in the trust Cole has placed in us and we intend to match that trust with the creativity, passion, and relentless determination that define Make Wake Artists. Cole has built an extraordinary legacy and we couldn’t be more excited to help take it to even greater heights.”
paras.zh: “欢迎像 Cole 这样的艺术家加入 Make Wake 对我们公司来说是一个具有里程碑意义的时刻，也证明了我们致力于代表的人才素质。最让我们兴奋的是，尽管他已经取得了一切成就，但我们相信他最伟大的篇章仍在前方。我们对 Cole 对我们的信任感到无比自豪，我们打算将这种信任与 Make Wake 艺术家所具有的创造力、热情和不懈的决心相匹配。Cole 建立了非凡的遗产，我们能够帮助它达到更高的高度，我感到无比兴奋。”

paras.en: “This is the kind of opportunity you don’t take lightly, and I’m grateful to be part of it,” Wright added. “My focus is simple: listen closely to Cole, understand what he wants next, and make sure our team is built around that every day. I’m excited to get to work with him, Kappy and Mike.”
paras.zh: “这是一个不容轻视的机会，我很高兴能参与其中，”赖特补充道。 “我的重点很简单：仔细聆听科尔的意见，了解他下一步想要什么，并确保我们的团队每天都围绕这个目标建立。我很高兴能与他、卡皮和迈克一起工作。”

paras.en: Swindell is also signed to Warner Records Nashville, William Morris Endeavor (WME) for booking and OH Creative for publicity.
paras.zh: 斯温德尔还签约了纳什维尔华纳唱片公司、William Morris Endeavor (WME) 进行预订，以及 OH Creative 进行宣传。

articles.title: What Did 1998 Actually Sound Like? A Look Back at the Year That Changed Pop Music
articles.author: Walaa Elsiddig

paras.en: There is something fascinating about the way younger generations listen to the past. Across streaming platforms and social media, listeners raised on unlimited access to music are digging into decades they never lived through, rediscovering forgotten singles, reviving old albums and dusting off records that once defined an era. Songs that dominated radio before they were born are finding new audiences, detached from the moments that produced them but still carrying traces of the world they came from.
paras.zh: 年轻一代倾听过去的方式有一些令人着迷的地方。在流媒体平台和社交媒体上，从小就不受限制地接触音乐的听众正在挖掘他们从未经历过的几十年，重新发现被遗忘的单曲，复兴旧专辑并重新审视曾经定义一个时代的唱片。在诞生之前就在广播中占据主导地位的歌曲正在寻找新的听众，这些听众脱离了产生它们的时刻，但仍然带有它们所来自的世界的痕迹。

paras.en: This renewed interest offers an opportunity to look beyond nostalgia and ask a more interesting question: What did the world sound like when these records were new? What were listeners hearing, what was the industry selling, and what cultural shifts were taking place beneath the surface of the charts?
paras.zh: 这种新的兴趣提供了一个超越怀旧的机会，并提出一个更有趣的问题：当这些唱片还是新唱片时，世界听起来是什么样的？听众听到了什么，行业销售什么，以及图表表面下正在发生什么文化转变？

paras.en: 1998 is a particularly revealing year to revisit. Not because the charts tell us everything about a culture, but because, sometimes, they tell us what a culture is becoming before it has found the language to express itself.
paras.zh: 1998 年是一个特别值得回顾的年份。不是因为图表告诉我们关于一种文化的一切，而是因为有时它们告诉我们一种文化在找到表达自己的语言之前正在变成什么样子。

paras.en: The Billboard Hot 100 throughout 1998 was a map of an industry in transition. Lauryn Hill, Brandy, Monica, Madonna, Céline Dion, Aerosmith, the Backstreet Boys and Shania Twain represented different sounds, audiences and ideas of what popular music could be, all competing for the same space. America was not listening to one thing, it was negotiating between several versions of itself, and somewhere in that negotiation, the center was shifting.
paras.zh: 1998 年的 Billboard Hot 100 是一个行业转型的地图。劳伦·希尔 (Lauryn Hill)、布兰迪 (Brandy)、莫妮卡 (Monica)、麦当娜 (Madonna)、席琳·迪翁 (Céline Dion)、史密斯飞船 (Aerosmith)、后街男孩​​ (The Backstreet Boys) 和仙妮亚·唐恩 (Shania Twain) 代表了不同的声音、听众和对流行音乐的看法，他们都在争夺同一个空间。美国没有在听一件事，而是在自己的几个版本之间进行谈判，而在谈判的某个地方，中心正在发生转移。

paras.en: Lauryn Hill’s The Miseducation of Lauryn Hill, released in August, became one of the year’s defining artistic statements. When “Doo Wop (That Thing)” debuted at No. 1 on the Hot 100 in November, it brought hip-hop, soul and social commentary together in a song as commercially successful as it was culturally pointed. Hill demonstrated that rap could be intellectually serious, musically rich, commercially dominant and unapologetically critical of the culture that consumed it.
paras.zh: 劳伦·希尔 (Lauryn Hill) 的《劳伦·希尔的错误教育》(The Miseducation of Lauryn Hill) 于八月发行，成为当年最具代表性的艺术宣言之一。当《Doo Wop (That Thing)》于 11 月首次亮相就登上了 Hot 100 排行榜第一名时，它将嘻哈、灵魂乐和社会评论融为一体，形成了一首在商业上和文化上都取得成功的歌曲。希尔证明说唱可以是理智上严肃的、音乐上丰富的、商业上占主导地位的，并且对消费它的文化毫无歉意地批评。

paras.en: Her success mattered because hip-hop was no longer asking for permission to enter the American mainstream. It was helping define the mainstream itself. But to describe 1998 as the triumph of hip-hop alone would be to miss the more interesting story.
paras.zh: 她的成功很重要，因为嘻哈音乐不再需要获得许可才能进入美国主流。它有助于定义主流本身。但如果仅将 1998 年描述为嘻哈音乐的胜利，就会错过更有趣的故事。

paras.en: Brandy and Monica’s “The Boy Is Mine” spent 13 weeks at No. 1, becoming one of the year’s defining hits. Songs like Monica’s “The First Night,” Next’s “Too Close” and Divine’s “Lately” further demonstrated R&B’s commercial strength. The genre was not a supporting act in this transformation; it was one of its principal architects.
paras.zh: Brandy 和 Monica 的《The Boy Is Mine》连续 13 周排名第一，成为今年最具决定性的热门歌曲之一。 Monica的《The First Night》、Next的《Too Close》和Divine的《Laterly》等歌曲进一步展示了R&B的商业实力。在这种转变中，流派并不是一个配角。它是其主要建筑师之一。

paras.en: American radio was increasingly shaped by vocal precision, intimate storytelling, polished production and rhythms that moved effortlessly between soul, pop and hip-hop. R&B was establishing a musical vocabulary that would carry into the next decade. At the same time, another commercial force was gathering momentum.
paras.zh: 美国广播电台日益受到精准的声音、亲密的故事讲述、精美的制作以及在灵魂乐、流行音乐和嘻哈音乐之间轻松游走的节奏的影响。 R&B 正在建立一个将延续到下一个十年的音乐词汇。与此同时，另一股商业力量正在蓄势待发。

paras.en: The Backstreet Boys and *NSYNC were building devoted audiences, while 98 Degrees were finding their place in the same lucrative landscape. Teen pop was becoming an industry of its own, selling not only songs but identities, fantasies and romantic longing packaged for mass consumption.
paras.zh: 后街男孩和 *NSYNC 正在培养忠实的观众，而 98 Degrees 也在同样利润丰厚的领域中找到了自己的位置。青少年流行音乐正在成为一个自己的产业，不仅出售歌曲，还出售为大众消费而包装的身份、幻想和浪漫渴望。

paras.en: There was a peculiar contradiction at this moment: Lauryn Hill was challenging listeners to examine gender, relationships and social behavior, while boy bands were selling romantic longing through carefully constructed images and immaculate harmonies. Both could succeed in the same marketplace. Popular music in 1998 had room for contradiction, even if the industry preferred to turn it into a marketing strategy.
paras.zh: 此时此刻存在着一个奇特的矛盾：劳伦·希尔（Lauryn Hill）正在挑战听众审视性别、人际关系和社会行为，而男孩乐队则通过精心构建的图像和完美的和声来兜售浪漫的渴望。两者都可以在同一市场取得成功。 1998 年的流行音乐有矛盾的余地，即使业界更愿意将其变成一种营销策略。

paras.en: While a new generation of stars prepared to take center stage, established artists were reinventing themselves. Madonna’s Ray of Light embraced electronic production and spiritual introspection, demonstrating how dance music could become a vehicle for artistic evolution. Cher’s “Believe,” released late in the year, introduced a distinctive vocal effect that would help reshape pop production. Meanwhile, Britney Spears’ debut single “…Baby One More Time” offered an early glimpse of the teen-pop phenomenon that would dominate the years ahead.
paras.zh: 当新一代明星准备登上舞台中央时，知名艺术家正在重塑自己。麦当娜的《光芒》拥抱电子制作和精神内省，展示了舞曲音乐如何成为艺术进化的载体。 Cher 在今年年底发行的《Believe》引入了独特的声音效果，有助于重塑流行音乐的制作。与此同时，布兰妮·斯皮尔斯的首张单曲“……Baby One More Time”让我们得以一睹将在未来几年占据主导地位的青少年流行音乐现象的雏形。

paras.en: Rock had not disappeared, either. Aerosmith’s “I Don’t Want to Miss a Thing” spent four weeks atop the Hot 100, while Goo Goo Dolls’ “Iris” and Barenaked Ladies’ “One Week” became radio staples. Country-pop was crossing boundaries, too, with Shania Twain and Faith Hill bringing Nashville’s storytelling traditions to mainstream audiences.
paras.zh: 摇滚也没有消失。 Aerosmith 的《I Don’t Want to Miss a Thing》在 Hot 100 排行榜上连续四个星期位居榜首，而 Goo Goo Dolls 的《Iris》和 Barenaked Ladies 的《One Week》则成为电台的热门歌曲。乡村流行音乐也正在跨越界限，仙妮亚·唐恩和费思·希尔将纳什维尔的讲故事传统带给主流观众。

paras.en: The old categories still existed, but their borders were becoming increasingly porous. What was changing was not simply the music people bought; it was the hierarchy of cultural influence.
paras.zh: 旧的类别仍然存在，但它们的边界变得越来越松散。发生变化的不仅仅是人们购买的音乐，还有人们购买的音乐。这是文化影响力的等级制度。

paras.en: The grunge and alternative rock movements that defined the early 1990s no longer possessed the same cultural authority. Hip-hop, R&B, teen pop and polished crossover records were reshaping the commercial landscape. The next generation of superstars would not necessarily resemble those who had dominated the decade’s beginning.
paras.zh: 定义 20 世纪 90 年代初的垃圾摇滚和另类摇滚运动不再拥有同样的文化权威。嘻哈、R&B、青少年流行音乐和精美的跨界唱片正在重塑商业格局。下一代超级巨星不一定会像那些在本世纪初占据主导地位的人一样。

paras.en: Even the mechanics of chart success were changing. Billboard announced a significant change to the Hot 100 methodology, effective with the Dec. 5 chart: Songs could now qualify based on radio airplay without needing a commercially available physical single.The decision reflected an industry – just ahead of digital downloads becoming ubiquitous – that was guiding consumers to purchase full CDs, not merely singles, as albums cost upwards of ten-times more. It foreshadowed a world in which evolving access, exposure and listening behavior would allow new avenues for commercial success.
paras.zh: 甚至图表成功的机制也在发生变化。 Billboard 宣布对 Hot 100 评选方法做出重大改变，自 12 月 5 日排行榜起生效：歌曲现在可以根据电台播放获得资格，而无需商业化的实体单曲。这一决定反映了一个行业——就在数字下载变得无处不在之前——正在引导消费者购买完整 CD，而不仅仅是单曲，因为专辑的价格高达十倍以上。它预示着一个不断变化的访问、曝光和倾听行为将为商业成功开辟新途径的世界。

paras.en: Beyond the charts, MTV, radio, music magazines and the emerging internet shaped how fans discovered artists and built communities around their favorite sounds. Before streaming playlists and viral TikTok moments, discovery meant anticipating a music video premiere, waiting for a song on the radio or purchasing an album at a local record store. The experience of listening was different, but the desire to connect through music was much the same.
paras.zh: 除了排行榜之外，MTV、广播、音乐杂志和新兴的互联网也塑造了歌迷发现艺术家并围绕他们喜爱的声音建立社区的方式。在流媒体播放列表和病毒式传播的 TikTok 时刻之前，发现意味着期待音乐视频首映、等待广播中的歌曲或在当地唱片店购买专辑。聆听的体验不同，但通过音乐建立联系的愿望却大同小异。

paras.en: 1998 was not merely a year of successful singles. It was a moment when several competing futures of American pop music became audible at once. Hip-hop was expanding its authority, R&B was shaping the mainstream, teen pop was preparing for its commercial peak and rock, country and dance music were adapting to a landscape in which no single genre could claim ownership of popular culture.
paras.zh: 1998 年不仅仅是成功单身人士的一年。在那一刻，美国流行音乐的几种相互竞争的未来立刻变得清晰起来。嘻哈音乐正在扩大其权威，R&B 正在塑造主流，青少年流行音乐正在为其商业顶峰做准备，而摇滚乐、乡村音乐和舞曲音乐正在适应这样一种格局，在这种格局中，任何一种流派都无法声称拥有流行文化的所有权。

paras.en: The charts could tell us who was winning in any given week, but they could not fully explain why those victories mattered. That is the work of looking back. The most interesting thing about 1998 is not any individual achievement, but that these developments happened together, revealing an America whose musical tastes were becoming more interconnected, commercially engineered and difficult to contain within traditional genre boundaries.
paras.zh: 图表可以告诉我们谁在任何一周内获胜，但它们无法完全解释为什么这些胜利很重要。这就是回顾的工作。 1998 年最有趣的事情不是任何个人成就，而是这些发展共同发生，揭示出美国的音乐品味变得更加相互关联、商业化，并且难以被传统流派的界限所束缚。

paras.en: The decade was approaching its end, but the sound of the next one was already taking shape.
paras.zh: 这个十年即将结束，但下一个十年的声音已经形成。

paras.en: Nearly three decades later, the music of 1998 continues to find new audiences, often far removed from the cultural moments that gave it meaning. What once felt like competing sounds and passing trends now reveals itself as the foundation of modern pop music. The artists, genres and industry shifts that defined the year didn’t simply reflect the tastes of a generation; they helped shape those that followed.
paras.zh: 近三十年后，1998 年的音乐继续寻找新的听众，而这些听众往往远离赋予其意义的文化时刻。曾经让人感觉竞争的声音和流行的趋势现在已经成为现代流行音乐的基础。定义这一年的艺术家、流派和行业转变不仅仅反映了一代人的品味；他们帮助塑造了后来的人。

paras.en: So, what did 1998 actually sound like? It sounded like an industry caught between what had been and what was coming next. A year of reinvention, contradiction, and possibility, when the future of popular music was already playing on the radio, even if no one quite knew it yet.
paras.zh: 那么，1998 年实际上是什么样的呢？这听起来像是一个夹在过去和未来之间的行业。这是重塑、矛盾和可能性的一年，流行音乐的未来已经在广播中播放，即使还没有人知道这一点。

articles.title: Fourth ‘Terminal List’ Show in the Works at Prime Video
articles.author: Rick Porter

paras.en: The Terminal List keeps getting longer at Prime Video.
paras.zh: Prime Video 的终端列表越来越长。

paras.en: On the heels of the Amazon-owned streamer ordering a series based on Jack Carr’s novel Savage Son, Prime Video on Monday announced it’s developing a fourth show in the franchise. Cry Havoc is based on Carr’s 2025 novel of the same name, which is set in Vietnam circa 1968 and centers on Tom Reece, the father of The Terminal List’s James Reece, played by Chris Pratt.
paras.zh: 继亚马逊旗下的流媒体订购了根据杰克·卡尔的小说《Savage Son》改编的剧集后，Prime Video 周一宣布正在开发该系列的第四部剧集。 《呐喊浩劫》改编自卡尔 2025 年的同名小说，故事背景设定在 1968 年左右的越南，以汤姆·里斯 (Tom Reece) 为中心，汤姆·里斯是《终端名单》中詹姆斯·里斯 (Chris Pratt) 饰演的父亲。

paras.en: The show’s logline reads, “Tom Reece is a brash Navy SEAL assigned to the top secret MACV-SOG [Military Assistance Command, Vietnam-Studies and Observations Group] unit, which runs harrowing cross-border operations in Laos. When Tom’s recon team comes across plans for the upcoming Tet Offensive, it unleashes a chain of events that pulls the young warrior out of the jungles and into the shadows of Cold War espionage.”
paras.zh: 该剧的剧情简介是这样的：“汤姆·里斯是一名傲慢的海豹突击队员，被分配到绝密的 MACV-SOG（军事援助司令部、越南研究和观察小组）部队，该部队在老挝开展令人痛苦的跨境行动。当汤姆的侦察队发现即将到来的春节攻势的计划时，引发了一系列事件，将这位年轻的战士从丛林中拉出来，带入了冷战间谍活动的阴影。”

paras.en: Max Adams, a writer on The Terminal List, and showrunner David Digilio, are writing the pilot script. They developed Cry Havoc for television along with Carr and Jared Shaw, an executive producer (and actor) on the main series.
paras.zh: 《终端名单》的编剧马克斯·亚当斯和剧集制片人大卫·迪吉利奥正在撰写试播集剧本。他们与卡尔和主要剧集的执行制片人（兼演员）贾里德·肖一起开发了电视剧《惊魂浩劫》。

paras.en: Digilio will also serve as showrunner on Cry Havoc. He executive produces with Adams, Pratt (via his Indivisible Productions), Carr, Shaw, and Antoine Fuqua and Kat Samick of Fuqua Films. The studios are MRC and Amazon MGM.
paras.zh: Digilio 还将担任《Cry Havoc》的剧集主管。他与 Adams、Pratt（通过他的 Indivisible Productions）、Carr、Shaw 以及 Fuqua Films 的 Antoine Fuqua 和 Kat Samick 一起担任监制。制片厂是 MRC 和亚马逊米高梅。

paras.en: The flurry of activity around the Terminal List franchise comes a few weeks after the show’s second season premiere, which has scored solid viewing numbers for Prime Video. A decision on season three hasn’t come yet. Savage Son will also center on Pratt’s James Reece; the source novel also features some characters from The Terminal List, though Pratt is the only actor attached at the moment.
paras.zh: 《终端列表》系列的一系列活动发生在该剧第二季首播几周后，该剧在 Prime Video 上获得了可观的收视率。关于第三季的决定尚未做出。 《野蛮之子》还将以普拉特饰演的詹姆斯·里斯为中心。源小说还以《终端名单》中的一些角色为主角，尽管普拉特是目前唯一的演员。

paras.en: The franchise also includes a prequel series, Dark Wolf, that premiered in August 2025.
paras.zh: 该系列还包括于 2025 年 8 月首播的前传系列《黑狼》。

articles.title: ‘The Traitors’ Star Ben McDonnell on ‘New Blood’ Set Secrets and Alan Cumming: “You Can Never Break Character”
articles.author: Jackie Strause

paras.en: [The following story contains spoilers through the 10th episode of The Traitors: New Blood.]
paras.zh: [以下故事包含《叛徒：新血液》第10集的剧透。]

paras.en: Ben McDonnell had just finished bingeing every episode of The Traitors when he got the call to join the fifth season of the Peacock and NBC Emmy-winning reality competition. The barrel racer living on a ranch in Texas with his husband, where he hosts his weekly comedy podcast It’s Ben a Week, accepted the gig, which he considers one of his biggest challenges yet, and quickly found himself heading to the Scottish castle to live with strangers and host Alan Cumming. McDonnell became the King of One Liners and the fan- and cast-favorite gay cowboy — until his elimination in the penultimate episode that aired last week.
paras.zh: 本·麦克唐纳 (Ben McDonnell) 刚刚看完《叛徒》(The Traitors) 的每一集，就接到了参加《孔雀》和 NBC 艾美奖真人秀第五季的电话。这位桶赛车手与他的丈夫住在德克萨斯州的一个牧场上，他在那里主持每周一次的喜剧播客“It's Ben a Week”，他接受了这份工作，他认为这是他迄今为止最大的挑战之一，并很快发现自己前往苏格兰城堡与陌生人住在一起并主持艾伦·卡明。麦克唐纳成为了 One Liners 之王，也是粉丝和演员们最喜爱的同性恋牛仔——直到他在上周播出的倒数第二集中被淘汰。

paras.en: “Every morning I would wake up freaking out [about getting eliminated]. And for some reason, the day I got murdered, I was so calm,” McDonnell says when speaking to The Hollywood Reporter after his exit. McDonnell went onto the show assuming his personality would make him a Traitor, but being a Faithful sent him away from the series with something more valuable than the $250,000 prize money. “I didn’t think they were going to love me for me,” he says of his castmates. “And that part was healing in an unexpected way, when you didn’t even know you were broken to be healed.”
paras.zh: “每天早上我都会因为被淘汰而惊慌失措地醒来。出于某种原因，在我被谋杀的那天，我非常平静，”麦克唐纳在退出后接受《好莱坞报道》采访时说道。麦克唐纳在参加节目时认为他的个性会让他成为叛徒，但作为一名忠实信徒，他带着比 250,000 美元奖金更有价值的东西离开了该剧。 “我不认为他们会因为我而爱我，”他谈到他的演员们时说道。 “那部分正在以一种意想不到的方式愈合，而你甚至不知道自己已经破碎并需要愈合。”

paras.en: Below, when opening up to THR, McDonnell reveals a surprise for fans and his castmates (he’s actually a trained actor), talks about the hardest parts about filming, like giving up his phone (“People are going to think I’m going to rehab,” he remembers thinking) and why Cumming is a national treasure who inspired the name of McDonnell’s new piglet, Alan Cunningham.
paras.zh: 下面，在接受《THR》采访时，麦克唐纳向粉丝和他的剧组成员透露了一个惊喜（他实际上是一名训练有素的演员），谈论了拍摄过程中最困难的部分，比如放弃手机（“人们会认为我要去戒毒所，”他记得自己当时这样想），以及为什么卡明是国宝级人物，正是他为麦克唐纳的新小猪艾伦·坎宁安起了名字。

paras.en: As a trained actor who left L.A. for a Texas ranch, how did Hollywood pull you back for this show?
paras.zh: 作为一名离开洛杉矶前往德克萨斯州牧场的训练有素的演员，好莱坞是如何吸引你回归这部剧的呢？

paras.en: This experience was truly one of the most exciting acting experiences of my life. When you’re on a set, you show up to play a character, but then when the director says “cut,” you go back to being Ben. When you’re playing Traitors, the director never says cut. You are in character at all times. Even when the cameras are not rolling, you still have to play whatever character you’re showing up as. If you’re having lunch, you can never break character. You have to play it up the whole time.
paras.zh: 这次经历确实是我一生中最激动人心的表演经历之一。当你在片场时，你会扮演一个角色，但当导演说“剪辑”时，你又回到本。当你扮演叛徒时，导演从来不会说剪辑。你在任何时候都处于角色之中。即使摄像机没有转动，你仍然必须扮演你所扮演的角色。如果你正在吃午饭，你就永远不能破坏你的性格。你必须一直玩下去。

paras.en: I have a pretty large and loud personality, so I really had to tone it back, which was challenging because I want to be the center of attention. I wanna go be loud, but that’s immediately going to put a target on my back. I also didn’t tell anyone that I was an actor. I really leaned in to, “I’m this gay cowboy,” which is not a lie. I really am the gay cowboy. It’s just that the gay cowboy is more of a hobby than my career.
paras.zh: 我的性格非常大而且大声，所以我真的必须把它调回来，这很有挑战性，因为我想成为关注的焦点。我想大声说话，但这立刻就会成为我背上的目标。我也没有告诉任何人我是一名演员。我真的倾向于说，“我是这个同性恋牛仔”，这不是谎言。我真的是同性恋牛仔。只是同性恋牛仔更多的是一种爱好而不是我的职业。

paras.en: The producers hired me to play a game about lying and deceit. But the show is non-union, so there are definitely people there who aren’t trying to pursue an acting or Hollywood career. For instance, Abby L. didn’t even have Instagram before she got on the show. She’s an astrophysicist, so she must be a fan of the show and then applied. There are people from all different walks of life, which was amazing.
paras.zh: 制片人雇我来玩一个关于谎言和欺骗的游戏。但这部剧没有工会，所以肯定有人不想追求演艺或好莱坞职业。例如，Abby L. 在上节目之前甚至没有 Instagram。她是一名天体物理学家，所以她一定是这个节目的粉丝，然后才申请的。这里有来自各行各业的人，这真是太棒了。

paras.en: I went to BravoCon and saw this Traitors thing, and I remember asking my friend, “What is Traitors?” She was like, “You don’t watch Traitors?” I had never seen it. She’s like, “You have to watch. It’s the best show.” I was like, whatever. Then in Texas, we got an insane ice storm last January and here in Texas, when you get an ice storm, you’re stuck at home because no one knows how to drive.
paras.zh: 我去 BravoCon 看到了关于叛徒的事情，我记得问我的朋友，“什么是叛徒？”她说：“你不看《叛徒》吗？”我从来没有见过它。她说，“你必须看。这是最好的节目。”我当时想，无论如何。然后在德克萨斯州，去年一月我们遇到了一场疯狂的冰暴，而在德克萨斯州，当你遇到冰暴时，你会被困在家里，因为没有人知道如何开车。

paras.en: AJ, my husband, came out one day like, “What are you watching?” I’m like, “Let’s just watch this Traitors thing.” I turn on one episode — instantly hooked. I binged every season of the U.K. show, every season of the U.S. show. Then two weeks later I got the phone call: “Would you be interested in The Traitors?” I was like, “I just binged it. This is crazy.”
paras.zh: 有一天，我的丈夫 AJ 出来问道：“你在看什么？”我想，“让我们看看叛徒的事情吧。”我打开一集——立刻就着迷了。我狂看了英国剧的每一季，美国剧的每一季。两周后，我接到电话：“你对《叛徒》感兴趣吗？”我当时想，“我刚刚吃了它。这太疯狂了。”

paras.en: Next thing you know, I’m at a Scottish castle with Alan Cumming, playing Clue, basically, in the middle of the Scottish Highlands.
paras.zh: 接下来你知道的，我和艾伦·卡明在苏格兰高地中部的一座苏格兰城堡里玩《线索》。

paras.en: Were you pursuing acting at the time? Or do you feel like it was lucky timing?
paras.zh: 你当时追求演艺事业吗？或者你觉得这是一个幸运的时机？

paras.en: Acting has always been my main goal. As an actor, I never thought I would do reality TV. For a long time, I was opposed. I’ve had other offers in life for a reality show idea, and I’ve always been like, “You can’t do reality and be taken seriously as an actor.” I do feel there has been a shift. Like, 10 years ago when I was like, “I can’t be gay and be an actor because I’m going to be put in this box where you’re just the gay actor.” That is totally not the case anymore. You can be gay and play straight roles, you can be straight and play gay roles. It’s not as scary as it used to be.
paras.zh: 演戏一直是我的主要目标。作为一名演员，我从未想过自己会拍真人秀。很长一段时间我都是反对的。我在生活中也曾收到过其他关于真人秀创意的邀请，但我总是说，“你不可能在做真人秀的同时，作为一名演员被认真对待。”我确实感觉发生了转变。就像，十年前，当时我就想，“我不能既是同性恋又当演员，因为我会被放在这个盒子里，而你只是同性恋演员。”现在情况完全不同了。你可以是同性恋并扮演异性恋角色，你可以是异性恋并扮演同性恋角色。它不像以前那么可怕了。

paras.en: So same thing with reality. You you look at people like our Ariana Madix from Vanderpump Rules. She’s on Broadway. She’s on an NBC show. She’s doing all sorts of stuff. There are so many different reality stars who are now pursuing scripted. So I guess it was not quite as scary, but scripted television and movies have always been number one.
paras.zh: 现实也是如此。你看看像我们《范德庞规则》中的阿丽亚娜·马迪克斯这样的人。她在百老汇。她正在参加 NBC 节目。她正在做各种各样的事情。现在有很多不同的真人秀明星都在追求剧本。所以我想这并不那么可怕，但有剧本的电视和电影一直是第一位的。

paras.en: I know you were hoping to be a Traitor. What was your strategy going in? And did your strategy change once you found out you were a Faithful?
paras.zh: 我知道你希望成为叛徒。你的策略是什么？当您发现自己是忠实信徒后，您的策略会改变吗？

paras.en: I had only thought about being a Traitor. It was so set in my mind.. There was absolutely no question of me not being a Traitor. Stupidly, that did not even enter my brain. Preparing for the show, flying over there in the castle. At no point was I like, “What am I going to do if I’m a Faithful?”
paras.zh: 我只想着当一个叛徒。我心里就这么确定了……我绝对不是叛徒。愚蠢的是，这甚至没有进入我的大脑。准备表演，飞到城堡那边。我从来没有想过，“如果我是忠实的人，我该怎么办？”

paras.en: So when I didn’t feel the tap on my shoulder, I remember being like, “Do I need to ask someone if didn’t feel the tap? Like, for sure, I’m a Traitor.” And when I was a Faithful, I laid in bed that night and was like, “Well, now what?”
paras.zh: 因此，当我感觉不到有人在拍我的肩膀时，我记得当时的感觉是：“我是否需要问别人是否没有感觉到有人拍拍我？就像，我肯定是个叛徒。”当我还是一名忠实信徒时，那天晚上我躺在床上，心想：“好吧，现在怎么办？”

paras.en: If you’re a Traitor, it’s strategy all the way. You need to plan. You need to think 10 steps ahead. If you’re a Faithful, it’s a popularity contest. We are back in high school, and you need the Traitors to think you trust them so they want to keep you around, and you need the Faithful to like you so that they don’t banish you. You can watch every season of every Traitors in every different country. What you think would work with one group of people may not work with the next. You have no idea how different people will react.
paras.zh: 如果你是叛徒，这就是策略。你需要计划。你需要提前思考 10 步。如果您是忠实信徒，这就是一场人气竞赛。我们回到了高中，你需要叛徒认为你信任他们，这样他们就想把你留在身边，你需要忠实者喜欢你，这样他们才不会驱逐你。您可以在每个不同的国家观看每个叛徒的每一季。您认为对一组人有效的方法可能不适用于另一组人。你不知道不同的人会有什么反应。

paras.en: Personally, I think my training at The Groundlings and with improv really helped me roll with the punches. You had to go with it. I really didn’t try to overthink it. Once I was a Faithful, I’m like, “Just be honest.” And it got me quite far.
paras.zh: 就我个人而言，我认为我在 The Groundlings 的训练和即兴表演确实帮助我从容应对。你必须接受它。我真的没有想太多。当我成为忠实信徒后，我会说：“说实话。”这让我走得很远。

paras.en: This is a huge thing to keep secret from family, friends, work. What was that like for you? Did you tell anyone?
paras.zh: 这是一件需要对家人、朋友和工作保密的大事。对你来说那是什么样的？你告诉过任何人吗？

paras.en: AJ is the only person I told. When you go to Scotland to film, you have no phone. No internet. No connection to the outside world. I was gone during my birthday. It’s very overwhelming.
paras.zh: AJ 是我唯一告诉过的人。当你去苏格兰拍戏时，你没有手机。没有互联网。与外界没有联系。生日那天我走了。这是非常压倒性的。

paras.en: I actually thought I was going to miss not having my phone. It was so nice and relaxing to not have a phone. The only thing that would drive me nuts is wondering, “Who’s trying to contact me?” I was like, “People are going to think I’m going to rehab.” (Laughs.)
paras.zh: 我真的以为我会怀念没有手机的日子。没有电话真是太好了，很放松。唯一让我抓狂的是想知道“谁想联系我？”我当时想，“人们会认为我要去康复中心。” （笑）

paras.en: I’m very active on social media. I post on my story all the time. The fact that I’ve just gone completely quiet? Also, I had to record my podcast, It’s Ben a Week, in advance. I had to get all the social media clips. So my podcast Instagram posted a clip every single day. But I was like, “What if I’m causing drama and I’m not even responding?” You have no control.
paras.zh: 我在社交媒体上非常活跃。我一直在发布我的故事。事实上我刚刚完全安静了？另外，我必须提前录制我的播客“It's Ben a Week”。我必须获取所有社交媒体剪辑。所以我的播客 Instagram 每天都会发布一个剪辑。但我想，“如果我引发了戏剧性事件而我什至没有回应怎么办？”你无法控制。

paras.en: Let’s go inside your elimination. You were very calm. What did you mean when you said, “I knew it was time” before you opened the envelope and found out you were murdered?
paras.zh: 让我们来看看你的淘汰赛吧。你很平静。在你打开信封并发现自己被谋杀之前，你说“我知道是时候了”，这是什么意思？

paras.en: I’m one of the calmest people I know. Nothing riles me up that much. I’m always like, “It’s fine.” That’s my line. This show caused so much anxiety! I’ve never had anxiety. I’m like, “Can someone get me a Xanax, please? (Laughs.) Because I think I need one.”
paras.zh: 我是我认识的最冷静的人之一。没有什么能让我如此恼怒。我总是说：“没关系。”这是我的台词。这部剧引起了很多人的焦虑！我从来没有焦虑过。我想，“有人能给我一个 Xanax 吗？（笑）因为我想我需要一个。”

paras.en: So every morning I would wake up freaking out. And for some reason, the day I got murdered, I was so calm. That morning I actually started packing my things. I knew there was something coming. That fur coat that I wore? I brought that to wear either at the finale or when I’m murdered. I even talked about with the stylist about saving that coat, and that day, I brought the coat with me.
paras.zh: 所以每天早上我都会惊慌失措地醒来。出于某种原因，在我被谋杀的那天，我非常平静。那天早上我实际上开始收拾东西。我知道有事要发生。我穿的那件皮大衣？我带着它在结局或被谋杀时穿。我什至和造型师讨论过要保留那件外套，那天，我把那件外套带在了身上。

paras.en: When I opened the door, I saw the envelope and there was a little hint of me that was like, “Maybe I’m being recruited [to be a Traitor,]” which I was like, “What a dream.” And then I was like, I don’t think so. That’s when I was like, it was time. I was ready to go.
paras.zh: 当我打开门时，我看到了信封，里面有一丝关于我的暗示，“也许我被招募[成为叛徒]”，我当时想，“多棒的梦想啊。”然后我想，我不这么认为。那时我就​​想，是时候了。我准备出发了。

paras.en: What’s the exit process like? Do you leave right after that?
paras.zh: 退出流程是怎样的？之后你就离开吗？

paras.en: You do more confessionals. You’re there for a whole other day doing stuff. But you don’t get to say goodbye to anyone. Shooting the show is such an immersive experience that you have to remind yourself no one is dying. They don’t waste money on budget or any of the production value. That funeral scene, for example, when we were in the graveyard and there was smoke and fog and you see a gravestone with your name on it? You’re watching your friends get into coffins in the ground. It feels real. Then the exits are abrupt; no goodbyes. It’s like, boom, gone.
paras.zh: 你做更多的忏悔。你在那里待了一整天，做一些事情。但你不能和任何人说再见。拍摄这部剧是一种身临其境的体验，你必须提醒自己没有人会死去。他们不会在预算或任何生产价值上浪费金钱。比如说葬礼的场景，当我们在墓地里，烟雾缭绕，你看到一块刻着你名字的墓碑吗？你正在看着你的朋友们进入地下的棺材。感觉很真实。然后出口是突然的；没有再见。就像，繁荣，消失了。

paras.en: Did you make it further than you thought, or did you think you could win?
paras.zh: 你是否比你想象的更进一步，或者你认为你能获胜吗？

paras.en: I definitely made it farther than I thought. Every day, when I’d walk into breakfast, I’d do a sigh of relief. There are so many steps to get there, I did not want to be the first one eliminated. Then we’re halfway through it, and by the time you can see the end of the tunnel. It’s like, “Let’s just finish it.”
paras.zh: 我确实比我想象的更远。每天，当我走进早餐时，我都会松一口气。到达那里有很多步骤，我不想成为第一个被淘汰的人。然后我们就走了一半，这时你就可以看到隧道的尽头了。就像是，“让我们完成它吧。”

paras.en: But if I’m being really honest, after the feast and hearing some of the other people’s stories, like Abby B and Shane and some of the other contestants opening up, I was like, “I actually think there are other people who deserve the money more than me.” I truly feel like if I would have won the money, I may have had guilt.
paras.zh: 但说实话，在宴会结束后，听到其他人的故事，比如艾比 B 和肖恩以及其他一些参赛者的故事，我当时想，“我实际上认为还有其他人比我更值得得到这笔钱。”我真的觉得如果我赢了钱，我可能会感到内疚。

paras.en: I would love to have an extra $250,000. But I think there are other people where it can change their life.
paras.zh: 我希望能有额外的 250,000 美元。但我认为还有其他人可以改变他们的生活。

paras.en: Are you still going to “haunt” Katie, or are you over it?
paras.zh: 你还会“困扰”凯蒂，还是已经结束了？

paras.en: No, I’m still haunting her. (Laughs.) She’s great, and I don’t blame her. Obviously, it’s part of the game. But I was onto her for a while.
paras.zh: 不，我还是对她念念不忘。 （笑）她很棒，我不怪她。显然，这是游戏的一部分。但我对她有一段时间了。

paras.en: You opened up about yourself — what it was like growing up gay in Wisconsin and parts about your family life. What about this process lends you to open up in the way that you did?
paras.zh: 你讲述了自己的经历——在威斯康星州长大的同性恋经历以及你的家庭生活。这个过程能让你像以前那样敞开心扉吗？

paras.en: I’m not a very emotional person. Not many people have ever seen me cry. Everything I do in life is with humor, whether that’s deflecting pain or hurt. So, those emotions you saw were very real and raw. Growing up as a gay kid in a small town in Wisconsin, being bullied in school for being gay, and then having a super traumatic experience with my stepdad. He literally held a gun to my head when he found out I was gay.
paras.zh: 我不是一个很情绪化的人。没有多少人见过我哭。我在生活中所做的一切都是幽默的，无论是转移痛苦还是伤害。所以，你看到的那些情绪是非常真实和原始的。作为一个同性恋孩子在威斯康星州的一个小镇长大，在学校因为同性恋而受到欺负，然后与我的继父经历了一次超级痛苦的经历。当他发现我是同性恋时，他真的用枪指着我的头。

paras.en: I’ve kind of struggled with male relationships. I’m much more comfortable with women, and then with gay men, it’s like, “Is this friendship? Does someone want more here?” I do have male friends. I wanted to clear that up. But I would say 99 percent of my friends are female. So going into the castle, I had zero expectation of making any friends. I’m like, “I’m just here to play this game; get in, get out.” And I made such good friends with so many people on the cast.
paras.zh: 我在男性关系中遇到了一些困难。我对女性更自在，而与​​男同性恋在一起时，我会想，“这就是友谊吗？这里有人想要更多吗？”我确实有男性朋友。我想澄清这一点。但我想说我99%的朋友都是女性。所以进入城堡后，我对交朋友的期望为零。我想，“我只是来这里玩这个游戏；进来，出去。”我和剧组里的很多人都交了很好的朋友。

paras.en: In my interviews leading up to it, I had said, “I’m going to be the girl’s gay best friend. I’m the social butterfly. And the guys will see me as an asset because I am a 6-foot-3 Sasquatch that lives on a ranch. I can do all these challenges. They’re going to love me for that.” But I didn’t think they were going to love me for me. And that part was healing in an unexpected way, when you didn’t even know you were broken to be healed.
paras.zh: 在我之前的采访中，我曾说过，“我将成为女孩最好的同性恋朋友。我是社交蝴蝶。男人们会把我视为一种资产，因为我是一只住在牧场上的 6 英尺 3 英寸的大脚野人。我可以完成所有这些挑战。他们会因此而爱我。”但我不认为他们会因为我而爱我。那部分正在以一种意想不到的方式治愈，而你甚至不知道自己已经破碎并需要治愈。

paras.en: In that moment, I said I feel like I’ve already won, which I also think is another reason why I was so at peace leaving. I had a great experience. I had so much fun. I got to come play Clue with all these fun people in the Scottish Highlands and Alan Cumming, a national treasure. It checked every box for me.
paras.zh: 在那一刻，我说我感觉我已经赢了，我也认为这也是我如此平静地离开的另一个原因。我有一个很棒的经历。我玩得很开心。我必须来苏格兰高地和所有这些有趣的人以及国宝艾伦·卡明一起玩线索游戏。它为我检查了每一个方框。

paras.en: From a filming standpoint, behind the scenes, going from viewer to being a part of it. What is something we don’t realize about the show, the filming schedule, about Alan?
paras.zh: 从拍摄的角度来看，在幕后，从观众变成其中的一部分。关于这部剧、拍摄时间表、关于艾伦，还有什么是我们没有意识到的？

paras.en: You could watch TV. You get Netflix, Hulu, Amazon, Disney. I was trying so hard to get cocktails in the castle. You’re only allowed a certain amount of alcoholic drinks, and I just wanted a drink to take the edge off. I always drink a Whitney Houston, which is a vodka and Diet Coke. They would give you a drink made and then one time, they brought it to me, and the shot was tiny. I switched to red wine. I would take the wine, and pour it into my coffee cups, and I was hiding it in the closet. Then when you had a day off, I would drink the wine hiding in the closet. (Laughs.)
paras.zh: 你可以看电视。你可以看到 Netflix、Hulu、亚马逊、迪士尼。我费了好大劲才在城堡里喝到鸡尾酒。你只能喝一定量的酒精饮料，而我只是想喝一杯来缓解一下。我总是喝惠特尼休斯顿，这是一种伏特加和健怡可乐。他们会给你一杯现做的饮料，然后有一次，他们把它带给我，而且镜头很小。我改喝红酒了。我会把酒倒进我的咖啡杯里，然后把它藏在壁橱里。然后当你休息的时候，我会喝藏在衣柜里的酒。 （笑）

paras.en: But I think the thing people would be surprised to know is that Alan sits in those round tables the whole time. They are really long. You see five minutes. They’re sometimes two hours long. He sits there the entire time, and he never breaks character.
paras.zh: 但我认为人们会惊讶地发现艾伦一直坐在那些圆桌会议上。它们真的很长。你看五分钟。有时长达两个小时。他一直坐在那里，从不破坏自己的性格。

paras.en: The one time we got a glimpse of him breaking character is when he told me he wanted a pig. And that’s when I go, “Pigs are the new dogs.” We actually have a brand new piglet we just got, and his name is Alan. I sent him pictures and he said, “Oh my God, did you name that pig after me?” I go, “Of course. His name is Alan Cunningham.” He was dying.
paras.zh: 我们第一次看到他打破性格是在他告诉我他想要一头猪的时候。就在那时我说：“猪是新的狗。”实际上，我们刚刚得到了一只全新的小猪，他的名字叫艾伦。我给他发了照片，他说：“天哪，你是用我的名字给那只猪命名的吗？”我说：“当然。他的名字叫艾伦·坎宁安。”他快死了。

paras.en: Also as an actor to watch him? He’s an icon. I would love to be an actor like Alan Cumming, where you can do so many different things and play so many different characters and have such a long career. What an inspiration. It was almost like I was doing a movie with Alan Cumming.
paras.zh: 还当演员看他？他是一个偶像。我很想成为像艾伦·卡明这样的演员，在那里你可以做很多不同的事情，扮演很多不同的角色，并且有很长的职业生涯。这是多么大的灵感啊。这几乎就像我在和艾伦·卡明一起拍电影。

paras.en: What’s something about the format you’d change?
paras.zh: 您要更改的格式有哪些？

paras.en: I would make it longer because I really think this cast of people was so interesting and dynamic. People came from all different backgrounds. I really don’t think you got to see how cool and special everyone was and is, and the relationships. Tamika and I were ride-or-die besties from day one, and no one even knew we were friends. You don’t see any of it. So I wish people got to see more — and maybe a little more airtime for Ben!
paras.zh: 我会把它写得更长，因为我真的认为这群人是如此有趣和充满活力。人们来自不同的背景。我真的不认为你会看到每个人过去和现在有多么酷和特别，以及他们之间的关系。塔米卡和我从第一天起就是生死攸关的好朋友，甚至没有人知道我们是朋友。你什么也看不到。所以我希望人们能够看到更多——也许还有本的更多播出时间！

paras.en: Is there something about you that you want people to know that we didn’t get to see?
paras.zh: 你有什么事情是你想让人们知道但我们没有看到的吗？

paras.en: A lot of my friends, or people who know me, said, “You are so quiet and calm, and flying under the radar,” and that is so not who I am. I’m loud, energetic. Usually people would say I’m life of the party. So I’m definitely much larger than life than I was shown on the show. But I also think you got to see a more sensitive, nice side of me on the show.
paras.zh: 我的很多朋友，或者认识我的人都说，“你是如此安静、平静，在雷达之下飞行”，而那不是我。我声音很大，精力充沛。通常人们会说我是聚会的主角。所以我绝对比节目中表现的要伟大得多。但我也认为你会在节目中看到我更敏感、更友善的一面。

paras.en: You’ve been called King of the One Liners. Which one are you most proud of?
paras.zh: 您被称为 One Liners 之王。你最引以为豪的是哪一个？

paras.en: “Shut up, Jay” was an iconic line. I think “pigs are the new dog,” and also comparing that Victor and Cher will live forever.
paras.zh: “闭嘴，杰伊”是一句标志性的台词。我认为“猪是新的狗”，并且比较维克多和雪儿将永远活着。

paras.en: Is there anything you want to say in response to things you’ve read from your castmates who’ve been doing interviews?
paras.zh: 对于你从接受采访的演员那里读到的事情，你有什么想说的吗？

paras.en: (Laughs.) There are some castmates out there who have had some strong opinions. I think that in the climate we live in, gay people have had it hard enough. I don’t understand why another gay guy is out there trying to bash people or tear people down. We really should be building each other up. I don’t see the point in that.
paras.zh: （笑）有些演员有一些强烈的意见。我认为在我们生活的环境下，同性恋者已经过得很艰难了。我不明白为什么另一个同性恋者会试图殴打人们或拆毁人们。我们真的应该互相帮助。我不明白这有什么意义。

paras.en: How do you feel about reality shows now? Would you do another one?
paras.zh: 您现在对真人秀节目有何看法？你会再做一件事吗？

paras.en: Scripted will always be my front and center, and the ultimate goal. But I’ve never been one to say no. So I’m not closing any doors. I think I could do a little Dancing With the Stars.
paras.zh: 脚本化永远是我的前沿和中心，也是最终目标。但我从来都不是一个会说不的人。所以我不会关闭任何门。我想我可以做一点与星共舞。

paras.en: You have your podcast, It’s Ben a Week, which is the most appropriate title for this moment. It’s a weekly comedy, pop culture show. Will you have Traitors stars on, now that you can finally talk about the show?
paras.zh: 你有你的播客，It's Ben a Week，这是此时最合适的标题。这是每周一播的喜剧、流行文化节目。现在你终于可以谈论这部剧了，你会邀请《叛徒》的明星出演吗？

paras.en: Yes, now that I’m able to. That was really hard for me. It’s Ben a Week really has been my baby for years. I’m a one-man band. I book my own guests, edit my own shows. I do all my own social media. I spoke about this on a recent episode: It’s been really hard to not to talk about it. It’s almost like I couldn’t be honest these last few months. Traitors has taken over my entire world, and I wasn’t able to talk about it. Every week I’m coming on talking about how it’s been a week, but I can’t really talk about what my week has been. I’m excited that now I can speak on it and share my experience.
paras.zh: 是的，现在我可以了。这对我来说真的很难。 《每周本》多年来一直是我的宝贝。我是一支单人乐队。我自己预订客人，编辑自己的节目。我所有的社交媒体都是我自己做的。我在最近的一集中谈到了这一点：很难不谈论它。过去几个月我几乎无法诚实。叛徒已经占领了我的整个世界，我无法谈论它。每周我都会谈论这一周过得怎么样，但我不能真正谈论我这一周过得怎么样。我很高兴现在我可以谈论它并分享我的经验。

paras.en: I’m opening the invitation to any of the castmembers who want to come on. I know a lot of them will because we’re good friends, but the invitation is open to all of the castmembers. I also have some other cast from previous seasons who will be coming on , so you’re going to hear from some other Faithfuls and Traitors.
paras.zh: 我向所有想要上场的演员发出邀请。我知道他们中的很多人都会这样做，因为我们是好朋友，但邀请是向所有演员开放的。我还有一些前几季的其他演员也将加入，所以你会听到其他一些忠实者和叛徒的声音。

paras.en: What are some of your favorite podcasts?
paras.zh: 您最喜欢的播客有哪些？

paras.en: I love comedy podcasts and casual conversations, which is something I try to do. I want to sit in my car and feel like we’re all hanging out together. I want people to feel like they’re hanging out with their friend Ben. I love Las Culturistas with Matt Rogers and Bowen Yang. I love Long Winded with Gabby Windey. She’s been on The Traitors. The fact that she can just sit by herself and talk for an hour and how she rambles and how smart she is and quick witted, I love her. It’s the funniest thing. I also listen to, Sorry, We’re Cyrus, which is Brandi and Tish Cyrus. I listen to Chelsea Handler. And, of course, I listen to Call Her Daddy because she gets some really, really cool guests.
paras.zh: 我喜欢喜剧播客和随意的对话，这是我尝试做的事情。我想坐在我的车里，感觉我们都在一起闲逛。我希望人们感觉他们正在和朋友本一起出去玩。我喜欢马特·罗杰斯和鲍文·杨的《Las Culturistas》。我喜欢 Gabby Windey 的《Long Winded》。她曾出演过《叛徒》。事实上，她可以一个人坐着讲一个小时，她的闲聊方式，她的聪明和机智，我爱她。这是最有趣的事情。我还听“对不起，我们是赛勒斯”，即布兰迪和蒂什·赛勒斯。我听切尔西·汉德勒的歌。当然，我听《Call Her Daddy》是因为她有一些非常非常酷的客人。

paras.en: What’s your dream acting role? I hear Taylor Sheridan lives in your neighborhood.
paras.zh: 你梦想的扮演角色是什么？我听说泰勒·谢里丹住在你家附近。

paras.en: Taylor lives right down the street. He’s filming so many shows. I’m pretty sure he has a new partnership with NBC that’s starting up the next couple years. … I can literally ride my horse to set. Taylor, you have an actor in your backyard who has his own horses he can ride to set. I don’t even need a stunt double!
paras.zh: 泰勒就住在这条街上。他拍了很多节目。我很确定他与 NBC 建立了新的合作关系，该合作关系将在未来几年内启动。 ......我真的可以骑着我的马去拍摄。泰勒，你的后院有一位演员，他有自己的马，可以骑着去片场。我什至不需要替身！

paras.en: I love comedies like Schitt’s Creek. A David in Schitt’s Creek. I love Grace and Frankie. I would love one of those shows that has a cultlike following. I think everyone wants that!
paras.zh: 我喜欢像《Schitt's Creek》这样的喜剧。施特溪的大卫。我爱格蕾丝和弗兰基。我会喜欢那些拥有狂热追随者的节目之一。我想每个人都希望如此！

paras.en: Half of me loves the comedy, but then I can put that cowboy hat on. I just did a movie that comes out next year, called Cowboy. It’s a gay cowboy movie where I play the straight cowboy. On Traitors, I’ve been portrayed as this gay cowboy, but I also can play the straight cowboy.
paras.zh: 我有一半喜欢这部喜剧，但之后我就可以戴上牛仔帽了。我刚刚拍了一部明年上映的电影，名叫《牛仔》。这是一部同性恋牛仔电影，我在其中扮演异性恋牛仔。在《叛徒》中，我被描绘成同性恋牛仔，但我也可以扮演异性恋牛仔。

paras.en: The next batch of Traitors will be back to celebrities. Any advice for them now that you’ve been through it?
paras.zh: 下一批叛徒将回归名人。既然你已经经历了这一切，你对他们有什么建议吗？

paras.en: Celebrities have it so much harder, because everyone knows everyone. I’m a Real Housewives fan, so when I’m watching The Traitors, I’m always rooting for the Housewives. But even if you don’t watch Housewives, you know Lisa Rinna’s reputation. She can’t go on the show and try to lie or be something else. I had the opportunity where I could change my personality a little bit or be what I wanted everyone to believe.
paras.zh: 名人的处境要困难得多，因为每个人都认识每个人。我是《真正的家庭主妇》的粉丝，所以当我看《叛徒》时，我总是支持《家庭主妇》。但即使你不看《主妇》，你也知道丽莎·琳娜的名声。她不能在节目中试图撒谎或扮演其他角色。我有机会稍微改变自己的性格，或者成为我希望每个人都相信的人。

paras.en: But I guess, try to be yourself and try to make friends.
paras.zh: 但我想，努力做你自己，努力交朋友。

paras.en: What about your season — who are you rooting for to win on Thursday? Where are you watching the finale?
paras.zh: 你的赛季怎么样——你支持谁在周四获胜？你在哪里看大结局？

paras.en: I’ll be watching the finale in New York at Club Cumming, Alan’s club. I have my alliance with Clyde and Abby B, so I really would hope for them to win. And of course, my sweaty boy, Victor. I’m excited to see the finale and who is going to win, or what group. Faithful or Traitor?
paras.zh: 我将在纽约艾伦的俱乐部卡明俱乐部观看决赛。我与克莱德和艾比 B 结盟，所以我真的希望他们能获胜。当然，还有我满头大汗的儿子维克多。我很高兴看到决赛以及谁将获胜，或者哪组获胜。忠诚还是叛徒？

paras.en: I tried, and they were like, “That’s a hard no.” (Laughs.) I did get to take some of the wardrobe. You bring your own wardrobe, but if you wear some of their stuff, you get to keep it. I did get some really cool pants!
paras.zh: 我尝试过，但他们说：“这很难。” （笑）我确实拿走了一些衣柜。你带着自己的衣柜，但如果你穿了他们的一些东西，你就可以保留它。我确实得到了一些非常酷的裤子！

paras.en: The two-part Traitors finale releases Thursday at 8 p.m. on Peacock; all episodes stream on Peacock.
paras.zh: 《叛徒》大结局由两部分组成，将于周四晚上 8 点上映。关于孔雀；所有剧集均在 Peacock 上播出。

articles.title: James Bond Fans Already Complaining About Robert Pattinson: “Not Alpha Male”
articles.author: James Hibberd

paras.en: There are many great reasons for casting Robert Pattinson as James Bond.
paras.zh: 选择罗伯特·帕丁森饰演詹姆斯·邦德有很多重要的理由。

paras.en: But in the wake of Amazon-MGM Studios announcing the Batman actor as the seventh 007, plenty of fans are griping online about the choice.
paras.zh: 但在亚马逊-米高梅影业宣布这位蝙蝠侠演员为第七位 007 演员后，许多粉丝在网上抱怨这一选择。

paras.en: Such complaints are to be expected, of course. Any actor cast as Bond is going to get bashed. Even Daniel Craig was roundly criticized by fans when producers tapped the character actor as Bond back in 2005 (“he isn’t handsome enough,” “Bond can’t be blonde,” etc.) Our visual concept of Bond is entirely formed by the other six actors who have played the role, so anybody new is going to be tough to imagine — at least, at first.
paras.zh: 当然，这样的抱怨是可以预料到的。任何扮演邦德的演员都会受到抨击。早在 2005 年，当制片人选择角色演员扮演邦德时，就连丹尼尔·克雷格也受到了粉丝的严厉批评（“他不够英俊”、“邦德不可能是金发女郎”等）。我们对邦德的视觉概念完全是由其他六位扮演过这个角色的演员形成的，所以任何新人都会很难想象——至少一开始是这样。

paras.en: That said, the Pattinson complaints are interesting, perhaps even valuable, as they show producers what they’re up against in terms of preconceived notions about their casting choice.
paras.zh: 也就是说，帕丁森的抱怨很有趣，甚至可能很有价值，因为它们向制片人展示了他们在选角选择方面所面临的先入为主的观念。

paras.en: The comment section of the British tabloid Daily Mail has been a hive of Pattinson bashing all morning.
paras.zh: 英国小报《每日邮报》的评论区整个上午都是对帕丁森的猛烈抨击。

paras.en: Wrote one: “He lacks the magnetic charm, polished elegance, rugged confidence, seductive sophistication, and effortless swagger that define James Bond.” Similarly penned another: “He doesn’t stand out as having the animal masculinity or charisma of a Bond character.” Another opined: “He doesn’t come across as Alpha male, ladies man, action type.” Snarked another: “I’ve seen sexier potatoes.”
paras.zh: 其中一篇写道：“他缺乏詹姆斯·邦德所具有的磁性魅力、优雅的优雅、坚定的自信、诱人的精致和毫不费力的招摇。”另一篇文章也有类似的描述：“他并不具有邦德角色的动物阳刚之气或魅力。”另一位网友则表示：“他给人的印象不是阿尔法男性、女汉子、行动派。”另一位尖刻地说：“我见过更性感的土豆。”

paras.en: Others felt that Pattinson has had too many iconic roles and expressed frustration that the same actors seem to be cast in so many projects.
paras.zh: 其他人则认为帕丁森扮演了太多标志性角色，并对相同的演员似乎在这么多项目中扮演角色表示沮丧。

paras.en: “You can’t have the same actor playing Batman and James Bond at the same time,” wrote one. “The Broccoli family would have never made this decision.” Or as one fan elaborated on Amazon MGM Studios’ Instagram post: “If you want to make a James Bond truly immortal, you have to cast someone who isn’t already strongly associated with other iconic movie characters.”
paras.zh: “你不能让同一个演员同时扮演蝙蝠侠和詹姆斯·邦德，”其中一位写道。 “西兰花家族永远不会做出这个决定。”或者正如一位粉丝在亚马逊米高梅影业公司的 Instagram 帖子中详细阐述的那样：“如果你想让詹姆斯·邦德真正不朽，你必须选择一个与其他标志性电影角色没有密切联系的人。”

paras.en: Or wrote one Redditor: “I’m not fond of this choice. I’d much rather see him continue his very interesting career as he has been excellent in so many roles & then have a newly discovered talent or up & comer to play Bond.”
paras.zh: 或者一位 Reddit 用户写道：“我不喜欢这个选择。我更愿意看到他继续他非常有趣的职业生涯，因为他在很多角色中都很出色，然后有一个新发现的人才或后起之秀来扮演邦德。”

paras.en: One influencer on X called the casting a “disappointingly unimaginative choice … Do we really have such a shortage of actors that we need the same handful of guys playing every iconic character? … This feels like a lazy, risk-averse pick designed to hedge Amazon’s bets by casting an established star.”
paras.zh: X 上的一位有影响力的人称选角是一个“令人失望、缺乏想象力的选择……我们真的如此缺乏演员，以至于我们需要同样的几个人来扮演每个标志性角色吗？……这感觉像是一个懒惰、规避风险的选择，旨在通过选角一位知名明星来对冲亚马逊的赌注。”

paras.en: Of course, plenty (if not most) reactions online have been positive, and even some of his detractors begrudgingly admit that Pattinson is a terrific actor who will probably crush the role.
paras.zh: 当然，网上的很多（如果不是大多数）反应都是积极的，甚至他的一些批评者也不情愿地承认帕丁森是一位出色的演员，他可能会压垮这个角色。

paras.en: The truth is there’s too much at stake — and too many talented people behind the scenes in a Bond production — for any actor cast in the role to outright fail. Any of the actors who were under consideration could have been made to work, and Pattinson, one suspects, will have less of a hill to climb than others given his star power and franchise experience. A week or two after the opening of Bond 26, Pattinson will have evolved from a decision made by producers and a studio to simply being Bond (James Bond).
paras.zh: 事实是，任何扮演这个角色的演员都面临着太多的风险，而且在邦德制作的幕后幕后有太多才华横溢的人，所以不可能彻底失败。任何正在考虑的演员都可以被安排去工作，有人怀疑，考虑到帕丁森的明星影响力和特许经营经验，他比其他人要爬的山要少。 《邦德 26》上映一两周后，帕丁森将从制片人和工作室的决定演变为简单的邦德（詹姆斯·邦德）。

articles.title: Berkshire Hathaway raised its stake in Delta in the third quarter. It also trimmed a key bank holding

paras.en: Berkshire Hathaway made several moves in the stock market during the third quarter, adding to key positions and trimming others.
paras.zh: 伯克希尔哈撒韦公司第三季度在股市采取了多项举措，增加了关键仓位并削减了其他仓位。

paras.en: The Greg Abel-led conglomerate increased its Delta Air Lines stake by 12%, scooping up 7.13 million shares. The position was worth $5.37 billion at the end of the third quarter.
paras.zh: 格雷格·阿贝尔 (Greg Abel) 领导的企业集团将达美航空 (Delta Air Lines) 股份增加了 12%，购买了 713 万股。截至第三季度末，该头寸价值 53.7 亿美元。

paras.en: Delta shares tumbled 11% over that period, as rising jet fuel prices due to the U.S.-Iran war pressured the airline industry. That marked the stock's worst quarterly performance since the first quarter of 2025, when it plunged 28%. Delta last month also cut its full-year earnings forecast, citing a surge in fuel costs.
paras.zh: 由于美伊战争导致航空燃油价格上涨给航空业带来压力，达美航空股价同期下跌 11%。这是该股自 2025 年第一季度以来最差的季度表现，当时该股暴跌 28%。达美航空上个月还下调了全年盈利预期，理由是燃油成本飙升。

paras.en: To be sure, buying that dip has been a winning investment thus far. Delta is up 3.8% so far in the fourth quarter, while the S&P 500 has dropped 3.1%. Shares are also up nearly 15% over the past month.
paras.zh: 可以肯定的是，迄今为止，逢低买入一直是一项成功的投资。第四季度迄今为止，达美航空股价上涨了 3.8%，而标准普尔 500 指数则下跌了 3.1%。过去一个月股价也上涨了近 15%。

paras.en: Berkshire also trimmed its holding in Bank of America by nearly 6%, selling more than $1.6 billion worth of stock.
paras.zh: 伯克希尔还减持了美国银行近 6% 的股份，出售了价值超过 16 亿美元的股票。

paras.en: BofA was under pressure in the third quarter, falling more than 4%, as interest rates surged alongside stubbornly high inflation and expectations of tighter Federal Reserve monetary policy. At one point in September the 30-year Treasury bond yield surged above 5.6% to its highest level since 2002.
paras.zh: 由于利率飙升、通胀居高不下以及美联储收紧货币政策的预期，美国银行第三季度面临压力，跌幅超过4%。 9月份，30年期国债收益率一度飙升至5.6%以上，达到2002年以来的最高水平。

paras.en: Despite the share sale, Bank of America remains a top Berkshire Hathaway holding, with the conglomerate's stake valued at $24.8 billion at the end of the third quarter.
paras.zh: 尽管出售了股票，美国银行仍然是伯克希尔·哈撒韦公司的最大控股公司，截至第三季度末，该集团所持股份价值达 248 亿美元。

paras.en: Berkshire also initiated a position in Bending Spoons and nearly doubled its stake in homebuilder Lennar in the latest quarter.
paras.zh: 伯克希尔哈撒韦公司还增持了 Bending Spoons 的股份，并在最近一个季度将其在住宅建筑商 Lennar 的股份增加了近一倍。

articles.title: United Airlines reports system outage affecting departing flights

paras.en: United Airlines on Monday reported a "widespread system outage" was affecting departing flights.
paras.zh: 美国联合航空公司周一报告称，“大范围的系统中断”正在影响离港航班。

paras.en: "We are troubleshooting a technology issue affecting departing flights," the airline said in a statement. "There is no impact on flights in progress, or on United Express flights."
paras.zh: 该航空公司在一份声明中表示：“我们正在解决影响离港航班的技术问题。” “这对正在进行的航班或联合快运航班没有影响。”

paras.en: A United spokesperson said there was no indication that the outage was a cyberattack.
paras.zh: 美联航发言人表示，没有迹象表明此次故障是网络攻击造成的。

paras.en: United said in a post on X that its teams "are working hard to get things back up and running as soon as possible." The airline told travelers to check their flight status for updates.
paras.zh: 曼联在 X 上的一篇帖子中表示，其团队“正在努力让一切尽快恢复正常运行”。该航空公司要求旅客检查航班状态以获取更新。

paras.en: The airline's outage came three days after a nationwide ground stop halted flights across the country for more than four hours, snarling travel and leading to widespread delays and cancellations over the weekend.
paras.zh: 该航空公司停运三天前，全国范围内的一个地面站导致全国各地的航班停飞四个多小时，导致旅行陷入困境，并导致周末出现大范围的航班延误和取消。

paras.en: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy blamed the issues that led to Friday's ground stop on a router in Arkansas that overwhelmed systems that feed radar and other data for air traffic control. FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford said the upgrades were part of "routine" maintenance to switch over from copper wires to fiber optic.
paras.zh: 交通部长肖恩·达菲 (Sean Duffy) 将导致周五地面停车的问题归咎于阿肯色州的一个路由器，该路由器淹没了为空中交通管制提供雷达和其他数据的系统。 FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford said the upgrades were part of "routine" maintenance to switch over from copper wires to fiber optic.

paras.en: — CNBC's Phil LeBeau contributed to this report.
paras.zh: — CNBC 的 Phil LeBeau 对本报告做出了贡献。

articles.title: Voyager 1 approaches a ‘light-day’ milestone

paras.en: Nicky Fox was driving through the gates of NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory this past October when she received a jarring text message: “We didn’t get data from Voyager 1 this morning.”
paras.zh: 去年 10 月，尼基·福克斯 (Nicky Fox) 开车穿过 NASA 喷气推进实验室大门时，收到了一条刺耳的短信：“今天早上我们没有从旅行者 1 号获得数据。”

paras.en: Fox, leader of NASA’s Science Mission Directorate, often refers to this beloved spacecraft as a friend. “Every day they send you the equivalent of a postcard home,” she says. “It’s 0’s and 1’s that we turn into amazing interplanetary data.”
paras.zh: 福克斯是美国宇航局科学任务理事会的负责人，经常将这艘深受喜爱的航天器称为朋友。 “他们每天都会寄给你相当于一张明信片的东西回家，”她说。 “我们将 0 和 1 转化为令人惊叹的行星际数据。”

paras.en: NASA’s Voyager 1 probe has been traversing the cosmos since September 5, 1977, when it launched on an ambitious mission to the outer planets that would ultimately take it beyond the solar system. Along the way, it has delivered spectacular science, capturing enchanting views of Jupiter’s Great Red Spot and even an iconic portrait of our home planet as a “Pale Blue Dot” suspended in a sunbeam. The spacecraft’s engineering is just as marvelous as its science: in 2012, despite what one member of its team jokingly calls “prehistoric technology,” it became the first human-made object to enter interstellar space. And now, at more than 16 billion miles away from Earth, it’s heading toward a nearly unfathomable milestone—the distance of a light-day.
paras.zh: NASA 的航行者 1 号探测器自 1977 年 9 月 5 日起就一直在宇宙中航行，当时它发射了一项雄心勃勃的外行星任务，最终将其带出太阳系。一路上，它提供了令人惊叹的科学成果，捕捉到了木星大红斑的迷人景色，甚至捕捉到了我们家乡星球的标志性肖像，即悬浮在阳光中的“淡蓝点”。这艘航天器的工程技术和它的科学一样了不起：2012 年，尽管其团队的一名成员戏称为“史前技术”，它还是成为第一个进入星际空间的人造物体。现在，在距地球超过 160 亿英里的地方，它正朝着一个几乎深不可测的里程碑——光日的距离迈进。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: The long-awaited moment will fall on November 18 at 5:16 A.M. EST (2:16 A.M. PST). But when Fox got that worrying text in mid-October, she momentarily wondered if the hardy spacecraft would reach that milestone in darkness.
paras.zh: 期待已久的时刻将于 11 月 18 日凌晨 5 点 16 分到来。美国东部时间（太平洋标准时间凌晨 2:16）。但当福克斯在十月中旬收到这条令人担忧的短信时，她立刻想知道这艘​​坚固的航天器是否会在黑暗中到达那个里程碑。

paras.en: “There was that pit in the stomach of just ‘oh, my goodness,’” she says. “And actually, I think then the light-day became a very significant thing for me.”
paras.zh: “心里有一个‘哦，我的天啊’的感觉，”她说。 “事实上，我认为光日对我来说变得非常重要。”

paras.en: The glitch was just another day at the office for the members of the Voyager team, who have become accustomed to rescuing the probe from one calamity after another as its hardware has continued to slowly degrade. “Don’t worry, Nicky, we’ll get it back,” Fox recalls team members reassuring her. Before they could send any commands to the spacecraft, however, Voyager resolved the issue itself.
paras.zh: 对于航行者号团队的成员来说，这次故障只是办公室的又一天，随着探测器的硬件继续缓慢退化，他们已经习惯于将探测器从一次又一次的灾难中拯救出来。 “别担心，尼基，我们会把它拿回来的，”福克斯回忆说，团队成员向她保证。然而，在他们向航天器发送任何命令之前，航行者号自己解决了这个问题。

paras.en: This time the spacecraft only went quiet for a total of 48 hours, but after nearly a half-century of operations, it has been through quite a bit. Only two of the spacecraft’s 10 instruments are still on as part of a power-saving measure, ensuring it has the strength to keep going. This is a major reason it should be able to get across the looming light-day milestone. Counterintuitively, Voyager 1’s sister spacecraft, Voyager 2, launched 16 days before its sibling but has followed a different trajectory that brought it to interstellar space in 2018; Voyager 2 still has about nine years before its own light-day arrives.
paras.zh: 这次飞船总共只安静了48个小时，但经过近半个世纪的运行，它已经经历了不小的历程。作为节电措施的一部分，航天器的 10 个仪器中只有两个仍在运行，以确保其有足够的力量继续运行。这是它能够跨越即将到来的光日里程碑的主要原因。与直觉相反，航海者 1 号的姊妹飞船航海者 2 号比其同级飞船早 16 天发射，但遵循了不同的轨迹，并于 2018 年进入星际空间；航海家二号距离它自己的光日到来还有大约九年的时间。

paras.en: The simple fact that these spacecraft still work at all testifies to the extraordinary planning behind their creation—and the heroic efforts of the personnel keeping them alive. Both offer reasons aplenty for celebration. But the light-day landmark is an extra opportunity to reflect on not just the progress of Voyager 1 but also the passage of time here on Earth.
paras.zh: 这些航天器仍然可以工作这一简单事实证明了它们的创造背后的非凡计划以及工作人员为保证它们生存而付出的英勇努力。两者都提供了充足的庆祝理由。但光日里程碑是一个额外的机会，让我们不仅可以反思旅行者一号的进展，还可以反思地球上时间的流逝。

paras.en: “I started working on one of the Voyager instruments a few years before they launched and have worked with them and the data they have returned for my entire career,” says William Kurth, a co-investigator on the Voyager Plasma Wave instrument. “Until now, I had never conceived of a time when I would wonder which of us would outlast the other.”
paras.zh: “在 Voyager 仪器推出前几年，我就开始研究其中一台仪器，并在我的整个职业生涯中与它们合作以及它们返回的数据，”Voyager 等离子体波仪器的联合研究员 William Kurth 说道。 “直到现在，我从来没有想过有一天我会想知道我们谁会比另一个更长寿。”

paras.en: “I think John Casani said it best: We didn’t design them to last 30 years or 40 years. We designed them not to fail,” says Kelly Perry, Voyager 1’s data systems engineer. John Casani was Voyager’s project manager in the 1970s and the first to envision the Golden Records—beautiful time capsules on both Voyager 1 and 2 that hold fingerprints of humanity. Each record is encoded with things that include Louis Armstrong’s “Melancholy Blues,” a Peruvian wedding song and greetings in 55 different languages, as well as a stylus and playback instructions, all in the hope that an extraterrestrial civilization may find them one day and experience the echoes of Earth. Casani died in 2025 at the age of 92.
paras.zh: “我认为约翰·卡萨尼 (John Casani) 说得最好：我们设计它们的目的不是为了持续 30 年或 40 年。我们设计它们是为了不会出现故障，”航海者 1 号的数据系统工程师凯利·佩里 (Kelly Perry) 说道。约翰·卡萨尼 (John Casani) 是 20 世纪 70 年代航海家号的项目经理，也是第一个设想金唱片的人——航海家号 1 号和航海家 2 号上都有美丽的时间胶囊，里面保存着人类的指纹。每张唱片都编码有路易斯·阿姆斯特朗的《忧郁布鲁斯》、一首秘鲁婚礼歌曲和 55 种不同语言的问候语，以及一支手写笔和播放说明，所有这些都希望有一天外星文明能够找到它们并体验地球的回声。卡萨尼于 2025 年去世，享年 92 岁。

paras.en: “I am thankful for the care and creativity of past team members in keeping the spacecraft thriving,” says Bhavana Gupta, who has been Voyager power analyst for the past year. “Not many people have the chance to work on spacecraft that launched decades before they were born.”
paras.zh: “我感谢过去团队成员的关心和创造力，让航天器保持蓬勃发展，”过去一年担任 Voyager 电力分析师的巴瓦纳·古普塔 (Bhavana Gupta) 说道。 “没有多少人有机会在他们出生前几十年发射的航天器上工作。”

paras.en: Both Voyagers now traverse the scarcely explored region beyond the heliopause, which is the boundary between our sun’s bubble of magnetized plasma and the outlying interstellar medium.
paras.zh: 两艘航海者号现在都穿越了日球层顶之外几乎没有探索过的区域，这是太阳磁化等离子体气泡和外围星际介质之间的边界。

paras.en: In some sense, there is nothing scientifically special about Voyager 1 reaching a light-day—after all, the duration of a “day” is a decidedly Earth-centric measurement—but the general distance does have some interesting technological effects for the spacecraft.
paras.zh: 从某种意义上说，航海者一号到达光日并没有什么特别的科学意义——毕竟，“一天”的持续时间显然是一个以地球为中心的测量——但一般距离确实对航天器产生了一些有趣的技术影响。

paras.en: “The one-light-day distance is not a noteworthy location other than it is really far away,” says Adam Szabo, principal investigator for the Voyager 1 and 2 magnetometers. “Technologically, it is a good illustration of how hard it is to operate a spacecraft in the outer heliosphere and local interstellar medium.”
paras.zh: “一光日距离并不是一个值得注意的位置，只是它确实很远，”旅行者 1 号和 2 号磁力计首席研究员 Adam Szabo 说。 “从技术上讲，这很好地说明了在外日光层和当地星际介质中操作航天器是多么困难。”

paras.en: The term “light-day” refers to how light takes a full 24 hours to cross this distance. That travel time creates a bit of a complication for Voyager 1 scientists when they attempt to communicate with the spacecraft—especially when troubleshooting issues with the probe such as the one that occurred in October.
paras.zh: “光日”一词是指光需要整整 24 小时才能穿过这个距离。当航海家一号科学家尝试与航天器通信时，这段旅行时间给他们带来了一些麻烦，尤其是在解决探测器问题（例如 10 月份发生的问题）时。

paras.en: “Whatever change or correction we want to command, we need two days—one day there and another back—to find out if the command worked or further corrective action is needed,” says Szabo, who started working with the probes as a Ph.D. student in 1988.
paras.zh: “无论我们想要命令什么改变或纠正，我们都需要两天的时间——一天在那里，另一天回来——来查明命令是否有效或需要采取进一步的纠正行动，”萨博说，他在博士期间就开始研究探测器。 1988年学生。

paras.en: This can be particularly disconcerting, Fox says, if the spacecraft has lost its attitude control, making its radio dish no longer point in toward Earth. “That’s a hell of a long way to be trying to send pings while you have to wait for the spacecraft to turn around,” she adds.
paras.zh: 福克斯说，如果航天器失去姿态控制，使其无线电天线不再指向地球，这可能会特别令人不安。她补充道：“在你必须等待航天器掉头的同时，还要尝试发送 ping 信号，这是一条漫长的路。”

paras.en: As remarkable as reaching one light-day may seem, what’s all the more notable is its revelation of just how small we really are.
paras.zh: 达到一光日似乎很了不起，但更值得注意的是它揭示了我们到底有多么渺小。

paras.en: A single light-day represents 16,094,799,096 miles (25,902,068,356 kilometers) in distance; for context, the moon is about 238,855 miles (384,400 km) from Earth, meaning a light-day is equal to about 67,383 Earth-moon distances back-to-back. This puts the concept of a light-year—a metric astronomers breezily use in daily life just as often as we use miles or kilometers—into an appropriately mind-numbing context.
paras.zh: 一个光日的距离为 16,094,799,096 英里（25,902,068,356 公里）；就上下文而言，月球距地球约 238,855 英里（384,400 公里），这意味着一个光日等于约 67,383 地月背靠背距离。这将光年的概念（天文学家在日常生活中轻松使用的公制单位，就像我们使用英里或公里一样频繁）置于一个适当的令人麻木的背景中。

paras.en: “We’ll say, ‘Oh, this galaxy is pretty close—it’s only a million light-years away,’” Fox says. “But no, think about how far away that really is.”
paras.zh: “我们会说，‘哦，这个星系非常近——只有一百万光年远，’”福克斯说。 “但是不，想想那到底有多远。”

paras.en: Perhaps, Perry wonders, having a tangible object take 49 years to reach a single light-day makes the true immensity of space easier to obtain. “It’s a distance people can grasp,” she says. “It’s this generation’s ‘Pale Blue Dot.’”
paras.zh: 佩里想知道，也许一个有形物体需要 49 年才能到达一个光日，这使得真正广阔的太空更容易获得。 “这是人们可以把握的距离，”她说。 “这是这一代的‘淡蓝点’。”

paras.en: As for what’s next: Well, the Voyagers’ duties aren’t only to travel far—they’re to travel far and to explore. These probes have been quite revolutionary for astronomy, having provided the first close-ups of Jupiter, Saturn, Neptune and Uranus. They even discovered several moons. “At virtually every phase of their explorations, they have surprised us at the endless creativity of the natural universe; none of the planets or moons they visited were as simple as expected,” Kurth says.
paras.zh: 至于下一步：嗯，航海者号的职责不仅仅是远行——他们还要远行和探索。这些探测器对天文学来说具有相当大的革命性，首次提供了木星、土星、海王星和天王星的特写镜头。他们甚至发现了几个卫星。 “在他们探索的几乎每个阶段，他们都让我们对自然宇宙的无穷创造力感到惊讶；他们访问过的行星或卫星都不像预期的那么简单，”库斯说。

paras.en: And by entering the interstellar medium, both spacecraft have revealed what happens in a place humans once only dreamed of accessing, opening up many new questions scientists are eager to answer. “We’ve proven interstellar space is very dynamic,” Perry says. “It’s much more interesting than the empty void that many people believe it is.”
paras.zh: 通过进入星际介质，这两艘航天器揭示了人类曾经梦想进入的地方所发生的事情，提出了许多科学家渴望回答的新问题。 “我们已经证明星际空间是非常动态的，”佩里说。 “它比许多人认为的空虚有趣得多。”

paras.en: For instance, Voyager data show shock waves from solar storms that create auroras in our skies persisting beyond the heliopause. “This should not happen in the ancient local interstellar medium, where every disturbance should have dissipated away a long time ago,” Szabo says. “Yet even at [nearly a light-day] away, the sun still manages to impact the local space environment.”
paras.zh: 例如，航行者号的数据显示，太阳风暴的冲击波在我们的天空中产生了极光，并且在日球层顶之外持续存在。萨博说：“这种情况不应该发生在古老的本地星际介质中，那里的所有扰动都应该在很久以前就消失了。” “然而，即使在[近一光日]之外，太阳仍然设法影响当地的太空环境。”

paras.en: Interstellar plasma density also seems to increase the farther out you get, and the magnetic field direction seen at the boundaries of our cosmic neighborhood doesn’t immediately change once you get to the interstellar medium. “We don’t know why this is so,” Kurth says. “We hope Voyager will continue far enough to see where the rotation occurs.”
paras.zh: 星际等离子体密度似乎也随着距离的增加而增加，并且一旦到达星际介质，在我们的宇宙邻域边界处看到的磁场方向并不会立即改变。 “我们不知道为什么会这样，”库尔斯说。 “我们希望航行者号能继续走得足够远，看看旋转发生的地方。”

paras.en: In the meantime, NASA is inviting people from all around the world to use flashlights pointed at the sky to send Morse code postcards back to Voyager 1 the way it has always done for us. Though the probe won’t actually be able to detect these messages, they’ll remind us that Voyager 1 may be long gone, but it is certainly not forgotten. “I think we all sort of think of Voyager as a bit of a friend because it’s been with us so long,” Fox says. “It’s, once again, at 49 years old, breaking another record, breaking another boundary, pushing us further into space as humanity.”
paras.zh: 与此同时，美国宇航局正在邀请世界各地的人们使用手电筒指向天空，将莫尔斯电码明信片寄回航行者一号，就像它一直为我们所做的那样。虽然探测器实际上无法检测到这些消息，但它们会提醒我们航海者一号可能早已消失，但它肯定不会被遗忘。 “我想我们都把 Voyager 视为朋友，因为它已经陪伴我们很久了，”福克斯说。 “在 49 岁的年纪，它再次打破了另一个记录，打破了另一个界限，将我们作为人类进一步推向太空。”

articles.title: Look up! The Leonid meteor shower peaks tonight

paras.en: The Leonid meteor shower will hit its peak on Monday night and into early Tuesday, when it will brighten the sky with fireballs and colorful shooting stars.
paras.zh: 狮子座流星雨将在周一晚上和周二早些时候达到顶峰，届时它将用火球和色彩缤纷的流星照亮天空。

paras.en: The Leonids come from Comet 55P/Tempel-Tuttle. When the Earth crosses through Tempel-Tuttle’s trail of debris each year, the leftover space rocks can enter our atmosphere and fall as bright and sometimes blue and green meteors.
paras.zh: 狮子座流星雨来自 55P/Tempel-Tuttle 彗星。每年，当地球穿过坦普尔-塔特尔的碎片轨迹时，剩余的太空岩石就会进入我们的大气层，并以明亮的、有时是蓝色和绿色的流星的形式落下。

paras.en: The height of this year’s show is expected to start around midnight tonight and to last until dawn, with around three meteors per hour in the darkest places. Stargazers on the East Coast are in luck this year because the shower will peak on a clear night—but with a nearly half-full moon, some of the fainter meteors may be difficult to spot.
paras.zh: 今年的表演预计将在今晚午夜左右开始，一直持续到黎明，在最黑暗的地方每小时大约有三颗流星。东海岸的观星者今年很幸运，因为流星雨将在晴朗的夜晚达到顶峰，但由于月亮接近半满月，一些较暗的流星可能很难被发现。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Though the shower will see relatively few meteors per hour, the Leonids can lead to especially great stargazing because of their tendency to produce fireballs. These larger pieces of comet debris are brilliant, and they are more vivid and last longer than a typical shooting star. The shower will also include Earth-grazing meteors, which shoot past the horizon and are often particularly vibrant. The Leonids are known for being some of the fastest meteors, at 44 miles per second. Blink, and you might miss them.
paras.zh: 虽然流星雨每小时看到的流星相对较少，但狮子座流星雨由于容易产生火球，因此可以带来特别好的观星体验。这些较大的彗星碎片非常明亮，而且比典型的流星更生动、持续时间更长。这场流星雨还将包括掠过地球的流星，它们会冲过地平线，而且通常特别活跃。狮子座流星雨因速度最快的流星之一而闻名，速度为每秒 44 英里。眨眼间，你可能会错过它们。

paras.en: Every so often, the Leonids’ parent comet, Tempel-Tuttle, produces so much debris that the shower becomes a meteor storm, marked by more than 1,000 meteors per hour. The last Leonid meteor storm was in 2002; the phenomenon tends to happen around every 33 years.
paras.zh: 狮子座流星雨的母彗星坦普尔-塔特尔经常会产生大量碎片，导致流星雨变成流星风暴，每小时有超过 1,000 颗流星。上次狮子座流星雨发生在 2002 年；这种现象大约每 33 年就会发生一次。

paras.en: NASA advises sky-gazers to wear lots of layers, bring a sleeping bag and lie down on the ground with their feet pointed to the east for the best viewing experience. After around 30 minutes, when your eyes adjust, you can catch the bright streaks across the night sky from midnight until dawn.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局建议观星者多穿几层衣服，带上睡袋，躺在地上，双脚指向东方，以获得最佳的观看体验。大约 30 分钟后，当您的眼睛适应时，您可以看到从午夜到黎明划过夜空的明亮条纹。

articles.title: Neanderthal DNA linked to lower risk of schizophrenia in modern humans

paras.en: Billions of people alive today carry a trace amount of Neanderthal DNA—the evolutionary legacy of interbreeding between these ancient human relatives and our species, Homo sapiens, tens of thousands of years ago. These genes have been linked to all sorts of health outcomes in modern humans, including changes in muscle mass, immune system function and even risk of dying from COVID.
paras.zh: 今天活着的数十亿人都携带着微量的尼安德特人 DNA，这是数万年前这些远古人类亲戚与我们人类智人杂交的进化遗产。这些基因与现代人类的各种健康结果有关，包括肌肉质量的变化、免疫系统功能，甚至死于新冠病毒的风险。

paras.en: Now researchers have identified a specific segment of Neanderthal DNA that helps shape the modern human brain and is associated with a lower risk of schizophrenia.
paras.zh: 现在，研究人员已经确定了尼安德特人 DNA 的一个特定片段，它有助于塑造现代人类的大脑，并且与较低的精神分裂症风险相关。

paras.en: In a new study published in Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences USA, researchers show that this DNA segment correlates with a nearly 10 percent lower risk of developing schizophrenia in people with two copies of the variant, as well as a small reduction in the size of the occipital lobe—a brain region involved in visual processing.
paras.zh: 在《美国国家科学院院刊》上发表的一项新研究中，研究人员表明，这种 DNA 片段与携带两个该变异拷贝的人患精神分裂症的风险降低近 10% 相关，并且与枕叶（参与视觉处理的大脑区域）尺寸小幅缩小相关。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Based on data from the UK Biobank, people carrying the Neanderthal genetic variant saw a decrease in occipital lobe size of about 0.85 cubic centimeter per copy—or a decrease of 1.7 cubic centimeters in those with two copies, one from each parent—the study found.
paras.zh: 研究发现，根据英国生物银行的数据，携带尼安德特人基因变异的人的枕叶大小每份减少约 0.85 立方厘米，而携带两份（父母各一份）的人枕叶大小减少 1.7 立方厘米。

paras.en: “I find it fascinating that a genetic variant inherited from Neandertals is associated with differences in brain anatomy in people today, particularly reduced occipital lobe volume,” says Nadav Ahituv, director of the Institute for Human Genetics at the University of California, San Francisco. Ahituv reviewed the study for PNAS but was not directly involved in the research.
paras.zh: 旧金山加利福尼亚大学人类遗传学研究所所长纳达夫·阿希图夫 (Nadav Ahituv) 表示：“令人着迷的是，从尼安德特人遗传的基因变异与现代人大脑解剖结构的差异有关，尤其是枕叶体积的缩小。” Ahituv 为 PNAS 审阅了该研究，但并未直接参与该研究。

paras.en: Researchers believe that most Neanderthal DNA carried by humans today stems from a large interbreeding event that occurred around 47,000 years ago, explains study co-author Svante Pääbo. He is a director at the Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Anthropology in Leipzig, Germany, and won the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine in 2022. “If you look at the [Neanderthal] contributions that exist in people today, it really seems to come from what looks like one event,” Pääbo explains.
paras.zh: 研究合著者 Svante Pääbo 解释说，研究人员认为，当今人类携带的大多数尼安德特人 DNA 源于大约 47,000 年前发生的一次大型杂交事件。他是德国莱比锡马克斯·普朗克进化人类学研究所的所长，并于 2022 年获得了诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。“如果你看看当今人类中存在的[尼安德特人]的贡献，你会发现它确实似乎来自于一个事件，”Pääbo 解释道。

paras.en: Skull fossils suggest that Neanderthals had a larger occipital lobe than H. sapiens, along with a more elongated brain case. So it’s unclear why humans carrying Neanderthal DNA have smaller occipital lobes today.
paras.zh: 头骨化石表明，尼安德特人的枕叶比智人更大，脑壳也更长。因此，目前还不清楚为什么携带尼安德特人 DNA 的人类如今的枕叶较小。

paras.en: One clue might be the DNA segment’s placement—it turns up near a gene called DAAM1, which plays a role in early brain development, says study co-author Hugo Zeberg, an evolutionary geneticist at the Karolinska Institute in Sweden. But exactly how DAAM1 interacts with the newly described segment of Neanderthal DNA is unclear.
paras.zh: 研究合著者、瑞典卡罗林斯卡研究所的进化遗传学家 Hugo Zeberg 表示，一条线索可能是 DNA 片段的位置——它出现在一个名为 DAAM1 的基因附近，该基因在早期大脑发育中发挥着作用。但 DAAM1 究竟如何与新描述的尼安德特人 DNA 片段相互作用尚不清楚。

paras.en: The variant was also not linked to any other psychiatric conditions, including depression, bipolar disorder or attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), and was not associated with intelligence, the researchers found.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，这种变异也与任何其他精神疾病无关，包括抑郁症、双相情感障碍或注意力缺陷多动障碍（ADHD），并且与智力无关。

paras.en: Zeberg and Pääbo plan to continue sifting through the genome for other consequential pieces of Neanderthal DNA. More discoveries are coming, Zeberg says: “You might hear from us again.”
paras.zh: Zeberg 和 Pääbo 计划继续在基因组中筛选尼安德特人 DNA 的其他重要片段。更多的发现即将到来，泽伯格说：“你可能会再次收到我们的消息。”

articles.title: Most transgender youth satisfied after choosing hormone therapy
articles.author: Aimee Cunningham

paras.en: An overwhelming percentage of transgender and gender diverse young people in the United States express satisfaction with gender-affirming hormone therapy.
paras.zh: 在美国，绝大多数跨性别和性别多样化的年轻人对性别肯定激素疗法表示满意。

paras.en: Almost 400 transgender and gender diverse young people reflected on their decision to take hormone therapy in the largest such survey to date. Nearly 97 percent affirmed it was the right decision, researchers report November 9 in JAMA Pediatrics. Only about 3 percent, or 10 individuals, said they regretted the step, and of those, seven felt the experience was harmful.
paras.zh: 在迄今为止最大规模的此类调查中，近 400 名跨性别和性别多样化的年轻人反思了他们接受激素治疗的决定。研究人员 11 月 9 日在《美国医学会儿科杂志》上报告称，近 97% 的人确认这是正确的决定。只有大约 3%（即 10 人）表示他们对这一步骤感到后悔，其中 7 人认为这种经历是有害的。

paras.en: With concerns around youth well-being fueling limits on gender-affirming hormone therapy, the researchers write, “the results provide further support for the existing standards of care [and] do not support efforts to categorically restrict or ban access.”
paras.zh: 研究人员写道，由于对青少年福祉的担忧加剧了对性别肯定激素疗法的限制，“研究结果为现有的护理标准提供了进一步的支持，[并且]不支持明确限制或禁止使用的努力。”

paras.en: Gender-affirming hormone therapy — with the masculinizing hormone testosterone or the feminizing hormone estrogen — allows a person’s body to better match their gender identity. Around 3 percent of 13- to 17-year-olds in the United States identify as transgender.
paras.zh: Gender-affirming hormone therapy — with the masculinizing hormone testosterone or the feminizing hormone estrogen — allows a person’s body to better match their gender identity.在美国，大约 3% 的 13 至 17 岁青少年认为自己是跨性别者。

paras.en: Among the study’s 376 young people, who were former patients of a clinic for transgender and gender diverse youth, nearly 92 percent began hormones at 17 or younger. Thirty percent took estrogen and 70 percent took testosterone, with the amount of time since starting the hormones averaging five years.
paras.zh: 在该研究的 376 名年轻人中，近 92% 的人在 17 岁或更年轻时开始服用激素，这些人曾是跨性别和性别多元化青少年诊所的患者。 30% 的人服用雌激素，70% 的人服用睾酮，距离开始使用激素的时间平均为五年。

paras.en: As per clinical guidelines for transgender health care, young people interested in medical treatment, joined by parents or guardians, began with an assessment visit with a mental health professional. For the study, participants took a yearly survey, filled out anytime from one month prior to six months following the anniversary of this initial visit. The research team analyzed surveys submitted from 2023 to 2025.
paras.zh: 根据跨性别医疗保健的临床指南，对医疗感兴趣的年轻人在父母或监护人的陪同下，首先接受心理健康专业人士的评估访问。在这项研究中，参与者每年进行一次调查，并在首次访问周年纪念日后六个月内的任何时间填写。研究团队分析了 2023 年至 2025 年提交的调查。

paras.en: The new research adds to growing evidence on the benefits of gender-affirming hormone therapy for transgender young people. Gender-affirming hormones improve the alignment these young people experience between their appearance and their gender, increase their satisfaction with life and reduce depression and anxiety.
paras.zh: 这项新研究进一步证明了性别肯定激素疗法对跨性别年轻人的益处。性别肯定荷尔蒙可以改善这些年轻人的外表和性别之间的一致性，提高他们对生活的满意度，并减少抑郁和焦虑。

paras.en: But state bans have curtailed young people’s access to gender-affirming care, which can include hormone therapy and puberty blockers. As of November 2026 in the United States, 28 states have laws or policies that limit this care, according to the health policy organization KFF. More than half of transgender young people age 13 to 17 reside in states that restrict gender-affirming care. The American Academy of Pediatrics and the Endocrine Society support gender-affirming health care for young people and provide evidence-backed guidelines for treatment.
paras.zh: 但各州的禁令限制了年轻人获得性别肯定护理的机会，其中包括激素疗法和青春期阻滞剂。据健康政策组织 KFF 称，截至 2026 年 11 月，美国有 28 个州制定了限制这种护理的法律或政策。超过一半的 13 至 17 岁跨性别年轻人居住在限制性别肯定护理的州。美国儿科学会和内分泌学会支持对年轻人进行性别肯定的医疗保健，并提供有证据支持的治疗指南。

articles.title: We know how to stop computer worms. But what if AI helps them persist?
articles.author: Kathryn Hulick

paras.en: AI is already powering new, more adaptable forms of cyberattack, but hackers typically wield the technology from afar. What if they set the AI models themselves loose to self-replicate and spread in a malicious manner?
paras.zh: 人工智能已经为新的、适应性更强的网络攻击形式提供了动力，但黑客通常会远程利用该技术。如果他们让人工智能模型自行自我复制并以恶意方式传播怎么办？

paras.en: Recent experiments have demonstrated two different ways this could happen. Two independent teams showed how a cyberattacker could turn an AI model into a “worm,” a type of malware that, unlike a computer virus, spreads on its own. And AI unlocked a new worm power: adapting attacks to different devices.
paras.zh: 最近的实验证明了这种情况可以通过两种不同的方式发生。两个独立团队展示了网络攻击者如何将人工智能模型变成“蠕虫”，这是一种恶意软件，与计算机病毒不同，它会自行传播。人工智能解锁了蠕虫病毒的新能力：使攻击适应不同的设备。

paras.en: The results hint at a new way AI could be used to ramp up cybersecurity threats — not just to computer systems but to smart devices such as security cameras or refrigerators. The good news is that the world still has time to build up defenses as several obstacles remain before this type of malware would work in the real world, says AI researcher Jonas Guan.
paras.zh: 研究结果暗示了人工智能可以用于增强网络安全威胁的新方式——不仅针对计算机系统，还针对安全摄像头或冰箱等智能设备。人工智能研究员 Jonasguan 表示，好消息是，世界仍然有时间建立防御措施，因为此类恶意软件在现实世界中发挥作用还存在一些障碍。
