articles.title: 49ers offense puts up over 580 yards against a bad Cowboys defense behind a Christian McCaffrey masterclass

paras.en: If there's a sole team above the rest in the NFL, it's the San Francisco 49ers.
San Francisco improved to 8-1 on Sunday with a 46-40 win at AT&T Stadium, piling up 584 total yards as red jerseys outnumbered and out-yelled home fans.
It was a close battle until the third quarter when a pair of electric Niners rushing touchdowns stuffed the Cowboys in a deep hole.

Rookie Kaelon Black sparked the surge on the opening drive of the second half, lowering his shoulder to bulldoze two Cowboys defenders, including first-round pick Caleb Downs and cornerback Cobie Durant, on his way to a 25-yard scamper.
Moments later, the seasoned second-term Niners star, Deebo Samuel Sr., stuck the dagger in Dallas on a 70-yard reverse, taking a pitch from Black.

On Sunday, San Francisco piled on 214 rushing yards: Black finished with 53 yards on 11 carries, while Samuel totaled 78 rushing yards on three carries in his first game back since Oct. 11, alongside an 11-yard touchdown catch.
Christian McCaffrey added three touchdowns of his own, including 74- and 66-yard catch-and-runs, as the 49ers averaged more than 9 yards a play.
"Totally unacceptable defense," Cowboys head coach Brian Schottenheimer said after the loss.

San Francisco's offensive clinic ruined a gutsy outing from Dak Prescott, who did everything possible to keep Dallas alive. Prescott threw for 343 yards and five touchdowns, hitting George Pickens three times in the end zone.

But Prescott's best efforts couldn't survive the defensive disaster led by first-year coordinator Christian Parker, who looked completely out of his depth as Kyle Shanahan picked Dallas apart for the most home yards allowed in franchise history.
Send us your thoughts: alejandro.avila@outkick.com / Follow along on X: @alejandroaveela

articles.title: 49ers fans involved in second consecutive week of fighting after Cowboys game at AT&T Stadium

paras.en: San Francisco 49ers fans were very present at AT&T Stadium on Sunday as they faced the Dallas Cowboys– two heated rivals in the NFL.

That rivalry spilled over in a very bad way with a massive brawl taking place at Texas Live, a large entertainment complex just outside the stadium between supporters of both fan bases after the 49ers’ 46-40 win in Week 10.
Police had to get involved to break things up, and likely book some people into the local jail as video from Dallas Texas TV social media accounts showcased the brutal altercation.
The video began with two police officers subduing one fan on the ground, though a fight continued to occur next to them.

A 49ers fan was seen tossing punches at a Cowboys fan, who was clearly fighting back. Some others around the incident were trying to break it up, but a quick camera pan showed another fight seemingly being de-escalated by a Cowboys fan restraining a 49ers fan who had been fighting.

Then, as police were escorting a fan away from the tense scene, another skirmish broke out. There were two women, one wearing a 49ers jacket and the other in Cowboys gear, were in each other’s faces as shoving seemed to be going on.

While it’s unclear what exactly caused the brawls to take place, 49ers fans have not been helping their reputation after what happened last week as they played another rival, the Las Vegas Raiders, at home in Santa Clara.
A massive parking lot brawl broke out last weekend between 49ers and Raiders fans, with one video going viral after fans were knocked out while throwing punches.
Nearly a dozen people were arrested and 45 were ejected from Levi’s Stadium for fighting, Santa Clara police told SF Gate.

"Incidents of violence at large-scale events in Santa Clara will not be tolerated," Santa Clara Police Department spokesperson Lt. Eric Lagergren told the outlet. "The Department strictly enforces the law and holds individuals accountable for criminal conduct. We will seek to arrest the individuals responsible for the fan-on-fan violence at the event."
Seven of the 11 people who were arrested were cited for disorderly conduct. Four were arrested for allegedly fighting in a public place and at least one received a drug possession charge.

It’s unknown how many arrests and ejections there may have been at AT&T Stadium, but these teams and fan bases certainly do not like each other and that is very apparent each time they match up during an NFL season.
Fox News’ Ryan Gaydos contributed to this report.

articles.title: Aaron Rodgers, Steelers totally tank in primetime as Cincinnati Bengals roll to 38-18 Scorigami win

paras.en: The Bengals beat the brakes off Pittsburgh 38-18 on Sunday night to grab first place in the AFC North.

And in over 100 years of NFL history, no game had ever ended with that exact score (i.e., Scorigami!). That gave the NFL two Scorigamis on the same day after San Francisco's 46-40 win over the Cowboys earlier in the afternoon.
Heading into Sunday night, the Bengals and Steelers both sat at 6-2 on four-game winning streaks, with Pittsburgh holding the division tiebreaker from Week 3.
Even with an entire bye week to prepare against a Bengals team flying back from Madrid, Pittsburgh had zero answers in stopping Joe Burrow and the Cincy offense.
Cincinnati built a 24-3 halftime lead, pushed it to 31-3, and didn't punt until the final minute of the third quarter.

Things got so lopsided that Cincinnati pulled Joe Burrow with seven minutes left in the fourth for 41-year-old backup Joe Flacco, while Pittsburgh needed two garbage-time touchdowns from DK Metcalf and Pat Freiermuth just to dress up the scoreboard and produce the first 38-18 final score in NFL history.

Sunday also proved how hollow Pittsburgh's 6-2 start really was. Aaron Rodgers and the Pittsburgh offense couldn't even move the chains until the second quarter. Rodgers didn't survive until the final whistle as Mason Rudolph stepped in to relieve the 42-year-old future Hall of Famer.
Cincinnati showed what a 6-2 contender with legit Super Bowl upside plays like.
Burrow carved up Pittsburgh's defense for 409 yards and four touchdowns, while Ja'Marr Chase hauled in 11 passes for 231 yards, outgaining Pittsburgh's entire offense all by himself.
On the other side of the ball, Dexter Lawrence kept building his Defensive Player of the Year case, anchoring a front that flat-out suffocated Pittsburgh's run game.
Three weeks ago, Cincinnati went into Baltimore and embarrassed the Ravens.
Sunday night, the Bengals did the exact same thing to Pittsburgh, proving the AFC North runs through Cincinnati.
Even Sopranos star Steven Van Zandt, famous for playing consigliere Silvio Dante, had seen enough of Mike McCarthy's squad, firing off a reaction:

"The Steelers are embarrassing themselves. I never liked this coach. I thought he was terrible in Dallas. I couldn't believe they hired him in Pittsburgh. There's two ways to prove you're a good team. Come out with a good scheme. Or adjust it when necessary. Let's see if they adjust it for the second half. If they don't, some mamajama needs to be fired."
Send us your thoughts: alejandro.avila@outkick.com / Follow along on X: @alejandroaveela

articles.title: Canada could work with Chinese automakers if US trade talks fail, says Carney
articles.author: Associated Press

paras.en: The prime minister of Canada, Mark Carney, said the country could turn to Chinese automakers if trade negotiations with the US president, Donald Trump, failed to preserve an integrated North American auto industry.

Carney’s comments in Cambodia on Monday came ahead of a planned meeting with Chinese leader Xi Jinping this week in Shenzhen, China, where auto manufacturing is expected to be discussed. The two leaders reached an agreement in January allowing tens of thousands of Chinese electric vehicles into Canada at reduced tariffs.

“We have the best auto workers in the world, and we want them fully deployed, full opportunity, in an integrated North American market,” Carney told reporters in Cambodia. “That market has become less integrated because of US trade actions.”

He said on Monday that negotiations with the US remained his priority, but their outcome could determine whether Canada pursues alternatives involving European, Chinese or Japanese automakers. A day earlier in Manila, in the Philippines, Carney said any trade agreement with Washington must leave Canada with a viable auto industry.
Asked whether potential Chinese investment was leverage in US negotiations, Carney replied: “It’s not leverage. But action, reaction.
“If they [Canada’s auto workers] are not fully utilized in a North American context, that provides other opportunities,” Carney said. “Canada is going to move forward either way.”

The Detroit Three – Ford, General Motors and Stellantis – operate factories across Canada, the US and Mexico, with parts sometimes crossing borders multiple times before a vehicle is completed. Trump has repeatedly pushed automakers to move production to the US from Canada.

Carney said any Chinese investment would have to involve substantial manufacturing in Canada rather than simply assembling imported parts. He said it would need proper labor standards, manufacturing facilities and domestic supply chains that expand over time, including Canadian critical minerals used in electric vehicles.
“It’s not just about kit cars,” he said. “There has to be a manufacturing aspect involved.”

Under a January agreement, Canada reduced its 100% tariff on Chinese electric vehicles to 6.1%, initially allowing up to 49,000 vehicles annually, with the cap increasing over time. In exchange, China agreed to lower tariffs on Canadian agricultural products, including canola.
Carney said at the time that he expected the agreement to attract Chinese investment in Canada’s auto industry and create jobs.

The deal drew criticism from Ontario premier Doug Ford, whose province is the center of Canada’s auto industry. Ford warned that allowing Chinese electric vehicles into Canada could threaten Canadian jobs and jeopardize access to the US market.

Trump’s tariffs have disrupted Canada’s auto industry, which relies heavily on cross-border production. Canada recently threatened to sue Stellantis after the automaker shifted planned Jeep Compass production from Brampton, Ontario, to Illinois and agreed to sell its idled Canadian assembly plant.
Carney said Saturday that he had spoken at length with Trump and senior US officials and that the two countries were making progress toward a possible trade agreement, although differences remained.

articles.title: MP Helen Haines’s first words since leaving hospital after alleged attack led to double amputation
articles.author: Krishani Dhanji

paras.en: The independent Australian MP Helen Haines has been discharged from hospital, four weeks after she was allegedly attacked by a man outside her electorate office in Victoria resulting in the amputation of both her legs.
In a statement, Haines said she had moved to the rehabilitation stage of her recovery, which would continue in Melbourne.
“This is a really positive moment, and I am full of gratitude for the expert and compassionate care I received at the Alfred [hospital] and am receiving in this next stage,” Haines said.

“I appreciate the thousands of warm wishes and supportive messages from people across Indi, throughout Australia and around the world. They are giving me strength as I focus on this next phase of healing.”
The prime minister, Anthony Albanese, said his thoughts were with Haines.
“We continue to provide support to Helen, her family, community and staff as she undertakes her rehabilitation,” Albanese said in a statement.
Haines said she was “overwhelmed” by the many Australians who had donated to the Save the Children charity fundraiser.
Her husband, Phil Haines, had made the request to the public on her behalf to donate to the charity in lieu of flowers in the aftermath of the alleged attack.
As of Monday afternoon, more than $1.46m had been raised for the charity through Haines’s fundraising appeal.

“I am overwhelmed by the generosity of Australians in the form of donations to Save the Children and I look forward to working with them in due course on applying these funds to improve the lives of children.”

Haines, the federal member for the Victorian seat of Indi, had been in a critical but stable condition after she was repeatedly struck by a vehicle in Wangaratta on 19 October. Her condition was then downgraded to “serious but stable” on 24 October.
Police will allege the 65-year-old was standing by the boot of her car outside her electoral office when a car did a U-turn and struck her repeatedly.
Tarrawingee man Brendan Nugent, 43, has been charged and the incident continues to be investigated. He is known to her family.
Police charged Nugent with dangerous driving causing serious injury, intentionally cause serious injury and the commonwealth offence of causing harm to a commonwealth public official.
Police have also charged him with two additional offences – cultivating and possessing cannabis – according to court documents.
The foreign affairs minister, Penny Wong, paid tribute to Haines in the Senate on Monday and on behalf of the parliament wished her strength through her challenging rehabilitation.

“It says a great deal about her character that even as she faces these challenges, in her statement she looks ahead to the work she wants to do to improve the lives of children following the donations to Save the Children that Australians made at her request. It is an example of her determination and her generosity that is so admired,” Wong said.
The leader of the opposition in the Senate, Michaelia Cash, added that Haines’s discharge from hospital was warmly welcomed across the parliament.
“She has demonstrated extraordinary courage and resilience. And on behalf, in particular, of my Coalition Senate colleagues, we wish Helen every strength during her continued recovery.”
Haines has been given leave of absence until 26 November, the last sitting day of the year.
MPs across parliament have expressed concern for their safety and that of their staff since the alleged attack, and prompted conversations about the temperature of political debate.
Albanese, during the last parliamentary sitting, warned against the rise in anger “that distorts and corrodes our public discourse”, and urged voters and politicians not to ignore it.

“Enabled by the anonymity and speed afforded by social media, we are seeing rage and aggression increasing, not just in politics, but towards workers in hospitality and retail, in schools and in hospitals, towards police, paramedics, and other officials, we are seeing a normalisation of the language of grievance and violence.”
The independent MP Allegra Spender said it was “wonderful” news that Haines was making good progress in her recovery.
“She is a remarkable person and her strength and positivity after everything that has happened inspires me.”

articles.title: Monday briefing: The many stages of the UK-EU relationship – and what’s next
articles.author: Libby Brooks

paras.en: Good morning. Ahead of the hotly anticipated UK-EU summit this Friday, Andy Burnham is expected to make the reset of our relationship with Europe the pivotal theme of his white-tie speech at the lord mayor’s banquet in London tonight.
paras.zh: 早上好。在备受瞩目的英欧峰会将于本周五召开之际，安迪·伯纳姆（Andy Burnham）预计将在今晚于伦敦举行的市长晚宴上发表正式晚宴演讲，将重塑我们与欧洲的关系作为核心主题。

paras.en: The prospect of closer ties – and the possibility of going “all the way” to reversing Brexit – has been met with jubilation and relief in some quarters and vehement opposition in others, while around Westminster and across the media the psychodrama has been spiralling for weeks.
paras.zh: 一些人对加强联系的前景——以及“彻底”扭转英国脱欧局面的可能性——欢欣鼓舞、如释重负，另一些人则强烈反对。与此同时，在威斯敏斯特议会和各大媒体，这场心理剧已持续数周，愈演愈烈。

paras.en: At this point, I’m reminded of that Robert Burns couplet: “O wad some Pow’r the giftie gie us / To see oursels as ithers see us!” What does the EU think about all this? Are they ready to reverse what leading figures have repeatedly described as a colossal act of self-harm? Or are they viewing this latest iteration with bombastic side-eye? I posed these questions to Jennifer Rankin, the Guardian’s Brussels correspondent. First the headlines.
paras.zh: 此时此刻，我想起了罗伯特·彭斯的这首双行诗：“但愿有神力赐予我们/让我们像别人那样看待自己！” 欧盟对此有何看法？他们是否准备好扭转主要人物一再形容为“巨大的自我伤害行为”的局面？还是说，他们正用夸张的斜眼看待这一最新动向？我向《卫报》的布鲁塞尔记者詹妮弗·兰金（Jennifer Rankin）提出了这些问题。首先是头条新闻。

paras.en: - UK news | A woman who alleges she was raped by Russell Brand when she was 16 has waived her right to anonymity to campaign for a staggered age of consent, which would make it illegal for adults over a certain age to have sex with 16- and 17-year-olds.
paras.zh: - 英国新闻 | 一名女子声称自己在16岁时被罗素·布兰德（Russell Brand）强奸，她放弃了匿名权，以倡导实行分级性行为同意年龄，这将使超过一定年龄的成年人与16岁和17岁的未成年人性交成为非法行为。

paras.en: - Youth unemployment | Andy Burnham has pledged to intervene as early as childhood to tackle youth unemployment before a watershed review, promising “a root-and-branch rethink of how we support childhood in the modern world”.
paras.zh: - 青年失业 | Andy Burnham承诺在进行分水岭式审查之前，尽早从童年阶段开始干预，以解决青年失业问题，并承诺“从根本上重新思考我们在现代社会中如何为儿童提供支持”。

paras.en: - Environment | The strongest El Niño in centuries has added urgency to UN climate talks in Turkey as vulnerable countries face “compounding” crises. In other Cop31 news, queer and gay protesters defied a crackdown on LGBTQ+ rights in Turkey to lead a civil society climate march.
paras.zh: - 环境 | 几个世纪以来最强烈的厄尔尼诺现象加剧了土耳其联合国气候谈判的紧迫性，因为脆弱国家正面临“叠加”危机。在其他COP31新闻中，酷儿和同性恋抗议者无视土耳其对LGBTQ+权利的打压，领导了一场民间社会气候游行。

paras.en: - UK news | Two people aged 22 and 23 have died after their car was hit by a BMW being pursued by police. West Yorkshire police said four people had been arrested and appealed for witnesses to come forward.
paras.zh: - 英国新闻 | 两名年龄分别为22岁和23岁的人在他们的汽车被一辆正被警方追捕的宝马车撞击后死亡。西约克郡警方表示，已有四人被捕，并呼吁目击者出面作证。

paras.en: - Air transport | The Trump administration says Friday’s four-hour nationwide Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) ground stop that delayed or cancelled thousands of flight stemmed from routine maintenance. The US transportation secretary, Sean Duffy, blamed prior presidents and Congress for the stoppage.
paras.zh: - 空运 | 特朗普政府表示，周五美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）下令的全国范围四小时停飞导致数千架航班延误或取消，原因是例行维护。美国交通部长肖恩·达菲将这次停飞归咎于前几任总统和国会。

paras.en: In depth: ‘This is a real priority for the EU, in almost emotional terms’
paras.zh: 深度报道：“这对欧盟来说是一个真正的优先事项，几乎可以用情感来形容”

paras.en: Ahead of the summit, the pro-Brexit polity has been in broadcast mode: headlines from the past few days include: “Burnham’s plot to rejoin the EU would leave the average UK household £6,500 poorer” (Express); “Taxpayers funding pro-EU university courses” (Sunday Telegraph); “Staggering cost of PM’s EU reset” (Daily Mail).
paras.zh: 在峰会召开之前，支持脱欧的政治派别一直在大肆宣传：过去几天的头条新闻包括：“伯纳姆（Burnham）重返欧盟的阴谋将使英国普通家庭的收入减少6,500英镑”（《每日快报》）；“纳税人资助亲欧盟的大学课程”（《星期日电讯报》）；“首相重置欧盟关系的惊人代价”（《每日邮报》）。

paras.en: Stay Out, a new campaign against rejoining the European Union, launched last week. While the guy you really want to hear from right now – David Cameron, the prime minister who lost the 2016 Brexit referendum – has insisted the UK’s problems have nothing to do with its exit from the EU.
paras.zh: 上周，一场名为“Stay Out”（退出欧盟）的新运动发起，旨在反对英国重新加入欧盟。与此同时，你们现在最想听取意见的人——在2016年英国脱欧公投中失利的首相大卫·卡梅伦——却坚持认为英国的问题与脱离欧盟毫无关系。

paras.en: Even within the Labour fold, there are rumblings of unease from MPs and unions.
paras.zh: 即使在工党内部，议员和工会也传出不满的声音。

paras.en: But the one-day summit in Brussels this Friday does not include any formal discussion of rejoining: instead, the EU and UK hope to sign deals on food and drink, emissions trading and the youth experience scheme (a work and study exchange programme).
paras.zh: 但本周五在布鲁塞尔举行的为期一天的峰会并不包括任何关于重新加入的正式讨论。相反，欧盟和英国希望就食品和饮料、排放权交易以及青年交流计划（一项工作和学习交流计划）签署协议。

paras.en: Still, the mood music is upbeat. Back in September, when Burnham first opened the door to a Brexit reversal, French president Emmanual Macron responded: “welcome back.” while Spanish prime minister Pedro Sánchez said: “Spain would welcome Britain’s return with open arms.”
paras.zh: 不过，整体气氛仍然乐观。早在9月份，当伯纳姆首次为逆转脱欧敞开大门时，法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙回应道：“欢迎回来。”而西班牙首相佩德罗·桑切斯则表示：“西班牙将敞开双臂欢迎英国的回归。”

paras.en: The enthusiasm is genuine, says Jennifer. Indeed, some European diplomats have told her the technicalities could be wrapped up within a year because the UK remains closely aligned with the bloc in so many areas. “It would be such a vote of confidence in the European project for a country to decide to return after voting to leave”.
paras.zh: Jennifer表示，这种热情是真诚的。事实上，一些欧洲外交官曾告诉她，技术细节问题可以在一年内解决，因为英国在许多领域仍然与欧盟保持密切一致。“如果一个国家在投票决定离开后又决定回归，这将是对欧洲一体化事业的极大信任。”

paras.en: Situationship: what’s at stake at this week’s summit?
paras.zh: 情境关系：本周峰会的利害关系是什么？

paras.en: Though Burnham has predicted “some long nights” of negotiation this week, Jennifer says there’s optimism on each side as the first two deals on food and drink and emissions trading were largely agreed.
paras.zh: 尽管伯纳姆预测本周的谈判将经历“漫长的夜晚”，但詹妮弗表示，由于前两项关于食品饮料和排放交易的协议已基本达成，双方都抱有乐观态度。

paras.en: There are two sticking points with the youth exchange deal. First, the Home Office wants to limit numbers to the UK to keep migration figures low. Second, there’s disagreement over whether those students would pay UK domestic rates of tuition fees or the international rate, which is four or five times higher for some courses.
paras.zh: 青年交流协议有两个棘手的问题。首先，内政部希望限制前往英国的人数，以保持较低的移民数字。其次，对于这些学生应缴纳英国国内学费还是国际学费，存在分歧，对于某些课程而言，国际学费是国内学费的四到五倍。

paras.en: The UK is offering concessions on tuition fees if it can join Made in Europe, the EU legislation designed to protect domestic manufacturing from cheap Chinese competition. But the EU says it can’t make a deal on Made in Europe this week, because the law is still at a draft stage.
paras.zh: 如果英国能够加入旨在保护欧盟本土制造业免受廉价中国产品竞争的欧盟立法“欧洲制造”（Made in Europe），英国将对学费做出让步。但欧盟表示，本周无法就“欧洲制造”达成协议，因为该法律仍处于草案阶段。

paras.en: And here’s where it gets complicated. The European Commission has proposed delaying an agreement on tuition fees for six months, which could allow time to get the UK into Made in Europe, a diplomatic win for Britain. But there’s pushback from member states who want to pin down the UK on tuition fees this week. “This is a real priority for the EU, in almost emotional terms,” Jennifer says. “Lots of EU officials and diplomats studied in the UK, or their children did, and they felt this was one of the big losses of Brexit, that these person-to-person links were being eroded.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: On-again, off-again: what else could get in the way of closer working?
paras.zh: 时好时坏：还有什么因素会妨碍更紧密的合作？

paras.en: In play at Friday’s summit will also be a future deal on Britain’s return to the EU’s internal electricity market and a joint migration pact, with the UK pushing for access to EU crime databases to tackle the small boats crisis.
paras.zh: 周五的峰会上还将讨论英国重返欧盟内部电力市场的未来协议以及一项联合移民协议，英国正在推动获得欧盟犯罪数据库的访问权限，以应对小型船只危机。

paras.en: Member states are already working hard to smooth things out on the electricity front, to stop it becoming a sticking point. A couple of weeks ago, Jennifer reported on leaders from Germany, Denmark and elsewhere calling for deeper cooperation on clean energy – which she reads as an attempt to head off a row about how much the UK should contribute to EU cohesion funds for the evident privilege of cutting red tape, easing trade and, ultimately, reducing costs.
paras.zh: 各成员国已经在电力方面努力协调，以防止其成为一个棘手问题。几周前，Jennifer报道了德国、丹麦和其他国家的领导人呼吁在清洁能源方面开展更深入的合作——在她看来，这是一种试图避免争端的举措，争端涉及英国应为欧盟凝聚基金贡献多少资金，以换取削减官僚主义、简化贸易手续以及最终降低成本的明显特权。

paras.en: A similar row over UK contributions scuppered negotiations last year on our entry into a €150bn EU defence fund.
paras.zh: 去年，围绕英国缴款的类似争论导致我们加入 1500 亿欧元欧盟国防基金的谈判破裂。

paras.en: It could also be a challenge for the UK to realign with the EU on farming, after changing to a payment model that puts more emphasis on delivering environmental benefits. And past UK governments have been lukewarm about EU AI regulation, devised post Brexit.
paras.zh: 在改用更重视提供环境效益的支付模式后，英国在农业方面与欧盟重新接轨也可能是一项挑战。此外，英国历届政府对英国脱欧后制定的欧盟人工智能监管持不冷不热的态度。

paras.en: Conscious partnership: will the EU welcome future closeness this week?
paras.zh: 有意识的伙伴关系：欧盟本周是否会欢迎未来的紧密关系？

paras.en: I learned long ago there’s no such thing as a stupid question, so I ask mine now: will there be a moment on Friday when Ursula von der Leyen offers the equivalent of Macron’s “welcome back”? Will there be a “just give us six months to sort out the paperwork Andy” vibe?
paras.zh: 我很久以前就知道，世上没有愚蠢的问题，所以我现在要问的是：周五是否会有这样一个时刻，乌尔苏拉·冯·德·莱恩会说出与马克龙的“欢迎回来”相对应的话？是否会有“安迪，只要给我们六个月时间来处理文书工作”的氛围？

paras.en: The European Commission president is, by nature, a cautious politician, Jennifer tells me, so she doesn’t expect anything so specific. “I’m sure she – and António Costa, the European Council president – will get asked about it at the press conference, and they’ll want to send a signal about the UK being welcome to rejoin.”
paras.zh: 詹妮弗告诉我，欧盟委员会主席天生就是一个谨慎的政治家，因此她并不期望有任何具体的内容。“我敢肯定，她和欧洲理事会主席安东尼奥·科斯塔（António Costa）在新闻发布会上会被问到这个问题，他们会希望发出一个信号，表示欢迎英国重新加入。”

paras.en: But behind closed doors, in Brussels and other capitals, what Jennifer hears repeatedly is that it’s up to the UK to decide what it wants. And, while the prospect of Brexiteer Nigel Farage in Downing Street has faded in recent months, there remains a deal of caution about the vicissitudes of UK politics. “Now the Burnham government is exploring the options, but there’s also an awareness that you could have a very different government in a few years’ time,” she says.
paras.zh: 但在布鲁塞尔和其他国家的首都，Jennifer 在私下里反复听到的说法是，英国想要什么，由英国自己决定。尽管脱欧派人士奈杰尔·法拉奇（Nigel Farage）入主唐宁街的前景在近几个月已然黯淡，但人们对英国政坛的变幻莫测仍持谨慎态度。“现在，伯纳姆政府正在探索各种方案，但人们也意识到，几年后可能会出现一个截然不同的政府。”她说。

paras.en: It’s not you, it’s me: what else is Europe worrying about?
paras.zh: 不是你，是我：欧洲还在担心什么？

paras.en: The EU and its member states are preoccupied with far weightier problems: the war in Ukraine (Volodymyr Zelenskyy attends every EU summit), the rise in support for the far right, street protests, hybrid threats from Russia, a trade deficit with China that has reached a staggering €1bn a day in 2026.
paras.zh: 欧盟及其成员国正忙于应对更为严峻的问题：乌克兰战争（弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基出席了每次欧盟峰会）、对极右翼的支持率上升、街头抗议、来自俄罗斯的混合威胁，以及与中国的贸易逆差，预计到2026年将达到惊人的每天10亿欧元。

paras.en: “There are so many other issues crowding on the agenda,” says Jennifer. So it’s not all about us? “That’s actually been the theme of my decade of reporting from Brussels,” she says with a laugh.
paras.zh: “议程上还有很多其他问题，”Jennifer说。所以，并不是所有事情都与我们有关？“这实际上是我在布鲁塞尔从事新闻报道十年来的主题。”她笑着说。

paras.en: There’s profound concern about the prospect of Marine Le Pen winning the French presidential elections next year, which could tip the bloc into a crisis if she pursues her resolutely anti-EU agenda, which includes reducing France’s substantial contribution to the EU budget.
paras.zh: 人们对玛丽娜·勒庞明年赢得法国总统选举的前景深感忧虑，如果她坚持其坚决反欧盟的纲领，包括削减法国对欧盟预算的大量贡献，那么欧盟就可能陷入危机。

paras.en: Beyond that, there’s a broader question about increasingly divided and unstable politics across member states. “Every single member state has to agree to the UK’s re-entry,” Jennifer reminds me. “Who knows what the EU will look like in 2030 when Britain could be having a rejoin referendum?”
paras.zh: 除此之外，还有一个更广泛的问题，那就是各成员国的政治日益分裂和不稳定。“每个成员国都必须同意英国重新加入，”Jennifer提醒我。“谁知道到2030年英国可能举行重新加入公投时，欧盟会是什么样子？”

paras.en: - Tuesday | The work and pensions secretary Alan Milburn’s long-awaited review into why increasing numbers of young people are falling out of work and education, is expected to be released.
paras.zh: - 周二 | 备受期待的就业与养老金大臣艾伦·米尔本（Alan Milburn）的报告即将发布，该报告旨在 بررسی 为什么越来越多的年轻人失业并辍学。

paras.en: - Thursday | German chancellor Friedrich Merz, French president Emmanuel Macron and UK prime minister Andy Burnham will be among around 20 heads of state meeting in Berlin to discuss defence funding for Ukraine, and to establish a unified position on future peace negotiations in its war with Russia.
paras.zh: - 周四 | 德国总理弗里德里希·默茨、法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙和英国首相安迪·伯纳姆将与约20位国家元首一道在柏林举行会议，讨论对乌克兰的国防资助，并就乌克兰与俄罗斯战争的未来和平谈判达成统一立场。

paras.en: - Friday | This marks last day of the world’s biggest annual climate conference, Cop31, in Turkey, with final negotiations taking place.
paras.zh: - 星期五 | 今天是全球最大规模的年度气候大会COP31在土耳其举行的最后一天，最后的谈判正在进行中。

paras.en: - Emma Beddington’s piece on why gen Xer seem to have worse mental and physical health than boomers is a must-read. Poppy
paras.zh: - Emma Beddington撰写的文章探讨了为什么X世代的心理和身体健康状况似乎不如婴儿潮一代，这篇文章必读。Poppy

paras.en: - Amelia Gentleman’s report over the weekend on two very different rape trials and what happened in each of them is a difficult read – but enlightening about all of the ways culture has (and has not) changed since Russell Brand’s prominence. Poppy
paras.zh: - Amelia Gentleman周末的报道涉及两起截然不同的强奸案审判，以及每起案件中发生的事情。这篇报道读起来很艰难，但却揭示了自Russell Brand声名鹊起以来，文化在方方面面所发生（和未发生）的变化。Poppy

paras.en: Football | England risked throwing away a three-goal lead against Spain after Elliot Anderson was sent off, but held on for a thrilling 3-2 win in Madrid, which Thomas Tuchel hailed as a statement result and the best performance of his tenure.
paras.zh: 足球 | 在埃利奥特·安德森被罚下场后，英格兰险些葬送了对西班牙的三球领先优势，但在马德里以 3-2 的惊险比分取胜。托马斯·图赫尔称这场胜利具有标志性意义，是他执教以来的最佳表现。

paras.en: Cricket | Tom Banton’s century led England to emphatic win, with 135 runs, in second ODI amid Australian soap opera.
paras.zh: 板球 | 在澳大利亚的闹剧中，汤姆·班顿（Tom Banton）在第二场单日国际赛中以135分创下个人百发纪录，带领英格兰队大获全胜。

paras.en: Rugby union | Tries from Matt Fagerson and Jack Dempsey gave Scotland a 15-12 win against Australia in the Nations Championship at Murrayfield
“PM vows early years interventions will tackle youth joblessness crisis”, is the Guardian’s front page today.
The i Paper leads with “Pressure grows for new consent law to protect teenagers from adult predators”, Metro has “Rethink on the age of consent”, the Sun writes “Brand’s rant from prison”.

The Telegraph says “Johnson: Britain would back Brexit again”, the Express writes “Brexit U-turn means ‘more asylum seekers’”. The Times has “Zero-hours ban to cost billions”, the Mail has “£80,000 a day spent ferrying migrants around”, the Mirror’s splash is “Dying in the dark”, and the FT’s is “Nvidia scandal spurs drive to choke China’s AI chip supply”.
Grand Theft Auto VI: the cultural event of the decade?

This week, after a 13-year wait, gamers will finally get hold of Grand Theft Auto VI, the latest instalment of the most successful console computer game in history. How did a game of stealing cars and shooting strangers become such an enormous cultural phenomenon? The Guardian’s video games editor, Keza MacDonald, traces the history of games by Rockstar, GTA’s creator, and what its most successful product has told us about the US, the setting of all its games so far.
A bit of good news to remind you that the world’s not all bad

Some travellers seek out ancient landmarks when they visit a new place. Hidde Burgmans, from the Netherlands, looks for ancient trees – and he’s created an app of the same name to help people find remarkable old trees around the world, from Malaysian baobabs to the Fortingall yew in Perthshire, Scotland, thought to be an astounding 5,000 years old.

Users can review remarkable old trees around the world, and upload their favourites to the Ancient Trees app. “On Tuesday somebody photographed a tree in Edinburgh. Today, someone in Freiburg,” said Burgmans. “That just makes me happy. I thought it was quite a niche, geeky thing, but apparently more people are interested in ancient trees than I thought.”
And finally, the Guardian’s puzzles are here to keep you entertained throughout the day. Until tomorrow.

articles.title: Mexican drug lord Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo dies age 80

paras.en: Notorious Mexican drug lord Miguel Ãngel FÃ©lix Gallardo has died in hospital aged 80.
paras.zh: 臭名昭著的墨西哥毒枭米格尔·安赫尔·费利克斯·加利亚多（Miguel Ángel Félix Gallardo）在医院去世，享年80岁。

paras.en: FÃ©lix Gallardo was widely considered one of the biggest drug smugglers in history and is credited with building an alliance between criminal groups in Colombia and his own Mexican cartel.
paras.zh: Félix Gallardo被普遍认为是历史上最大的毒品走私犯之一，他被认为是促成了哥伦比亚犯罪集团与他自己的墨西哥卡特尔之间的联盟。

paras.en: Known as The Godfather or the 'Boss of Bosses', FÃ©lix Gallardo was the head of the all-powerful Guadalajara Cartel, which reigned over Mexican drug trafficking at the height of the cocaine boom of the 1980s.
paras.zh: 费利克斯·加利亚多（Félix Gallardo）被称为“教父”或“老大中的老大”，他是权势滔天的瓜达拉哈拉贩毒集团的头目，该集团在20世纪80年代可卡因热潮鼎盛时期主宰着墨西哥的毒品贩运。

paras.en: At the time, it created a new modus operandi in the illegal drug trade which endures to this day. He had been in state custody since 1989.
paras.zh: 当时，它在非法毒品交易中开创了一种新的作案手法，这种手法一直沿用至今。自1989年以来，他一直被国家羁押。

paras.en: The name Miguel Ãngel FÃ©lix Gallardo will echo through the annals of drug-trafficking history more than any other except perhaps Pablo Escobar's.
paras.zh: 在贩毒史的 annals 中，米格尔·安赫尔·费利克斯·加利亚多（Miguel Ángel Félix Gallardo）的名字比任何人都更响亮，或许只有巴勃罗·埃斯科瓦尔（Pablo Escobar）的名字能与之媲美。

paras.en: He led the organisation which revolutionised drug smuggling in the region by entering into partnership with the Colombian cartels, particularly Escobar's MedellÃn Cartel, to combine production in the Andes with Mexican transportation across the border into the United States.
paras.zh: 他领导的组织通过与哥伦比亚贩毒集团（特别是埃斯科瓦尔的麦德林贩毒集团）建立合作伙伴关系，将安第斯山的毒品生产与墨西哥的跨境运输相结合，从而彻底改变了该地区的毒品走私格局。

paras.en: At one point an estimated 80% of all cocaine that entered the US came from the MedellÃn Cartel. FÃ©lix Gallardo and his organisation played a major role in smuggling it in.
paras.zh: 曾几何时，流入美国的全部可卡因中，约有80%来自麦德林卡特尔。费利克斯·加利亚多及其组织在走私方面发挥了重要作用。

paras.en: At its height, the Guadalajara Cartel under FÃ©lix Gallardo exerted huge influence over Mexican politics and law enforcement, controlling entire police networks and state governorships.
paras.zh: 在鼎盛时期，由费利克斯·加利亚多领导的瓜达拉哈拉卡特尔对墨西哥的政治和执法机构施加了巨大影响力，控制着整个警察网络和州政府。

paras.en: In 1985, the net started to tighten around the leaders of the cartel following the torture and murder of a DEA agent, Enrique 'Kiki' Camarena.
paras.zh: 1985年，在缉毒署探员恩里克·“基基”·卡马雷纳（Enrique 'Kiki' Camarena）遭到酷刑和谋杀后，针对贩毒集团头目的围剿行动开始收紧。

paras.en: Camarena had angered them after he had discovered and then destroyed a vast marijuana plantation in Chihuahua, which belonged to the criminal group.
paras.zh: 卡马雷纳发现并摧毁了位于奇瓦瓦的一处大麻种植园后，激怒了他们，该种植园属于该犯罪集团。

paras.en: His murder sparked one of the biggest manhunts the US government has ever launched in North America.
paras.zh: 他的遇害引发了美国政府有史以来在北美发起的最大规模的搜捕行动之一。

paras.en: In 1989, FÃ©lix Gallardo was captured and sentenced to decades in prison. In ill health, he was granted house arrest in 2022 but technical problems with electronic ankle monitoring prevented his transfer. He died in hospital in his native Guadalajara.
paras.zh: 1989年，费利克斯·加利亚多被捕，并被判处数十年监禁。由于健康状况不佳，他于2022年被准予软禁，但由于电子脚踝监控存在技术问题，他未能被转移。他死于家乡瓜达拉哈拉的一家医院。

paras.en: In the 1980s, Joaquin 'El Chapo' GuzmÃ¡n was introduced to FÃ©lix Gallardo, who put him in charge of handling logistics for his drug organisation.
paras.zh: 20世纪80年代，华金·“矮子”·古兹曼被介绍给费利克斯·加利亚多，后者让他负责其贩毒组织的后勤工作。

paras.en: From the subsequent break-up of FÃ©lix Gallardo's organisation after his arrest, the Sinaloa Cartel emerged, led by GuzmÃ¡n, now another man synonymous with large-scale drug trafficking.
paras.zh: 在费利克斯·加利亚多被捕后，他的组织随之解散，锡那罗亚卡特尔应运而生，由古兹曼领导，他现在是又一个与大规模贩毒同义的人。

paras.en: In 2019, GuzmÃ¡n was sentenced to life in prison for charges including drug trafficking and money laundering following one of the most high-profile trials in recent US history.
paras.zh: 2019年，在近期美国历史上最受瞩目的审判之一之后，古兹曼因贩毒和洗钱等罪名被判处无期徒刑。

paras.en: FÃ©lix Gallardo's life has been portrayed in a number of television programmes including the Netflix series Narcos: Mexico. The show depicted his rise to power as well as his relationship with GuzmÃ¡n.
paras.zh: 多部电视节目都曾描写过费利克斯·加利亚多的生平，其中包括Netflix剧集《毒枭：墨西哥》。该剧描绘了他崛起的过程以及他与古兹曼的关系。

articles.title: Watch: New York teen reunites with cat missing after building collapse

paras.en: Watch: New York teen reunites with cat missing after building collapse
paras.zh: 视频：纽约少女与大楼坍塌后失踪的猫咪重逢

paras.en: A teenage girl and her cat have been reunited four days after a building in the New York borough of Brooklyn collapsed.
paras.zh: 在纽约布鲁克林区一栋大楼倒塌四天后，一名少女与她的猫重逢了。

paras.en: Zariah Coleman, 13, made an emotional plea when her pet went missing after she and her family were forced to relocate when the side of their building was stripped off in the unexpected collapse.
paras.zh: 13岁的Zariah Coleman在她的宠物失踪后发出了感人的呼吁。此前，由于大楼一侧在意外坍塌中被剥离，她和家人被迫搬迁。

paras.en: City officials later found her cat, Isaac, in the debris of the their home and shared the reunion on Sunday afternoon.
paras.zh: 后来，市政府官员在他们家的废墟中找到了她的猫Isaac，并在周日下午将猫送回了主人身边。

paras.en: Eight people died and 18 others were injured when the three-storey building collapsed in the Flatbush neighbourhood last Wednesday.
paras.zh: 上周三，弗拉特布什街区一栋三层楼房坍塌，造成8人死亡，18人受伤。

articles.title: Wife of assassinated ex-Haitian leader registers for presidential election

paras.en: The widow of assassinated former Haitian president Jovenel Moise has registered as a presidential candidate for next year's elections in the Caribbean nation.
paras.zh: 被暗杀的海地前总统若弗内尔·莫伊斯的遗孀已登记成为该加勒比国家明年总统选举的候选人。

paras.en: Martine Moise was injured in the gun attack that killed her husband at their home in the capital, Port-au-Prince, in 2021.
paras.zh: 2021年，马蒂娜·莫伊兹在首都太子港的家中遭遇枪击，她的丈夫在这次袭击中丧生，她本人也受了伤。

paras.en: Haiti, which last held an election in 2016, has been plagued with chronic instability and gang violence.
paras.zh: 海地上一次举行选举是在2016年，该国一直饱受长期不稳定和帮派暴力的困扰。

paras.en: Elections were scheduled to be held in December but were postponed last month until July due to the country's insecurity.
paras.zh: 选举原定于12月举行，但由于该国局势不稳，上个月被推迟至7月。

paras.en: Moise has to comment on her candidacy but the electoral council website showed her registration on Sunday.
paras.zh: 莫伊兹必须对她的参选资格发表评论，但选举委员会网站在周日显示了她的登记信息。

paras.en: Last week she said on X: "Haiti will rise again on its own two feet, because politics needs to be done differently."
paras.zh: 上周，她在X上表示：“海地将再次自立，因为政治需要以不同的方式进行。”

paras.en: A total of 33 candidates have registered for the elections, including former presidents Michel Martelly and Jocelerme Privert, former prime minister Claude Joseph and former foreign minister Dominique Dupuy.
paras.zh: 共有 33 名候选人登记参加选举，其中包括前总统米歇尔·马尔泰利和若塞莱姆·普里韦尔、前总理克洛德·约瑟夫和前外交部长多米尼克·杜皮。

paras.en: Jovenel Moise, who led Haiti from 2017 until his death, was shot dead at his home in Port-au-Prince in July 2021, allegedly by a group of mainly Colombian mercenaries.
paras.zh: 若弗内尔·莫伊兹自2017年起执掌海地，直至2021年7月在太子港的家中被枪杀，据称凶手是一群主要由哥伦比亚雇佣兵组成的团伙。

paras.en: Martine Moise suffered serious gunshot wounds during the attack and was flown to a hospital in Florida.
paras.zh: 马蒂娜·莫伊兹在袭击中身中数枪，伤势严重，被空运至佛罗里达州的一家医院。

paras.en: She was charged in connection with the assassination in 2024, but the indictment was overturned last year.
paras.zh: 她因与2024年的暗杀事件有关而被起诉，但起诉书于去年被撤销。

paras.en: The assassination shook the Caribbean nation to its core, with many Haitians shocked that the 53-year-old was killed with such apparent ease.
paras.zh: 此次暗杀事件令这个加勒比国家深受震撼，许多海地人对这位53岁的总统如此轻易地被杀害感到震惊。

paras.en: Thirty suspects have been indicted over the killing so far and in September 18 people were flown from Haiti to Florida to stand trial for their alleged involvement in the assassination.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，已有30名嫌疑人因这起谋杀案被起诉，9月份有18人从海地被空运至佛罗里达州，因涉嫌参与暗杀而接受审判。

paras.en: Haiti has been engulfed in a wave of gang violence since the assassination of Moise.
paras.zh: 自莫伊兹遇刺以来，海地一直深陷于一波又一波的帮派暴力之中。

paras.en: At least 1,408 people were killed and 656 injured from April through to June this year, according to the UN Integrated Office in Haiti.
paras.zh: 据联合国海地综合办事处的数据，今年4月至6月，至少有1408人丧生，656人受伤。

paras.zh: 参观 CONEXPO 上的 Carlisle Brake & Friction

paras.zh: Carlisle CBF 将在 2026 年 CONEXPO 上加入我们的 CentroMotion 系列，位于南厅二楼的 #S82219 展位，我们将在这里重点展示我们在精密工程制动系统方面的最新进展。

articles.title: CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026 recap

paras.en: CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026 in Las Vegas, Nevada, reaffirmed its position as the largest construction trade show in North America, drawing more than 140,000 construction professionals from 128 countries across the globe. For Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, the week was an incredible opportunity to showcase innovation, strengthen partnerships and gain valuable insights into the future of the construction, mining and aggregate industries. Throughout the busy week, attendees had the chance to speak with our experts and watch live demonstrations of our brake systems, along with our advanced brake and transmission friction solutions for the construction industry.
paras.zh: 在内华达州拉斯维加斯举行的 CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026 重申了其作为北美最大的建筑贸易展的地位，吸引了来自全球 128 个国家的超过 140,000 名建筑专业人士。对于 CentroMotion 品牌 Carlisle Brake & Friction 来说，本周是展示创新、加强合作伙伴关系以及获得对建筑、采矿和骨料行业未来的宝贵见解的绝佳机会。在忙碌的一周中，与会者有机会与我们的专家交谈并观看我们制动系统的现场演示，以及我们为建筑行业提供的先进制动和传动摩擦解决方案。

paras.en: CONEXPO-CON/AGG is more than a trade show, it’s a barometer for where the industry is headed. Top trends included integrating autonomous equipment, advanced digital tools and sustainable technologies. The exhibition footprint spanned more than 3 million square feet with greater than 2,000 exhibitors, and attendees covered miles of exhibits sprawled across indoor and outdoor spaces.
paras.zh: CONEXPO-CON/AGG 不仅仅是一个贸易展，它还是行业发展方向的晴雨表。主要趋势包括集成自主设备、先进的数字工具和可持续技术。展览面积超过 300 万平方英尺，参展商超过 2,000 家，与会者覆盖了遍布室内和室外空间的数英里展品。

paras.en: At the show, Carlisle Brake & Friction highlighted its advanced brake systems and friction technologies designed to withstand extreme duty cycles and demanding off‑highway applications. Attendees experienced firsthand the performance, quality, and engineering expertise that define the CarlisleCBF brand. The CentroMotion booth was a hub of activity, and the team welcomed OEM leaders and aftermarket specialists. These interactions went beyond showcasing our products, they enhanced relationships and increased our team’s understanding of the industry’s evolving needs. Check out this video https://youtu.be/C_IaFtvWBY8 for more detail about our booth and featured products serving the market.
paras.zh: 在展会上，卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司重点介绍了其先进的制动系统和摩擦技术，旨在承受极端的工作循环和苛刻的非公路应用。与会者亲身体验了 CarlisleCBF 品牌的性能、质量和工程专业知识。 CentroMotion 展位是活动中心，团队欢迎 OEM 领导者和售后市场专家。这些互动不仅仅是展示我们的产品，它们还增强了关系并增加了我们团队对行业不断变化的需求的了解。请观看此视频 https://youtu.be/C_IaFtvWBY8，了解有关我们的展位和服务于市场的特色产品的更多详细信息。

paras.en: The show floor was packed with the latest advancements across construction, aggregate, concrete and lifting. Attendees explored:
paras.zh: 展厅里充满了建筑、骨料、混凝土和起重方面的最新进展。与会者探讨：

paras.en: • New and upgraded equipment and machinery in action
paras.zh: • 新的和升级的设备和机械投入使用

paras.en: • Advances in automation, electrification and equipment intelligence
paras.zh: • 自动化、电气化和设备智能化的进步

paras.en: • Digital tools focused on productivity, fleet management and jobsite visibility
paras.zh: • 专注于生产力、车队管理和作业现场可视性的数字工具

paras.en: • Solutions designed to improve safety, efficiency and sustainability
paras.zh: • 旨在提高安全性、效率和可持续性的解决方案

paras.en: Hands on demos and a live equipment showcase gave attendees the opportunity to see innovations in action and understand how they can be applied on real jobsites.
paras.zh: 动手演示和现场设备展示让与会者有机会看到创新的实际应用，并了解如何将它们应用到实际工作现场。

paras.en: Technology continued to be a major focus at CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026. Exhibitors and education sessions highlighted these key updates as transformational in construction operations:
paras.zh: 技术仍然是 CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026 的主要焦点。参展商和教育会议强调了这些关键更新对建筑运营的变革：

paras.en: • Digital workflows and jobsite visibility
paras.zh: • 数字化工作流程和工地可视性

paras.en: • Sustainability and emissions reduction
paras.zh: • 可持续发展和减排

paras.en: • Workforce challenges and talent development
paras.zh: • 劳动力挑战和人才发展

paras.en: Together, these topics reflected an industry adapting to change while looking toward long term growth.
paras.zh: 这些主题共同反映了行业在适应变化的同时寻求长期增长。

paras.en: Looking ahead: The future of construction
paras.zh: 展望未来：建筑业的未来

paras.en: CONEXPO-CON/AGG shines a bold spotlight on the companies and innovations redefining what’s next in the construction, mining and aggregate industries. Our team’s conversations and key learnings will help shape our strategies for the coming year, and we’re committed to driving progress!
paras.zh: CONEXPO-CON/AGG 大胆聚焦于重新定义建筑、采矿和骨料行业未来发展的公司和创新。我们团队的对话和重要经验将有助于制定来年的战略，我们致力于推动进步！

articles.title: New Facility Brings Off-Highway Wet Friction Production to India

paras.en: New Facility Brings Off-Highway Wet Friction Production to India
paras.zh: 新工厂将非公路湿式摩擦摩擦片生产带至印度

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction has broken ground to expand its Chennai, India manufacturing operations in one of the world’s fastest-growing industrial regions. Having produced mechatronic products in the region for more than 15 years, Carlisle CBF will relocate to add production at a larger site for off-highway paper wet friction discs and steel separator plates. The new facility is scheduled to open in 2027.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司 (Carlisle Brake & Friction) 已破土动工，以扩大其位于印度钦奈的制造业务，该工厂位于世界上增长最快的工业地区之一。 Carlisle CBF 在该地区生产机电一体化产品已超过 15 年，将搬迁至更大的工厂，增加非公路用纸湿式摩擦片和钢制隔板的生产。新设施计划于 2027 年开业。

paras.en: The move to expanded space is designed to accommodate manufacturing capabilities needed to serve the growing demand across the agriculture, construction and especially mining industries in India and Southeast Asia. Local production will improve supply chain responsiveness while supporting original equipment and aftermarket requirements in cost-sensitive markets.
paras.zh: 扩建空间的目的是为了满足印度和东南亚农业、建筑业、特别是采矿业不断增长的需求所需的制造能力。本地生产将提高供应链响应能力，同时支持成本敏感市场的原始设备和售后市场要求。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is establishing a state-of-the-art wet friction manufacturing facility on par with proven global manufacturing processes in the new Chennai plant, to build a more resilient regional platform. This expansion strengthens our ability to deliver durable wet friction products that help keep critical off-highway equipment productive.
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 正在钦奈新工厂建立最先进的湿式摩擦制造设施，与成熟的全球制造工艺相媲美，以打造更具弹性的区域平台。此次扩张增强了我们提供耐用湿式摩擦产品的能力，有助于保持关键非公路设备的生产力。
