articles.title: Octopuses Are the Ultimate Escape Artists. Now Scientists Know How the Creatures Contort Themselves to Squeeze Through Tiny Holes

paras.en: Octopuses are talented escape artists, capable of squeezing their bodies through seemingly impenetrable gaps to avoid danger, find hidden prey or break out of captivity. Scientists have long wondered how these eight-limbed creatures manage such impressive feats of flexibility. Now, they say they have some answers.
paras.zh: 章鱼是天才的逃脱艺术家，它们能够将自己的身体挤过看似无法穿透的缝隙，以避免危险、寻找隐藏的猎物或挣脱束缚。长期以来，科学家们一直想知道这些八肢生物是如何实现如此令人印象深刻的灵活性的。现在，他们说他们有了一些答案。

paras.en: A study published November 5 in the Journal of Experimental Biology describes the step-by-step processes some octopuses use to cram themselves into tight spaces. In addition to expanding our understanding of these crafty cephalopods, the findings could help engineers improve the design of soft robots that need to fit into small spaces, such as those used during search-and-rescue missions.
paras.zh: 11 月 5 日发表在《实验生物学杂志》上的一项研究描述了一些章鱼将自己塞进狭小空间的逐步过程。除了扩大我们对这些狡猾的头足类动物的了解之外，这些发现还可以帮助工程师改进需要适应狭小空间的软机器人的设计，例如在搜救任务中使用的软机器人。

paras.en: “You always just think as a biologist that this is a minor question: How to squeeze your body into a crevice, through a hole or into a cave,” study co-author Michael Kuba, a biologist at the University of Naples Federico II in Italy, tells IFLScience’s Rachael Funnell. “But working with soft robotic engineers, you realize that there is so much more to how they manage to do this. They have several steps of the movement, and they have specific postures and body parts they use to move through a hole.”
paras.zh: “作为一名生物学家，你总是认为这是一个小问题：如何将你的身体挤进缝隙、洞或洞穴中，”该研究的合著者、意大利那不勒斯费德里科二世大学的生物学家迈克尔·库巴 (Michael Kuba) 告诉 IFLScience 的 Rachael Funnell。 “但是与软机​​器人工程师一起工作，你会意识到他们如何做到这一点还有很多。他们有几个运动步骤，并且他们有特定的姿势和身体部位用于穿过洞。”

paras.en: In the study, Kuba and colleagues conducted laboratory experiments involving three subadult common octopuses (Octopus vulgaris) and four juvenile Mayan octopuses (O. maya). The team started by measuring the distance between each animal’s eyes to determine the size of the semi-rigid cartilage casing surrounding their brains. Then, they adjusted a clear, acrylic tank partition to create a single, central hole that was either smaller or larger than the measurements, which ranged from about 0.4 to 1.4 inches. One at a time, they placed the octopuses in the tank, then watched and filmed what happened next.
paras.zh: 在这项研究中，库巴和同事进行了实验室实验，涉及三只亚成年普通章鱼（Octopus vulgaris）和四只幼年玛雅章鱼（O.maya）。研究小组首先测量每只动物眼睛之间的距离，以确定它们大脑周围的半刚性软骨外壳的大小。然后，他们调整了透明的丙烯酸水箱隔板，以创建一个比测量值更小或更大的单个中心孔，测量值的范围约为 0.4 到 1.4 英寸。他们一次一只地将章鱼放入水箱中，然后观察并拍摄接下来发生的事情。

paras.en: “We know that they can squeeze through all these spaces, but nobody’s actually looked at how they do this,” study co-author Tamar Gutnick, a biologist at the Haus des Meeres-Aqua Terra Zoo in Austria, tells NPR’s Ari Daniel. “So, what we did was take octopuses and systematically make them go through different-sized holes.”
paras.zh: “我们知道它们可以挤过所有这些空间，但没有人真正研究过它们是如何做到这一点的，”该研究的合著者、奥地利 Haus des Meeres-Aqua Terra 动物园的生物学家塔玛尔·古特尼克 (Tamar Gutnick) 告诉 NPR 的阿里·丹尼尔 (Ari Daniel)。 “所以，我们所做的就是让章鱼系统地穿过不同大小的洞。”

paras.en: Octopus bodies are mostly soft and pliable. These creatures have only two stiffer body parts: a cartilaginous shell that protects their brains and a beak—made of a hard material called chitin—that they use to eat.
paras.zh: 章鱼的身体大多柔软且柔韧。这些生物只有两个更坚硬的身体部分：保护大脑的软骨壳和由称为甲壳素的坚硬材料制成的喙，它们用来进食。

paras.en: The common octopuses used two different strategies, depending on the size of the hole. When the opening was larger than the distance between their eyes, they tended to perform a three-step maneuver. First, they probed the hole with one arm, initially creating a U-shaped bend at the opening, then sticking the limb through. That might be the animals’ way of feeling out the situation.
paras.zh: 常见的章鱼根据洞的大小使用两种不同的策略。当开口大于眼睛之间的距离时，他们倾向于执行三步操作。首先，他们用一只手臂探查这个洞，最初在开口处形成一个 U 形弯曲，然后将肢体插入其中。这可能是动物感知情况的方式。

paras.en: “The idea is that the octopuses use the tactile sense on the arms to investigate the opening,” Kuba tells Reuters’ Marta Serafinko.
paras.zh: “我们的想法是，章鱼利用手臂上的触觉来调查开口，”库巴告诉路透社的玛塔·塞拉芬科。

paras.en: Then, they snaked a few more arms through the hole. Finally, they used the arms that were already through the hole to push against the back side of the partition, using leverage to pull the rest of their bodies through.
paras.zh: 然后，他们又从洞里伸了几只手臂。最后，他们用已经穿过洞的手臂推着隔板的背面，利用杠杆作用将身体的其余部分拉了进去。

paras.en: When the hole was smaller than the distance between their eyes, the common octopuses used a similar strategy, except they broke the final step into two stages. After probing and then threading a few arms through, they put the remaining arms through. Then, they pulled their head and mantle through.
paras.zh: 当洞小于眼睛之间的距离时，普通章鱼会使用类似的策略，只不过它们将最后一步分为两个阶段。在探测并穿过几条手臂后，他们将其余的手臂穿过。然后，他们把头和斗篷拉了出来。

paras.en: “This change initially puzzled all of us,” lead author Wenci Xin, a roboticist at the National University of Singapore, tells IFLScience. “However, after thinking about it carefully, we felt that it made sense: The animals were still following the same general pattern, while the new strategy simply divided the process of pulling the body through into separate stages.”
paras.zh: “这一变化最初让我们所有人都感到困惑，”新加坡国立大学的机器人专家、主要作者 Wenci Xin 告诉 IFLScience。 “然而，仔细思考后，我们觉得这是有道理的：动物仍然遵循相同的一般模式，而新策略只是将拉动身体的过程分为不同的阶段。”

paras.en: The Mayan octopuses deployed a similar strategy as the common octopuses when the hole was larger than the distance between their eyes. But when the hole was smaller, they simply ignored it—they didn’t even try to squeeze through.
paras.zh: 当洞大于它们眼睛之间的距离时，玛雅章鱼采取了与普通章鱼类似的策略。但当洞变小时，他们就直接忽略它——甚至没有试图挤过去。

paras.en: It’s not clear why the two species behaved differently. However, the researchers suspect their unique approaches likely stem from differences in their biologies or environments. Other species of octopuses might also have their own squeezing strategies.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚为什么这两个物种表现不同。然而，研究人员怀疑他们独特的方法可能源于他们的生物学或环境的差异。其他种类的章鱼也可能有自己的挤压策略。

paras.en: The new work sheds light on how some octopuses pull off their acrobatic stunts. But scientists still don’t fully understand how octopuses can tolerate the physical demands of these movements.
paras.zh: 这项新研究揭示了一些章鱼如何完成杂技特技。但科学家们仍然不完全了解章鱼如何忍受这些运动的身体要求。

paras.en: “It’s really remarkable that they carry on about their daily business,” Trevor Wardill, a neuroethologist at the University of Minnesota who was not involved with the study, tells the Washington Post’s Meghan Bartels.
paras.zh: 未参与这项研究的明尼苏达大学神经行为学家特雷弗·沃迪尔 (Trevor Wardill) 告诉《华盛顿邮报》的梅根·巴特尔斯 (Meghan Bartels)，“他们能够继续自己的日常事务，这真是太了不起了。”

paras.en: If humans or other animals with backbones tried something similar, he says, “that level of brain distortion … would be like a massive concussion—you’d be really spaced out for a very long time, if not dead.”
paras.zh: 他说，如果人类或其他有脊椎的动物尝试类似的事情，“那种程度的大脑扭曲……就像一次巨大的脑震荡——你会在很长一段时间内昏迷不醒，甚至死亡。”

paras.en: Moving forward, the researchers hope the results of their experiments will help them develop flexible, octopus-like robots that can successfully navigate confined spaces. Today, most search-and-rescue robots are long and slender—more like snakes than octopuses, a design that helps them wriggle through narrow crevices. But an octopus-inspired robot might have other benefits, such as the ability to carry sensors, communication devices and tools on its flexible arms.
paras.zh: 展望未来，研究人员希望他们的实验结果能够帮助他们开发出灵活的、类似章鱼的机器人，能够成功地在密闭空间中航行。如今，大多数搜救机器人都又长又细——更像蛇而不是章鱼，这种设计可以帮助它们蠕动穿过狭窄的缝隙。但受章鱼启发的机器人可能还有其他好处，例如能够在其灵活的手臂上携带传感器、通信设备和工具。

paras.en: “This incredible capability could enable robots to overcome environmental limitations and enter spaces that are difficult to reach,” Xin tells Science News’ Nora Bradford.
paras.zh: “这种令人难以置信的能力可以使机器人克服环境限制并进入难以到达的空间，”辛告诉《科学新闻》的诺拉·布拉德福德。

articles.title: The Handwritten Final Draft of Martin Luther King Jr.'s 'I Have a Dream' Speech Was Considered Lost. It Turned Out to Be Sitting in a Desk Drawer for Decades

paras.en: It was late on August 27, 1963, and Martin Luther King Jr. was huddled with a group of his closest advisors in the lobby of the Willard Hotel in Washington, D.C.
paras.zh: 1963 年 8 月 27 日深夜，马丁·路德·金 (Martin Luther King Jr.) 和他最亲密的一群顾问挤在华盛顿特区威拉德酒店的大厅里。

paras.en: They were drafting King’s closing remarks for the March on Washington, officially the March on Washington for Jobs and Freedom, which was set to start in just 12 hours. The group went back and forth on the message: Should it be ideological or Biblical? Directed towards the students marching or the nation at large?
paras.zh: 他们正在起草马丁·路德·金为“华盛顿大游行”（正式名称为“华盛顿争取就业和自由大游行”）的闭幕词，该活动原定在 12 小时内开始。小组就这个信息反复讨论：它应该是意识形态的还是圣经的？针对学生游行还是针对整个国家？

paras.en: As the night wore on, King eventually bowed out. “Okay brothers,” Clarence B. Jones, an activist and speechwriter for King, recalled him saying. “Thank you so much everybody for your suggestions and input … I am now going upstairs to my room to counsel with my Lord.”
paras.zh: 随着夜幕降临，金最终退出了。 “好吧，兄弟们，”金的活动家兼演讲撰稿人克拉伦斯·B·琼斯 (Clarence B. Jones) 回忆起金的说法。 “非常感谢大家的建议和意见……我现在上楼到我的房间向我的主商议。”

paras.en: Alone in his suite, King stayed up until 4 a.m., writing and revising his remarks on a yellow notepad, scratching out swaths of text in blue ink. He then sent these marked-up pages to be typed, forming the basis of his canonical “I Have a Dream” speech, delivered to more than 250,000 demonstrators gathered by the Lincoln Memorial.
paras.zh: 金独自在套房里熬夜到凌晨 4 点，在黄色记事本上书写和修改自己的言论，并用蓝色墨水划出大段文字。然后，他将这些标记好的页面发送给打字员，构成了他向林肯纪念堂聚集的超过 250,000 名示威者发表的经典演讲“我有一个梦想”的基础。

paras.en: Scholars have long assumed that the original, handwritten final draft had been discarded amid the day’s chaos. But six decades later, the manuscript has resurfaced from a drawer of one of King’s former aides. The seven yellow pages are set to be auctioned at Christie’s in January, where the draft is expected to sell for more than $10 million.
paras.zh: 长期以来，学者们一直认为手写的最终草稿在当天的混乱中已被丢弃。但六年后，这份手稿又从金的一位前助手的抽屉里重新出现。这七本黄页将于 1 月份在佳士得拍卖，预计售价将超过 1000 万美元。

paras.en: “When I first saw these pages and realized what they were, I was astounded,” Christie’s manuscripts specialist Peter Klarnet says in a statement. “This is a treasure of American history … Reading along, you’re there in the moment with Dr. King, watching him compose it and making edits in real time.”
paras.zh: “当我第一次看到这些页面并意识到它们是什么时，我感到震惊，”佳士得手稿专家彼得·克拉内特（Peter Klarnet）在一份声明中说道。 “这是美国历史的瑰宝……一边读，一边与金博士在一起，看着他实时创作并进行编辑。”

paras.en: Civil rights leader and philanthropist Xernona Clayton found the pages in the late 1990s. They were tucked in an envelope labeled “speech,” nestled among other papers in a desk drawer belonging to her late husband, Edward, one of King’s aides and speechwriters.
paras.zh: 民权领袖兼慈善家 Xernona Clayton 在 20 世纪 90 年代末发现了这些页面。它们被塞在一个贴着“演讲”标签的信封里，与她已故丈夫爱德华（金的助手和演讲撰稿人之一）的办公桌抽屉里的其他文件放在一起。

paras.en: Clayton knew it was an important document related to the “I Have a Dream” speech but not that it was the final manuscript. She tucked it back in the desk drawer, not wanting to disrespect King’s memory by selling or displaying his memorabilia.
paras.zh: 克莱顿知道这是一份与“我有一个梦想”演讲相关的重要文件，但不知道它是最终手稿。她把它塞回书桌抽屉里，不想通过出售或展示金的纪念品来不尊重他的记忆。

paras.en: But in recent years, she changed her mind. “Now that I’m older, I’m wiser,” Clayton, now 96, tells the New York Times’ Jennifer Schuessler. “It just seems like something that important ought to be shared.”
paras.zh: 但近年来，她改变了想法。 “现在我年纪大了，我更聪明了，”现年 96 岁的克莱顿告诉《纽约时报》的詹妮弗·舒斯勒。 “这似乎是一些重要的事情应该被分享。”

paras.en: In 2024, she shared the pages with her financial manager, who worked with the Christie’s team to identify it as the only known handwritten final draft of the famous speech.
paras.zh: 2024 年，她与财务经理分享了这些页面，财务经理与佳士得团队合作，将其确定为唯一已知的著名演讲的手写最终草稿。

paras.en: “I’m just glad I looked at the drawer,” Clayton says in the statement. “Now, the world will have the opportunity to see those words of wisdom that continue to inspire hope, freedom and the pursuit of equality.”
paras.zh: “我很高兴看到了抽屉，”克莱顿在声明中说。 “现在，世界将有机会看到那些继续激发希望、自由和追求平等的智慧之言。”

paras.en: The handwritten manuscript is nearly identical to the final, typeface draft King carried with him to the lectern, a copy of which is currently on view at Smithsonian’s National Museum of African American History and Culture (NMAAHC).
paras.zh: 这份手写手稿与金随身携带到讲台上的最终字体草稿几乎完全相同，该手稿的副本目前正在史密森尼国家非裔美国人历史和文化博物馆 (NMAAHC) 展出。

paras.en: “The speech was slotted to be a four-minute closing to the march,” NMAAHC curator Kevin Strait explained in 2021. “However, it became a powerful, 16-minute rallying cry for the entire civil rights movement.”
paras.zh: NMAAHC 策展人凯文·斯特雷特 (Kevin Strait) 在 2021 年解释说：“这场演讲原定为游行结束时的四分钟。然而，它成为整个民权运动强有力的 16 分钟战斗口号。”

paras.en: In fact, neither the original, handwritten pages nor the printed copy bear any mention of the speech’s most memorable line, King’s “I have a dream” refrain. Those words, along with much of the speech’s second half, were improvised on the spot after gospel singer Mahalia Jackson shouted to King, “Tell ‘em about the ‘dream.’” The rediscovered draft does contain the speech’s enduring final line, “Free at last, free at last; thank God almighty, we are free at last.”
paras.zh: 事实上，手写原稿和印刷本都没有提及演讲中最令人难忘的一句话，即金的“我有一个梦想”。这些话以及演讲后半部分的大部分内容都是在福音歌手玛哈莉亚·杰克逊向金喊道“告诉他们‘梦想’”后即兴创作的。重新发现的草稿确实包含了演讲经久不衰的最后一句：“终于自由了，终于自由了；感谢全能的上帝，我们终于自由了。”

paras.en: King’s address has been extensively studied, but this manuscript may shed new light on the activist’s thinking in the hours leading up to the monumental march. For example, King rewrote the speech’s warning about “the tranquilizing drug of gradualism” three times. First, he wrote “tokenism,” before replacing it with “waitism.” He eventually crossing both out in favor of “gradualism,” per the Times.
paras.zh: 金的演讲已被广泛研究，但这份手稿可能会为这位活动家在纪念性游行前几个小时的想法提供新的线索。例如，金将演讲中关于“渐进主义镇静剂”的警告重写了三遍。首先，他写了“象征主义”，然后用“等待主义”代替。据《泰晤士报》报道，他最终将两者划掉，转而支持“渐进主义”。

paras.en: Scholars say the opportunity to see the speech in King’s own writing is an incredible opportunity. “When [Christie’s] called me, I was almost in disbelief. It’s almost like it gives us a chance to get between King’s ears, to get in his mind,” Lerone A. Martin, director of the Martin Luther King Jr. Research and Education Institute at Stanford University, tells the Times.
paras.zh: 学者们表示，有机会看到金自己撰写的演讲稿是一个难以置信的机会。 “当（佳士得）打电话给我时，我几乎不敢相信。这几乎就像给了我们一个深入金的耳朵、进入他的思想的机会，”斯坦福大学马丁·路德·金研究与教育研究所所长莱隆·马丁 (Lerone A. Martin) 告诉《泰晤士报》。

paras.en: Malcolm X attended the March on Washington but did not participate. He critiqued the event, calling it “the Farce in Washington,” and took issue with King’s "Dream" speech, declaring that “the black masses in America were—and still are—having a nightmare.”
paras.zh: 马尔科姆·X 参加了华盛顿游行，但没有参加。他批评了这一事件，称其为“华盛顿的闹剧”，并对金的“梦想”演讲提出异议，宣称“美国的黑人群众过去和现在仍然在做一场噩梦。”

paras.en: All proceeds from the sale will go to philanthropic efforts, including the Xernona Clayton Foundation and the King Center in Atlanta, which was founded by King’s wife and fellow civil rights activist Coretta Scott King.
paras.zh: 出售的所有收益将用于慈善事业，包括 Xernona Clayton 基金会和亚特兰大国王中心，该中心由金的妻子、民权活动家科雷塔·斯科特·金 (Coretta Scott King) 创立。

paras.en: The manuscript will be exhibited at the National Center for Civil and Human Rights in Atlanta from November 16 to 22, followed by a display in Chicago. The pages will also be on public display at Christie’s New York starting on King’s birthday, January 15, through January 21. The draft will be sold on January 22 in a single-lot sale.
paras.zh: 该手稿将于 11 月 16 日至 22 日在亚特兰大国家公民和人权中心展出，随后在芝加哥展出。这些页面还将在金的生日 1 月 15 日至 1 月 21 日期间在纽约佳士得公开展出。该草稿将于 1 月 22 日以单拍拍卖的形式出售。

paras.en: “It’s poetic that the past will protect the future,” Martin Luther King III, a human rights activist and the eldest son of the civil rights leader, says in the statement. “We are grateful that this treasure was preserved over the decades by the Clayton family … Now, for the first time, the public will have the opportunity to be inspired by this document.”
paras.zh: “过去将保护未来，这是诗意的，”人权活动家、民权领袖的长子马丁·路德·金三世在声明中说道。 “我们很感激克莱顿家族几十年来保存了这一宝藏......现在，公众将第一次有机会从这份文件中受到启发。”

articles.title: A Rare Surviving Letter From Martha Washington Sheds Light on Her Young Daughter's Struggle With Epilepsy

paras.en: More than 260 years ago, Martha Washington wrote to a friend with encouraging news about her young daughter’s health. Now, that letter has found a new home at the Library of Congress, offering a rare glimpse into the family’s private life.
paras.zh: 260 多年前，玛莎·华盛顿 (Martha Washington) 写信给一位朋友，带来了有关她小女儿健康状况的令人鼓舞的消息。现在，这封信在国会图书馆找到了新家，让人们得以难得一睹这个家庭的私生活。

paras.en: Martha penned the note on September 29, 1760. Writing to Margaret Bolan Green, she provided an update on her four-year-old daughter “Patsy.”
paras.zh: 玛莎于 1760 年 9 月 29 日写下了这张便条。她写信给玛格丽特·博兰·格林，提供了她四岁女儿“帕齐”的最新情况。

paras.en: “I have the pleasure to tell you my dear little girl is much better,” she wrote. “She has lost her fitts & fevours bout and seems to be getting well very fast.”
paras.zh: “我很高兴告诉你，我亲爱的小女孩好多了，”她写道。 “她已经失去了健康和活力，而且似乎恢复得很快。”

paras.en: The Library of Congress purchased the letter for $47,500 in June during a Heritage Auctions sale, with funding from the James Madison Council’s Edwin L. Cox Legacy Trust, a permanent endowment that helps the library acquire materials. The library already had 11 of Martha’s letters, but this is the first that bears her handwriting.
paras.zh: 国会图书馆在 6 月份的 Heritage 拍卖会上以 47,500 美元的价格购买了这封信，资金来自詹姆斯·麦迪逊委员会的埃德温·L·考克斯遗产信托基金，这是一项帮助图书馆获取资料的永久捐赠基金。图书馆已经收藏了玛莎的 11 封信件，但这是第一封有她亲笔签名的信件。

paras.en: “Very few of Martha Washington’s letters survive, as she appears to have destroyed most of her own private correspondence,” Elizabeth Novara, the American women’s history specialist for the library’s Manuscript Division, writes in a blog post. “Even brief documentation of her relationships with family and friends, as may be found in this letter, is important to understanding women’s lives during this time period.”
paras.zh: “玛莎·华盛顿的信件几乎没有保存下来，因为她似乎销毁了自己的大部分私人信件，”图书馆手稿部门的美国女性历史专家伊丽莎白·诺瓦拉在一篇博客文章中写道。 “即使是在这封信中可以找到的关于她与家人和朋友关系的简短记录，对于了解这一时期女性的生活也很重要。”

paras.en: “Patsy”—whose full name was Martha Parke Custis—was one of the four children Martha had with her first husband, Daniel Parke Custis. The two had been married for just seven years when Custis died from a sudden illness in July 1757, at the age of 45. Two years later, at age 27, the widowed Martha married George Washington. Together, they raised the two surviving children from Martha’s first marriage, Patsy and John “Jacky” Parke Custis. (The other two, Daniel Parke Custis and Frances Parke Custis, died while their father was still alive.).
paras.zh: “帕齐”——全名玛莎·帕克·卡斯蒂斯——是玛莎和第一任丈夫丹尼尔·帕克·卡斯蒂斯生的四个孩子之一。两人结婚仅七年，卡斯蒂斯就于 1757 年 7 月因病去世，享年 45 岁。两年后，27 岁的寡妇玛莎与乔治·华盛顿结婚。他们一起抚养了玛莎第一次婚姻中幸存的两个孩子，帕齐·帕克·卡斯蒂斯和约翰·“杰基”·帕克·卡斯蒂斯。 （另外两人，丹尼尔·帕克·卡斯蒂斯和弗朗西斯·帕克·卡斯蒂斯，在他们的父亲还活着时就去世了。）。

paras.en: Historians believe that William Costin, a prominent member of Washington, D.C.’s free Black community, was likely Martha Washington’s grandson—the child of her son from her first marriage, Jacky, and an enslaved woman.
paras.zh: 历史学家认为，华盛顿特区自由黑人社区的杰出成员威廉·科斯汀很可能是玛莎·华盛顿的孙子——她第一次婚姻所生的儿子杰基和一名被奴役的妇女所生的孩子。

paras.en: Martha wrote the letter after George Washington had served as commander of the Virginia Regiment during the French and Indian War but before he had become the nation’s first president. Historians now suspect that Patsy’s “fitts & fevours” were symptoms of epilepsy, a neurological disorder caused by abnormal bursts of electrical activity in the brain. But, at the time, doctors didn’t understand her affliction.
paras.zh: 玛莎是在乔治·华盛顿在法印战争期间担任弗吉尼亚军团司令之后、但在他成为美国第一任总统之前写下这封信的。历史学家现在怀疑帕齐的“癫痫发作和发烧”是癫痫的症状，癫痫是一种由大脑异常电活动爆发引起的神经系统疾病。但当时，医生并不理解她的痛苦。

paras.en: “There’s no doubt that [Patsy] had epilepsy,” Kevin Butterfield, acting chief of the library’s manuscript division, tells the Washington Post’s Michael E. Ruane. “In her preteen and teen years it really accelerated.”
paras.zh: “毫无疑问，[帕齐]患有癫痫症，”图书馆手稿部代理主管凯文·巴特菲尔德 (Kevin Butterfield) 告诉《华盛顿邮报》的迈克尔·E·鲁恩 (Michael E. Ruane)。 “在她青春期前和青少年时期，这种情况确实加速了。”

paras.en: The Washingtons consulted numerous doctors and tried a variety of remedies to stop Patsy’s seizures, including an iron ring worn on one finger, bloodletting, trips to mineral springs and treatments with mercury and ether. They also gave her cinchona bark, commonly used to treat malarial fevers, and bitters, a remedy for stomach ailments.
paras.zh: 华盛顿夫妇咨询了众多医生，并尝试了多种疗法来阻止帕特西的癫痫发作，包括在一根手指上戴铁环、放血、去矿泉浴以及使用汞和乙醚治疗。他们还给了她金鸡纳树皮（通常用于治疗疟疾热）和苦精（一种治疗胃病的药物）。

paras.en: But Patsy’s epilepsy only worsened. In the summer of 1770, when Patsy was 14, her stepfather kept track of her epileptic fits. His log revealed that she had seizures on 26 out of 86 days, sometimes suffering two per day.
paras.zh: 但帕齐的癫痫症只会恶化。 1770 年夏天，帕齐 14 岁，她的继父一直在追踪她的癫痫发作情况。他的日志显示，在 86 天中，她有 26 天出现癫痫发作，有时每天两次。

paras.en: In the end, it was a seizure that killed Patsy. She died at age 17 on June 19, 1773, at Mount Vernon “without uttering a Word, a groan or scarce a Sigh,” George Washington wrote the next day. The death of the “Sweet Innocent Girl” was a “sudden, and unexpected blow” that “almost reduced my poor Wife to the lowest ebb of Misery,” he added.
paras.zh: 最终，帕西因癫痫发作而死亡。 1773 年 6 月 19 日，17 岁的她在弗农山去世，“没有说一句话，没有呻吟，也没有叹息，”乔治·华盛顿第二天写道。他补充道，“可爱无辜的女孩”的去世是一个“突然的、意想不到的打击”，“几乎让我可怜的妻子陷入了痛苦的最低潮”。

paras.en: The Library of Congress also recently acquired a letter written by First Lady Mary Todd Lincoln. She penned the note to Caroline R. Wright, the wife of the former governor of Indiana, on February 15, 1865, two months before her husband was assassinated.
paras.zh: 国会图书馆最近还获得了第一夫人玛丽·托德·林肯写的一封信。 1865 年 2 月 15 日，也就是她丈夫被暗杀的两个月前，她给印第安纳州前州长的妻子卡罗琳·R·赖特 (Caroline R. Wright) 写了这封信。

paras.en: In the letter, she mentions a “beautiful wreath of hair,” which scholars suspect is a reference to the “Hairy Eagle,” an intricate sculpture created from the locks of several politicians and their wives, including the Lincolns. Wright commissioned the piece to be used as a fundraiser for sick and wounded Civil War soldiers.
paras.zh: 在信中，她提到了一个“美丽的头发花环”，学者们怀疑这是指“毛鹰”，这是一个由几位政客及其妻子（包括林肯家族）的头发制成的复杂雕塑。赖特委托这件作品为内战受伤的士兵筹款。

paras.en: The letter also references a recent White House dinner and renovations to the Executive Mansion that would prevent the Lincolns from hosting visitors in early March. Mary Todd Lincoln suggests Wright might stay at Willard’s Hotel, now the site of the Willard InterContinental, during a visit that historians think might coincide with Abraham Lincoln’s second presidential inauguration on March 4, 1865.
paras.zh: 这封信还提到了最近的一次白宫晚宴以及对行政官邸的翻修，这将使林肯家族无法在三月初接待访客。玛丽·托德·林肯建议赖特可能会在威拉德酒店（现为威拉德洲际酒店所在地）下榻，历史学家认为赖特此次访问可能恰逢亚伯拉罕·林肯 1865 年 3 月 4 日第二次总统就职典礼。

paras.en: Together, the two newly acquired letters help the Library of Congress “tell fascinating stories that we simply couldn’t tell before,” Butterfield says in a statement. “What is already the world’s richest and most expansive collection of materials related to American history is constantly growing—sometimes one letter at a time.”
paras.zh: 巴特菲尔德在一份声明中说，这两封新获得的信件一起帮助国会图书馆“讲述我们以前无法讲述的有趣故事”。 “与美国历史相关的资料已经是世界上最丰富、最广泛的，而且还在不断增加——有时一次一封信。”

articles.title: Evercade Nexus Review: The Best Retro Handheld Yet
articles.author: Matt Kamen

paras.en: Specialist hardware manufacturer Blaze Entertainment has spent the 2020s quietly carving out a niche for itself as the go-to option for retro gaming. With a stable of reliable hardware, from the original Evercade handheld to the Evercade Alpha bartop arcade cabinet, it offers numerous ways to play, all built around an ever-expanding library of physical cartridges. Each brings a curated selection of classic titles and lost curiosities to modern players.
paras.zh: 专业硬件制造商 Blaze Entertainment 在 2020 年代悄然为自己开辟了一个利基市场，成为复古游戏的首选。凭借稳定可靠的硬件，从最初的 Evercade 掌机到 Evercade Alpha 吧台街机柜，它提供了多种游戏方式，所有这些都围绕不断扩展的物理卡带库构建。每款游戏都为现代玩家精心挑选了经典游戏和失落的好奇心。

paras.en: The Evercade Nexus is more than just the latest addition to its console lineup. While it retains compatibility with every previously released Evercade cartridge, it’s also the biggest leap forward the line has taken so far, both in hardware and in what it might offer with games going forward. It’s a real level up—and it’s rather brilliant.
paras.zh: Evercade Nexus 不仅仅是其游戏机系列的最新成员。虽然它保留了与之前发布的所有 Evercade 卡带的兼容性，但它也是该系列迄今为止所取得的最大飞跃，无论是在硬件方面还是在未来游戏可能提供的功能方面。这是真正的提升——而且相当出色。

paras.en: The most obvious change is the sheer size. Where Blaze’s previous handhelds were about on par with the original Game Boy Advance, aimed at pocketable play, the Evercade Nexus is closer in scale to a Nintendo Switch Lite. It measures 215 x 111 x 34 millimeters and weighs 410 grams—still easily portable, but more in the “buy a protective hard case and throw it in your bag” kind of way.
paras.zh: 最明显的变化是尺寸。 Blaze 之前的掌上游戏机与最初的 Game Boy Advance 大致相当，旨在便携游戏，而 Evercade Nexus 的规模更接近 Nintendo Switch Lite。它的尺寸为 215 x 111 x 34 毫米，重量为 410 克，仍然易于携带，但更多的是“购买一个保护性硬盒并将其放入包中”的方式。

paras.en: The size increase works in its favor, though. The larger design feels more substantial, with more real estate for your hands for better comfort. The control layout remains broadly the same as the Evercade EXP—a D-pad, ABXY face buttons, shoulder buttons, and triggers all return, with a few beneficial tweaks. Notably, the triggers are now chunkier and curved to meet your fingers, while all four shoulder inputs and the rear of the device are now nicely textured for better grip.
paras.zh: 不过，尺寸的增加对其有利。更大的设计感觉更坚固，为您的双手提供更多空间，带来更好的舒适度。控制布局与 Evercade EXP 大致相同——方向键、ABXY 面部按钮、肩部按钮和所有返回触发器，并进行了一些有益的调整。值得注意的是，触发器现在更厚实且弯曲，以适应您的手指，而所有四个肩部输入和设备后部现在都具有良好的纹理，以便更好地抓握。

articles.title: AI DJs Completely Kill My Groove
articles.author: Reece Rogers

paras.en: I usually can’t pinpoint the moment I stop using a software feature, with most tools drifting out of fashion without an expiration date. That’s not the case with YouTube Music’s “Beyond the Beat,” an AI-generated DJ that explains songs to you.
paras.zh: 我通常无法确定我停止使​​用某个软件功能的时间，因为大多数工具都已经过时了，而且没有过期日期。 YouTube Music 的“Beyond the Beat”则并非如此，它是由人工智能生成的 DJ，可以向你解释歌曲。

paras.en: YouTube Music is my music-streaming service of choice. And since I’m a software reporter, I always enable the beta features available through YouTube Labs, which include Beyond the Beat. YouTube’s AI DJ randomly interjects for about 30 seconds between songs, teeing up the vibe shift and providing context about the next track.
paras.zh: YouTube Music 是我选择的音乐流媒体服务。由于我是一名软件记者，因此我总是启用 YouTube 实验室提供的测试版功能，其中包括 Beyond the Beat。 YouTube 的 AI DJ 在歌曲之间随机插入约 30 秒，营造氛围转变并提供有关下一首曲目的背景信息。

paras.en: More listeners are encountering synthetic commentary built into their music streaming apps. While YouTube launched this experimental AI DJ in 2025, Spotify first introduced a similar tool back in 2023. It doubled down on its AI DJ efforts in November, expanding the different personalities available to users and adding more controls over the commentary.
paras.zh: 越来越多的听众正在遇到内置于音乐流媒体应用程序中的综合评论。 YouTube 在 2025 年推出了这款实验性 AI DJ，而 Spotify 早在 2023 年就首次推出了类似的工具。该公司在 11 月加倍加大了 AI DJ 的力度，扩大了用户可用的不同个性，并增加了对评论的更多控制。

paras.en: These AI DJs aren’t just annoying. Their attempts to provide helpful context and mimic human candor ultimately fall flat. Lucky for me, both features are optional and avoidable.
paras.zh: 这些人工智能 DJ 不仅令人讨厌。他们试图提供有用的背景并模仿人类的坦诚，最终以失败告终。对我来说幸运的是，这两个功能都是可选且可以避免的。

paras.en: After months of leaving it enabled, a bad experience with Beyond the Beat this week pushed me to swear off AI DJs altogether. I was listening to a pop divas playlist as part of my morning workout and got slapped with 30 seconds of exposition after a Slayyyter track:
paras.zh: 在启用它几个月后，本周 Beyond the Beat 的一次糟糕体验迫使我完全放弃人工智能 DJ。作为早上锻炼的一部分，我正在听流行歌星的播放列表，在 Slayyyter 曲目之后，我被长达 30 秒的解释所困扰：

paras.en: “Hey Boy delivers that high-energy surge perfectly, but we're shifting our focus to a sharper, more visceral reality. In Rock Music, Charli XXC [sic] weaves in a biting, dark sense of humor regarding the physical toll of her relentless 2024 and 2025 touring. She turns the genuine nerve damage she sustained on the road into a strange sort of battle scar, reclaiming the exhaustion of a weary party girl as a badge of honor. It's an unflinching look at the cost behind the spectacle, where the grind of the industry becomes the actual subject matter. Here is Rock Music by Charli XXC [sic].”
paras.zh: “Hey Boy 完美地传达了那种高能量的冲击力，但我们正在将注意力转向更尖锐、更发自内心的现实。在《摇滚音乐》中，Charli XXC [原文如此]以一种尖锐的黑色幽默感讲述了她在 2024 年和 2025 年无情的巡演中所遭受的身体伤害。她将在路上遭受的真正的神经损伤变成了一种奇怪的战斗伤疤，将疲惫的派对女孩的疲惫重新视为荣誉徽章。这是对这一奇观背后的成本的坚定审视，其中行业的苦差事成为了真正的主题，这是 Charli XXC 的摇滚音乐[原文如此]。”

paras.en: What a lengthy paragraph of platitudes with little substance. That’s not even mentioning how the AI DJ butchered the pronunciation of a little-known, indie act called Charli XCX. This flub reflected my overall experience with YouTube Music’s AI DJ. It took me out of the groove and didn’t feel additive.
paras.zh: 多么冗长的陈词滥调，内容却很少。更不用说 AI DJ 是如何毁掉一个鲜为人知的独立艺人 Charli XCX 的发音的了。这个失误反映了我对 YouTube Music 的 AI DJ 的整体体验。它让我脱离了困境，并且没有感觉有任何附加。

paras.en: In another example, it went in-depth on the meaning of Olivia Rodrigo’s Expectations remix featuring Chappell Roan, calling it a "structural interpretation” that unpacks the “nuances of queer dating.” Then YouTube Music played the original track, sans Roan; so much for the queer yearning.
paras.zh: 在另一个例子中，它深入探讨了奥利维亚·罗德里戈（Olivia Rodrigo）与查普尔·罗恩（Chappell Roan）合作的《期望》混音版的含义，称其为“结构性解释”，揭示了“酷儿约会的细微差别”。然后 YouTube Music 播放了原曲（没有 Roan）；奇怪的渴望就到此为止。

paras.en: Curious how Spotify’s AI DJ experience would compare, I upgraded my account to the premium tier for access to that beta software. One of the biggest recent changes to Spotify’s AI DJ was adding new voices to the lineup, so I went into my settings and played the introduction clips for each of the eight English-language voices.
paras.zh: 我很好奇 Spotify 的 AI DJ 体验会如何比较，因此我将我的帐户升级到高级级别以访问该测试版软件。 Spotify 的 AI DJ 最近最大的变化之一是在阵容中添加了新的声音，因此我进入我的设置并播放了八种英语声音中每一种的介绍剪辑。

paras.en: Maybe I was already a bit miffed from my YouTube Music experience because these voices immediately started to frustrate me. Multiple voices leaned into filler words such as “you know” and “like,” as the AI described the next songs it would play. Knowing an AI voice is being trained to use filler words to sound more human gave me the uncanny-valley ick.
paras.zh: 也许我已经对 YouTube Music 体验感到有点恼火了，因为这些声音立即开始让我感到沮丧。当人工智能描述它将要播放的下一首歌曲时，多个声音倾向于使用“你知道”和“喜欢”等填充词。知道人工智能的声音正在被训练使用填充词来听起来更人性化，这让我产生了一种恐怖谷般的恶心。

paras.en: Spotify’s AI DJ was fairly different from YouTube Music’s version. On Spotify, the AI DJ is also an algorithmically guided experience that picks songs for you based on past listening habits and song requests. Overall, Spotify’s synthetic commentary felt tighter and more tolerable than YouTube’s blabbering DJ. That said, neither software experience was enjoyable enough for me to return.
paras.zh: Spotify 的 AI DJ 与 YouTube Music 的版本有很大不同。在 Spotify 上，AI DJ 也是一种算法引导的体验，可以根据过去的收听习惯和歌曲请求为您挑选歌曲。总体而言，Spotify 的综合评论比 YouTube 喋喋不休的 DJ 感觉更紧凑、更容易忍受。也就是说，这两种软件的体验都不足以让我再次回来。

paras.en: Although Spotify claims it has “80 percent of listeners coming back to DJ week after week,” according to the company’s launch blog, I won’t be one of them. My rejection of AI DJs isn’t based on how they audibly sound. The voices, from both companies, are decent and sound convincingly human. The content of their commentary is what truly turns me off. Whether it’s empty platitudes or mimicking human mistakes, I’ve heard enough.
paras.zh: 尽管 Spotify 声称，根据该公司的发布博客，“80% 的听众每周都会回归 DJ”，但我不会成为其中之一。我对人工智能 DJ 的拒绝并不是因为他们听起来如何。两家公司的声音都很体面，听起来也很人性化。他们评论的内容真正让我感到厌烦。无论是空洞的陈词滥调还是模仿人类的错误，我已经听够了。

articles.title: The 4 Best Planners of 2027: Roterunner, Hobonichi, Cloth & Paper
articles.author: Nena Farrell

paras.en: There’s nothing like the feeling of a brand-new planner, and I've found the best planners if you're shopping for something new for 2027. Whether you're looking to get a little more organized or just love having somewhere to write everything down, the beginning of the year is a great time for a fresh start, and most planner companies have their 2027 planner designs already available.
paras.zh: 没有什么比全新的计划本更好的感觉了，如果您要为 2027 年购买新的东西，我已经找到了最好的计划本。无论您是想要更有条理，还是只是喜欢有地方写下所有内容，年初都是重新开始的好时机，大多数计划本公司都已经提供了 2027 年计划本设计。

paras.en: The world of planners might seem simple if you've only browsed your local Target or bookstore to see what planners they might have on hand. But there's a wide world of options out there that can perfectly suit your needs, especially if you're willing to build your own travel notebook or write in the dates on an undated paper planner, or open to trying your first Japanese-style planner.
paras.zh: 如果您只是浏览当地的 Target 或书店，看看他们手头上可能有哪些规划师，那么规划师的世界可能看起来很简单。但是，有很多选择可以完全满足您的需求，特别是如果您愿意制作自己的旅行笔记本或在未注明日期的纸质记事本上写下日期，或者愿意尝试您的第一个日式记事本。

paras.en: After years of testing and a constant stack of planners on my desk, I've found these standout favorite planner styles that could benefit everyone. If you're looking for a tech companion to your paper planner, check out my guides to the Best Digital Wall Calendars and Best Digital Notebooks to help keep your calendar and thoughts organized digitally.
paras.zh: 经过多年的测试和我办公桌上不断堆放的计划表，我发现了这些最受喜爱的计划表风格，可以使每个人受益。如果您正在为您的纸质计划器寻找技术伴侣，请查看我的最佳数字挂历和最佳数字笔记本指南，以帮助您以数字方式组织日历和想法。

paras.en: Updated November 2026: I've updated the information in this guide to reflect planner availability as 2026 comes to an end and 2027 designs become available. I'm also currently testing 2027 designs from Plum Paper, Laurel Denise, My PA Planner, and Sterling Ink, plus an undated design of Aura Estelle if you're looking for a planner you can start using in December 2026 into the new year.
paras.zh: 2026 年 11 月更新：我更新了本指南中的信息，以反映 2026 年即将结束且 2027 年设计可用时规划师的可用性。我目前还在测试 Plum Paper、Laurel Denise、My PA Planner 和 Sterling Ink 的 2027 年设计，如果您正在寻找可以在 2026 年 12 月开始使用的计划本并进入新的一年，还可以测试 Aura Estelle 的未注明日期的设计。

paras.en: If you need a single planner that can do it all and won't burn through your back-to-school budget, this is the one. The Roterunner Purpose Planner is an undated planner that has monthly spreads, weekly spreads, and two full open pages for each week, so there's plenty of room to write longer lists or a project brainstorm. Each monthly and weekly spread has a ton of premade checklist sections for you to use, too. There's even space to track your meals, water intake, and gratitude. It's a planner that actually helps me stay organized and gives me space to track and take notes without running out of room.
paras.zh: 如果您需要一个可以完成所有工作并且不会消耗您的返校预算的规划师，那么这就是您的最佳选择。 Roterunner Purpose Planner 是一款没有日期的计划表，有每月跨页、每周跨页以及每周两个完整的开放页面，因此有足够的空间来编写更长的列表或项目头脑风暴。每个月度和周度都有大量预制清单部分供您使用。甚至还有空间可以记录您的膳食、饮水量和感激之情。它是一个计划工具，实际上可以帮助我保持井井有条，并为我提供空间来跟踪和记笔记，而不会耗尽空间。

paras.en: The undated nature makes it easy to pick up anytime and use for whichever months you need. Fell off the boat for a few months? No problem. No pages will go to waste when you can fill them in as you go. It only covers six months, but I actually like that; it once again feels like a feasible commitment, especially if you're waffling on how much paper planner you want to promise to use. I love the massive B5 size ($35) since it's finally enough space for me and all my various to-do lists and brainstorms, but there's also a smaller (and cheaper!) A5 ($28) size. It's truly my go-to planner since it has so much space for me to both use the pre-made lists and the open space to actually stay organized and put all my ideas, plans, and notes into one planner. Most others make me feel like I need a companion notebook, but not the Roterunner.
paras.zh: 未注明日期的性质使您可以随时轻松拿起并在您需要的任何月份使用。从船上掉下来几个月了？没问题。当您可以边填写边填写时，任何页面都不会浪费。它只涵盖六个月，但我真的很喜欢；这再次感觉像是一个可行的承诺，尤其是当你对承诺使用多少纸质计划表犹豫不决时。我喜欢巨大的 B5 尺寸（35 美元），因为它终于有足够的空间容纳我和我所有的各种待办事项列表和头脑风暴，但还有更小（更便宜！）的 A5（28 美元）尺寸。它确实是我的首选计划表，因为它有足够的空间让我可以使用预制列表和开放空间来真正保持井井有条，并将我所有的想法、计划和笔记放入一个计划表中。大多数其他笔记本让我觉得我需要一个配套笔记本，但 Roterrunner 不需要。

paras.en: The covers come in a variety of simple colors, and in both hard cover or soft, but the butter-soft faux leather soft cover is my favorite of the bunch. Get it in B5 size if you're always looking for more room in your journals and planners—you won't regret it.
paras.zh: 封面有各种简单的颜色，有硬封面或软封面，但黄油般柔软的人造皮革软封面是我最喜欢的。如果您总是在日记和记事本中寻找更多空间，请选择 B5 尺寸 — 您不会后悔的。

paras.en: If you're getting into planners, there's no way you won't hear about Hobonichi at some point. There are a few different planners the brand makes, with the Techo being the most popular model. I tested the similar Hobonichi Cousin, which adds weekly spreads to the front of the planner after the monthly overviews. While I don't typically prefer a daily planner style, I was surprised by how much I liked using the Hobonichi. All of Hobonichi's planners use Tomoe River S paper, which is super thin but won't bleed through to the other side. It's also super smooth to the touch and to write on. I liked adding my own structure to the daily pages; I sketched a box to separate my to-do lists and habit trackers from my hourly agenda for the day, and then would usually freeform the rest of the page based on what was on my mind. The Cousin I tested and photographed is an A5 size, while the standard Techo is the smaller A6.
paras.zh: 如果您正在从事规划工作，那么您不可能在某些时候不会听说 Hobonichi。该品牌生产了几种不同的记事本，其中 Techo 是最受欢迎的型号。我测试了类似的 Hobonichi Cousin，它在每月概述之后将每周传播添加到计划表的前面。虽然我通常不喜欢每日计划表风格，但我对使用 Hobonichi 的喜爱程度感到惊讶。 Hobonichi 的所有策划师都使用 Tomoe River S 纸，这种纸超薄，但不会渗透到另一面。它的触感和书写也非常光滑。我喜欢在每日页面中添加自己的结构；我画了一个框，将我的待办事项列表和习惯跟踪器与当天的每小时议程分开，然后通常会根据我的想法自由设计页面的其余部分。我测试和拍摄的Cousin是A5尺寸，而标准Techo是较小的A6尺寸。

paras.en: Hobonichi's 2027 editions are here, so you can stock up on your planner for next year right now, plus tons of colors, covers, and other accessories, some of which are unique to 2027. I recommend picking out a protective cover since I did ding up my soft cover quite a bit, and that was just from being used around the house with an occasional trip in a bag. There are little quotes in the corners, but I got a Japanese version instead of an English one, so I can't actually read mine. But honestly, I'm glad I did; I prefer the Japanese lettering to English words on the corners of each page.
paras.zh: Hobonichi 的 2027 年版本已经上市，所以您现在就可以储备明年的计划本，还有大量的颜色、封面和其他配件，其中一些是 2027 年独有的。我建议挑选一个保护套，因为我经常把我的软封面弄坏，而这只是因为偶尔在包里旅行时在家里使用。角落里几乎没有引文，但我得到的是日文版本而不是英文版本，所以我实际上无法阅读我的。但说实话，我很高兴我这么做了；与每页角上的英文单词相比，我更喜欢日文字母。

paras.en: I've been obsessed with travel notebooks this year. A travel notebook uses bands to connect three or four notebooks together, and I love using this system to build a customized planner designed for my exact needs. It makes it easy to change the design, too, since you can just switch out a single notebook when it's full.
paras.zh: 今年我迷上了旅行笔记本。旅行笔记本使用带子将三到四个笔记本连接在一起，我喜欢使用这个系统来构建一个专为我的确切需求而设计的定制计划本。它还可以轻松更改设计，因为您只需在笔记本装满时将其更换即可。

paras.en: I really like Cloth & Paper's Travel Notebook Collection. There are 13 different notebooks you can choose from to include in your travel notebook, ranging from classic weekly and monthly spreads to more unique options like a daily wellness notebook and a task planner. It's really a great option if you want a couple of specific things, or even just a regular monthly and weekly notebook plus a blank notebook in the back you can fill with to-do lists and replace anytime without needing an entirely new planner. It's great for students, too, because you can have a notebook dedicated to tracking your assignments and syllabus for the semester. You'll need to create your own, though, as Cloth & Paper doesn't have a dedicated academic notebook for you to select.
paras.zh: 我非常喜欢 Cloth & Paper 的旅行笔记本系列。您可以选择 13 种不同的笔记本纳入您的旅行笔记本中，从经典的每周和每月笔记本到更独特的选项，例如每日健康笔记本和任务计划表。如果您想要一些特定的事情，或者甚至只是一个常规的每月和每周笔记本加上后面的空白笔记本，您可以填写待办事项列表并随时更换，而不需要全新的计划表，这确实是一个不错的选择。这对学生来说也很棒，因为你可以有一个笔记本专门用来跟踪你的学期作业和教学大纲。不过，您需要创建自己的笔记本，因为 Cloth & Paper 没有专门的学术笔记本供您选择。

paras.en: I tried both the A5 Slim and the Pocket Plus size, and I really prefer the A5 Slim for a traditional planner experience. The Pocket Plus would be fun to bring on a trip; I wish I'd had it on my latest trip to store little mementos and important things like parking receipts, and could have also written out notes and the plan for the week-long trip. But otherwise, the larger A5 slim was much easier to write on and use for my daily notes and planning.
paras.zh: I tried both the A5 Slim and the Pocket Plus size, and I really prefer the A5 Slim for a traditional planner experience.带上Pocket Plus去旅行会很有趣；我希望我最近一次旅行时能用它来存放小纪念品和停车收据等重要物品，并且还可以写下笔记和为期一周的旅行计划。 But otherwise, the larger A5 slim was much easier to write on and use for my daily notes and planning.

paras.en: You'll want the Clear Vinyl Travel Notebook Cover ($23 to $25) no matter which size you choose, which includes elastic bindings to bring all the notebooks you buy together, and you can also pick up more colorful elastic options to add a little more personality to your planner.
paras.zh: 无论您选择哪种尺寸，您都需要透明乙烯基旅行笔记本套（23 至 25 美元），其中包括弹性装订，可将您购买的所有笔记本放在一起，您还可以选择更多彩色弹性选项，为您的记事本增添更多个性。

paras.en: I've heard a lot of good things about Erin Condren. Founded in 2005 by Erin Condren, it's known for the LifePlanner that's full of various spreads and productivity tools that you can customize, but there are other variations of planners you can find from the brand. While you'll usually customize your Erin Condren planner if you shop directly on the site, there's a predesigned Target line you can shop that won't give you options, but will give you a well-made planner that's ready to go immediately.
paras.zh: 我听说过很多关于艾琳·康德伦的好消息。该公司由 Erin Condren 于 2005 年创立，以 LifePlanner 闻名，其中充满了您可以定制的各种利差和生产力工具，但您还可以从该品牌找到其他不同的规划工具。如果您直接在网站上购物，通常会定制您的 Erin Condren 规划本，但您可以购买预先设计的 Target 系列，它不会为您提供选择，但会给您一个制作精良的规划本，可以立即使用。

paras.en: I've been testing the Erin Condren Academic Planner you'll find at Target, but it's sold out as we head into the new year; Erin Condren's website has similar, but more expensive options with more cover and customization options. This base version from Target is a great fit for students and people with deadline-style or client-based work they want to organize. Each month has two pages following the monthly spread to set your most important to-dos and dates, but also a full page to track the month's deadlines and what class (or client, or in my case, story beat) they're for. After that, there are weekly spreads with long columns for each day, and seven blocks of four lines that you can label with things like specific classes, clubs, or organizations, or parenting and household tasks, as I track. It's been a really easy planner to add into my lifestyle, even though it's made for students. There's a class tracker in the front of the planner, too, which I skipped using, plus a detailed holiday calendar, and the back has project and exam pages, plus blank note pages, and even a simple sheet of stickers with things like “Exam,” “Midterm,” and “Paper Due.”
paras.zh: 我一直在测试 Erin Condren 学术规划师，你可以在 Target 找到它，但随着我们进入新的一年，它已经卖完了；艾琳·康德伦 (Erin Condren) 的网站有类似的选项，但价格更高，有更多封面和定制选项。 Target 的这个基础版本非常适合学生和想要组织截止日期风格或基于客户的工作的人。每个月在每月的跨页之后都有两页来设置您最重要的待办事项和日期，还有一个完整的页面来跟踪该月的截止日期以及它们所在的班级（或客户，或者在我的情况下，故事节拍）。之后，每周都有长栏，每天都有长栏，还有七块四行，你可以用我跟踪的特定班级、俱乐部或组织、或育儿和家务任务等标签。尽管它是为学生设计的，但它确实是一个非常容易添加到我的生活方式中的规划器。计划本的前面还有一个课程跟踪器，我没有使用它，再加上详细的假期日历，后面有项目和考试页，加上空白笔记页，甚至还有一张简单的贴纸，上面写着“考试”、“期中考试”和“到期论文”等内容。

paras.en: Academic planners usually start in August, so you probably don't want a planner like this if you want something fresh for the new year. But it's still my favorite I've tried if it's your preferred style. Erin Condren does have annual layouts and its popular LifePlanner designs available in 2027 layouts, and other specific designs like budget planners and teacher lesson planners if you're looking for something specific, too.
paras.zh: 学术规划师通常在八月开始，所以如果你想在新的一年里有一些新鲜的东西，你可能不需要这样的规划师。但如果这是你喜欢的风格，它仍然是我尝试过的最喜欢的。 Erin Condren 确实有年度布局及其流行的 LifePlanner 设计（2027 年布局），以及其他特定设计，例如预算规划器和教师课程规划器（如果您也在寻找特定的东西）。

paras.en: Like I said, there's a huge world of planners out there. Here are a few that the Reviews team and I at WIRED have tested and enjoyed.
paras.zh: 就像我说的，规划者的世界非常广阔。以下是《连线》的评论团队和我已经测试过并喜欢的一些内容。

paras.en: Agendio Basic Planner starting at $48: This is a completely customizable planner. I liked it, and you have the option to design your own pages, and the folder-style cover will protect both the pages and binding. I didn't love the customization tools or abilities as much as I wanted to, and there are a lot of steps to create your planner. I preferred the custom tools of Plum Paper over it. It's a good planner if the pages and binder-style are what you're looking for, and you can find some preset options that usually start around $48 for the smallest page size and black-and-white print.
paras.zh: Agendio Basic Planner 起价 48 美元：这是一款完全可定制的规划器。我喜欢它，您可以选择设计自己的页面，文件夹式封面将保护页面和装订。我并不像我想要的那样喜欢定制工具或功能，并且创建计划表有很多步骤。与它相比，我更喜欢 Plum Paper 的自定义工具。如果您正在寻找页面和活页夹样式，那么它是一个很好的计划工具，并且您可以找到一些预设选项，最小页面尺寸和黑白打印的起价通常约为 48 美元。

paras.en: Ban.do 12-Month Planner for $20: If you're looking for another affordable option but want something with more personality than the Roterunner above, Ban.do's planners are fun and colorful and even come with a page of stickers. It's only a horizontal weekly format, though, which I don't love (but maybe you do!) and the 2027 12-Month designs are now available.
paras.zh: Ban.do 12 个月计划表，售价 20 美元：如果您正在寻找另一种价格实惠的选择，但想要比上面的 Roterunner 更有个性的东西，Ban.do 的计划表既有趣又丰富多彩，甚至还附带一页贴纸。不过，这只是横向的每周格式，我不喜欢（但也许你喜欢！），2027 年 12 个月的设计现已推出。

paras.en: Happy Planner 12-Month Planner for $33: Happy Planner uses disc-bound planners to make it easy to remove and add pages or covers, which is nice for customizability. But they're a very specific aesthetic, and personally, I didn't love turning pages on the discs. Still, it's a good planner if you like the style, and they come in a ton of different layouts. Right now, you can get a Happy Planner that starts in July 2026 and will run you until June 2027, perfect for tracking the academic year.
paras.zh: Happy Planner 12 个月计划表，售价 33 美元：Happy Planner 使用光盘装订计划表，可以轻松删除和添加页面或封面，这非常适合定制。但它们是一种非常具体的审美，就我个人而言，我不喜欢在光盘上翻页。尽管如此，如果您喜欢这种风格，它仍然是一个很好的计划工具，而且它们有很多不同的布局。现在，您可以获得一个从 2026 年 7 月开始一直运行到 2027 年 6 月的 Happy Planner，非常适合跟踪学年。

paras.en: Laurel Denise Nancy Academic Planner for $44: These planners are cool because you'll look at the month and your weekly at the same time, as the slim weekly pages lay on top of the monthly spread. However, I write way, way too much for the space in these planners, at least for the Nancy design I tested previously. It's great if you just want to write a couple to-dos and meetings per day, but if you want space for detailed lists, you might feel the way I did. I'm currently testing the 2027 Luna ($62) and Scout ($62) planners from Laurel Denise to see if I still feel the same way compared to the original design.
paras.zh: Laurel Denise Nancy 学术计划表，售价 44 美元：这些计划表很酷，因为你可以同时查看月份和每周，因为纤薄的每周页面位于每月跨页之上。然而，对于这些规划器中的空间，我写得太多了，至少对于我之前测试的南希设计来说是这样。如果您只想每天写几个待办事项和会议，那么这很好，但如果您需要空间来列出详细列表，您可能会和我有同样的感觉。我目前正在测试 Laurel Denise 的 2027 年 Luna（62 美元）和 Scout（62 美元）规划师，看看与原始设计相比我是否仍然有同样的感觉。

paras.en: Leuchtturm1917 12-Month Ruled Planner for $29: This is a solid, minimalist planner that has a popular following. It's a simple horizontal weekly layout with the week on one side and a lined page on the other. It's not enough space for everything I write down, but if you're looking for something simple and space for a couple of lists or notes for each week that fit onto a page, it's a good option for you. Leuchtturm1917 also has a nice line of notebooks that look the same from the outside cover, so make sure you actually get the planner.
paras.zh: Leuchtturm1917 12 个月规则计划表，售价 29 美元：这是一款坚固、简约的计划表，深受追随者欢迎。这是一个简单的水平每周布局，一侧是星期，另一侧是横线页面。它没有足够的空间来容纳我写下的所有内容，但如果您正在寻找一些简单的东西，并且需要足够的空间来容纳每周在一页上放置的几个列表或笔记，那么这对您来说是一个不错的选择。 Leuchtturm1917 还拥有一系列精美的笔记本电脑，从外盖看，这些笔记本电脑看起来都一样，因此请确保您确实拿到了记事本。

paras.en: Muji Undated Weekly Planner for $7: If you want a super simple, super affordable planner, the Muji Undated Weekly is for you. It's just undated weekly horizontal spreads from front to back, even on the paper cover. It's slim, but still more than a year's worth of weeks in it. It's the most minimalist planner I've tried, and though I'm not a fan of horizontal weekly spreads for my planner needs, it's a great cheap option for a lot of people.
paras.zh: Muji Undated Weekly Planner 售价 7 美元：如果您想要一个超级简单、超级实惠的计划，那么 Muji Undated Weekly 非常适合您。这只是未注明日期的每周从前到后的水平跨页，甚至在纸质封面上也是如此。它很薄，但仍然比一年多的时间要长。这是我尝试过的最简约的计划程序，尽管我不喜欢水平每周传播以满足我的计划程序需求，但对于很多人来说，它是一个非常便宜的选择。

paras.en: Papier Hardcover 2027 Planner for $40: My favorite thing about Papier's planners is how gorgeous the covers are. Papier has a range of beautiful designs you can choose that feel like they belong on a bookshelf rather than just my planner. I tested one of the annual planners, which has the horizontal weekly layout I don't love on any planner (and you can still get that by choosing the mid-year layout for any cover Papier has if you love that style), but the academic one ($29) has a vertical layout that's much more up my alley. Whichever style you like, you can pick. Papier also has softcover academic planners ($32) that use a ring binding, which is easier to lay open than the hard cover binding, and still has both mid-year and academic layout options.
paras.zh: Papier 2027 年精装记事本售价 40 美元：Papier 记事本我最喜欢的一点是其封面非常华丽。 Papier 有一系列精美的设计可供您选择，感觉它们适合放在书架上，而不仅仅是我的计划表。我测试了其中一款年度计划表，它具有我在任何计划表上都不喜欢的水平每周布局（如果你喜欢 Papier 的任何封面，你仍然可以通过选择年中布局来获得这种风格），但学术计划表（29 美元）具有垂直布局，这更合我的胃口。你喜欢哪种风格，都可以选择。 Papier 还有平装学术计划手册（32 美元），采用环形装订，比精装装订更容易打开，并且仍然有年中和学术布局选项。

paras.en: Passion Planner 2027 Planner for $50: This planner was really popular when I was in college, and maybe it still is with the college kids. I liked it, but I feel like the Purpose Planner does a similar thing but better, at least for my needs. It's got vertical spread, but every slot is timed, so I can't use it as a to-do list. It's great for anyone needing to plan out a super detailed schedule and has some to-do list spaces on the bottom, but they're pretty small in my opinion to work for an entire week. It's good for students who only want to track their busy schedules and a couple assignments and tasks for each week.
paras.zh: Passion Planner 2027 Planner 售价 50 美元：这个计划本在我上大学时非常受欢迎，也许现在仍然受到大学生的欢迎。我喜欢它，但我觉得目的规划器做了类似的事情，但更好，至少满足我的需求。它有垂直分布，但每个时段都是定时的，所以我不能将它用作待办事项列表。对于任何需要计划超级详细的日程安排并在底部有一些待办事项列表空间的人来说，这非常有用，但在我看来，它们很小，足以工作一整周。对于只想跟踪繁忙的日程安排以及每周的一些作业和任务的学生来说，这非常有用。

paras.en: Looking for what to pair with your planner? Here are some of our team's favorite daily tools and planner accessories.
paras.zh: 正在寻找与您的规划师搭配的物品吗？以下是我们团队最喜欢的一些日常工具和计划配件。

paras.en: Passion Planner Passion Highlighters for $20: If your planner could use a little color, I really like Passion Planner's highlighter sets. They're nice and thin-tipped to fit into slim planner lines, and I especially like the vintage colors for adding color without it feeling neon-bright. You can use the highlighters to organize your plans by type (I like to do red for work, blue for my kid, yellow for things like doctor's appointments, and green for my social life) or color-code your class subjects like we used to do with ringed notebooks.
paras.zh: Passion Planner Passion荧光笔售价20美元：如果你的计划者可以使用一点颜色，我真的很喜欢Passion Planner的荧光笔套装。它们很漂亮，尖端很薄，适合细长的规划线，我特别喜欢复古的颜色，可以增加色彩，但又不会感觉霓虹灯般明亮。您可以使用荧光笔按类型组织您的计划（我喜欢为工作使用红色，为我的孩子使用蓝色，为医生预约等使用黄色，为我的社交生活使用绿色），或者像我们过去使用环形笔记本一样对课程主题进行颜色编码。

paras.en: Pilot Metropolitan Fountain Pen for $34: I never understood the appeal of a fountain pen until I bought one. A properly smoothed fountain pen nib requires very little pressure to write with and seems to glide across the page with a soft, satisfying scratching sound. I know, I'm one of those people now. Much of my initial skepticism came from the perceived complexity of caring for and using a fountain pen, which is very much overblown. My favorite pen of the dozen I've tested is the Pilot Metropolitan with the fine nib. It's easy to work with, taking either prefilled ink cartridges, which you can pop in and out without ever spilling any ink, or you can fill it yourself using a converter and the ink of your choice. I started off using the cartridges, but eventually my quest for a waterproof ink led me to the converter and this sketching ink. Once a week or so, I dip the Metropolitan nib in the bottle of ink and twist the converter to fill the chamber with ink—that's all there is to it. Whichever fountain pen you find works best for you, you’ll find you'll have a quite simply better writing experience. —Scott Gilbertson
paras.zh: Pilot Metropolitan 钢笔售价 34 美元：在我买了一支钢笔之前，我从来没有理解钢笔的吸引力。光滑的钢笔笔尖只需很小的压力即可书写，并且在纸上滑动时会发出轻柔、令人满意的刮擦声。我知道，我现在就是这些人中的一员。我最初的怀疑很大程度上来自于对保养和使用钢笔的复杂性的感知，这种看法被过分夸大了。在我测试过的十几支钢笔中，我最喜欢的是带有精美笔尖的 Pilot Metropolitan。使用起来很简单，可以使用预填充墨盒，您可以将其弹出或弹出而不会溢出任何墨水，也可以使用转换器和您选择的墨水自行填充。我开始使用墨盒，但最终我对防水墨水的追求让我找到了转换器和这种素描墨水。大约每周一次，我将 Metropolitan 笔尖浸入墨水瓶中，然后旋转转换器，将墨水填充到笔室中——仅此而已。无论您找到最适合您的钢笔，您都会发现您将获得更好的书写体验。 ——斯科特·吉尔伯森

paras.en: Plum Paper Seasonal Stickers for $10: There are a lot of stickers out there you could use for your planners, but my favorites—especially for the holidays—are from Plum Paper. They're beautiful and fun, and are mostly nice and small to fit into small lines or monthly charts without eating up the entire section. I like that there's a mix of shapes and styles, and you can also shop stickers for themes like home, fitness, wellness, and baby milestones. You can even make your own custom stickers (starting at $12), which are only thick line-style stickers where you can customize the word and icon on them. Still, very handy!
paras.zh: Plum Paper 季节性贴纸，售价 10 美元：有很多贴纸可供您用于计划表，但我最喜欢的贴纸（尤其是假期贴纸）来自 Plum Paper。它们既漂亮又有趣，而且大多又漂亮又小，可以放入小线或月度图表中，而不会占用整个部分。我喜欢它的形状和风格的混合，你还可以购买家居、健身、健康和婴儿里程碑等主题的贴纸。您甚至可以制作自己的自定义贴纸（起价 12 美元），这些贴纸只是粗线式贴纸，您可以自定义上面的文字和图标。不过，非常方便！

paras.en: Not everyone needs or wants a rigid planner. If you just need daily to-do lists or are a fan of bullet journals, consider getting a great notebook instead.
paras.zh: Not everyone needs or wants a rigid planner.如果您只需要每日待办事项列表或者是子弹日记的粉丝，请考虑购买一本很棒的笔记本。

paras.en: Maybe you just want a plain, lined notebook. One of our former reviewers recommended the Midori MD Notebook, and I found it to be a nice small size if you're looking for something minimal. It comes in lined, unlined, or dot-grid, and uses paper made from cotton pulp (just like money!) Midori’s notebooks are designed to fit inside notebook or journal covers (which you can find all over Etsy). The pages are a subtle off-white and have a weight and texture that draw you in.
paras.zh: 也许您只想要一本普通的、有横线的笔记本。我们的一位前评论家推荐了 Midori MD 笔记本，如果您正在寻找最小的东西，我发现它是一个不错的小尺寸。它有带衬里、无衬里或点网格形式，并使用棉浆制成的纸张（就像钱一样！）Midori 的笔记本设计用于放入笔记本或日记本封面（您可以在 Etsy 上找到）。这些页面是微妙的灰白色，具有吸引您的重量和纹理。

paras.en: One of our reviewers skips a planner entirely and instead writes down his to-do list on a 3-by-5 index card. He puts that index card into his pocket with a pocket-sized memo book like this one from Field Notes ($13 for three), where he jots down notes throughout the day to use for the next day's to-do list. Both the notebook and index cards fit inside a waxed canvas notebook cover to keep them safe from the elements (or just his pocket). It's an affordable and easy-to-manage system.
paras.zh: 我们的一位审阅者完全跳过了计划表，而是将他的待办事项清单写在一张 3×5 的索引卡上。他把索引卡和一本口袋大小的备忘录一起放进口袋里，就像 Field Notes 上的一本（三本 13 美元），他在其中记下一天的笔记，以用于第二天的待办事项清单。笔记本和索引卡都装在打蜡的帆布笔记本封面内，以确保它们免受恶劣天气（或只是他的口袋）的影响。这是一个经济实惠且易于管理的系统。

paras.en: Studies show that it's good for your brain to write things down. Sure, you could put your calendar in an online tool, but putting pen to paper activates more brain connectivity. We're more likely to remember and learn things if we write them down by hand, so using a paper planner for your to-do list can make it easier to remember. Plus, it's fun! You're given a creative space to let out everything you need to remember, from appointments to the day's tasks, and customize it in a way that best helps you stay organized.
paras.zh: 研究表明，把事情写下来对你的大脑有好处。当然，您可以将日历放入在线工具中，但是用笔写在纸上可以激活更多的大脑连接。如果我们手写下来，我们就更有可能记住和学习事物，因此使用纸质计划表来记下您的待办事项列表可以让您更容易记住。另外，这很有趣！您将获得一个创意空间，可以列出您需要记住的所有内容（从约会到当天的任务），并以最能帮助您保持井井有条的方式对其进行自定义。

paras.en: What Style Paper Planner Is Best for You?
paras.zh: 哪种风格的纸质记事本最适合您？

paras.en: Paper planners mainly come in two styles: weekly and daily. Daily planners have an entire page dedicated to each day, while weekly planners have an entire week spread across just two pages. These aren't the only options (monthly is another popular one, for example, but not as popular as these two styles), but they're the most common you'll see. I like daily planners for folks who have a really busy schedule they want to plan out, and long daily to-do lists. Weekly planners are great if you want to be able to write down a few things per day but don't need an entire page.
paras.zh: 纸质计划表主要有两种风格：每周和每日。每日计划者有一个完整的页面专门用于每一天，而每周计划者则只有两页，涵盖整个星期。这些不是唯一的选项（例如，每月是另一种流行的选项，但不如这两种样式流行），但它们是您会看到的最常见的选项。我喜欢每日计划表，适合那些日程安排非常繁忙、每日待办事项清单很长的人。如果您希望能够每天写下一些事情但不需要整页，那么每周计划表就非常有用。

paras.en: Here are a couple common planner sizes. My favorite are the larger sizes since I like lots of room to doodle, but the smaller A5 is a popular choice for a book-sized planner that won't take up too much space. Not all paper planners use the same sizing names—Moleskine, for example, calls its A5 size a large—so you'll want to check measurements before you purchase.
paras.zh: 以下是一些常见的规划师尺寸。我最喜欢的是较大的尺寸，因为我喜欢有足够的空间来涂鸦，但较小的 A5 是书籍大小的记事本的流行选择，因为它不会占用太多空间。并非所有纸张规划器都使用相同的尺寸名称（例如，Moleskine 将其 A5 尺寸称为大号），因此您需要在购买前检查尺寸。

articles.title: Best Buy Gift Guide 2026: Best Tech Gifts From Sony, Sennheiser, HP and Amazon to Shop Online
articles.author: Rudie Obias

paras.en: All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.
paras.zh: 所有特色产品和服务均由编辑独立选择。然而，Billboard 可能会收到通过其零售链接下的订单的佣金，并且零售商可能会收到某些用于会计目的的可审计数据。

paras.en: The holidays are here, so now is the best time to get all of your shopping done before Christmas. Why wait until Black Friday, when the best tech products are available right now at Best Buy.
paras.zh: 假期到了，所以现在是在圣诞节前完成所有购物的最佳时机。为什么要等到黑色星期五，届时百思买 (Best Buy) 就有售最好的科技产品。

paras.en: The retailer is your one-stop shop for the best tech, thanks to the company’s convenient locations, friendly and help staff who can assist you with tech demos and ease of use when shopping in-store or online. Best Buy really melds the best of both worlds in retail.
paras.zh: 该零售商是您购买最佳技术的一站式商店，这要归功于该公司便利的地理位置、友好且乐于助人的员工，他们可以为您提供技术演示，并且在店内或网上购物时易于使用。百思买确实融合了零售业的优点。

paras.en: And, when it comes to offering the latest and greatest in tech, Best Buy has a variety of items from leading brands, such as Sony, Sennheiser, HP and Amazon. Scroll down and check out some of Shop Billboard’s top picks for the holiday season.
paras.zh: 而且，在提供最新、最先进的技术方面，百思买拥有来自索尼、森海塞尔、惠普和亚马逊等领先品牌的各种商品。向下滚动并查看 Shop Billboard 假日季的一些热门精选。

paras.en: At $599.99 at Best Buy, the Sony ZV-1F Compact Digital Camera is one of the best entry-level cameras that’s an all-in-one for digital photography and video capture. It’s ideal for beginners and casual use.
paras.zh: 索尼 ZV-1F 紧凑型数码相机在百思买的售价为 599.99 美元，是最好的入门级相机之一，它是数码摄影和视频拍摄的一体化产品。它非常适合初学者和休闲使用。

paras.en: The Sony Alpha 6100 APS-C Mirrorless Camera, which is priced at $949.99 at Best Buy, is a more advanced camera system for someone who wants to take their photography to the next level.
paras.zh: 索尼 Alpha 6100 APS-C 无反光镜相机在百思买的售价为 949.99 美元，对于那些想要将摄影提升到新水平的人来说，它是一款更先进的相机系统。

paras.en: For rich and robust personal audio, the Sennheiser MOMENTUM 5 Noise-Canceling Headphones, which are priced at $399.99 at Best Buy, are a must, especially with Bluetooth wireless settings.
paras.zh: 想要获得丰富而强劲的个人音频，森海塞尔 MOMENTUM 5 降噪耳机是必备之选，它在百思买的售价为 399.99 美元，尤其是在蓝牙无线设置方面。

paras.en: For a distraction-free TV watching experience, then go with the Sennheiser RS 275 TV Headphones, which are priced at $299.99 at Best Buy. The headphones offer clear and crisp audio, dialog enhanced settings and immersive listening when watching movies and TV shows.
paras.zh: 如果想要获得无干扰的电视观看体验，可以选择 Sennheiser RS 275 电视耳机，该耳机在百思买的售价为 299.99 美元。该耳机在观看电影和电视节目时提供清晰明快的音频、对话增强设置和身临其境的聆听体验。

paras.en: Priced at $179.99 at Best Buy, the HP OfficeJet Pro 8125 Inkjet Printer is a pro-level printer that’s best for a small business or heavy-duty printing at home.
paras.zh: HP OfficeJet Pro 8125 喷墨打印机在百思买的售价为 179.99 美元，是一款专业级打印机，最适合小型企业或家庭重型打印。

articles.title: Phoebe Bridgers Stuns With Haunting Black-Light Skeleton Performance on ‘SNL’: Watch
articles.author: Mitchell Peters

paras.en: Phoebe Bridgers returned to Saturday Night Live as musical guest on Nov. 14, delivering two performances from her latest album, Lost Weekend.
paras.zh: 11 月 14 日，菲比·布里杰斯 (Phoebe Bridgers) 作为音乐嘉宾重返《周六夜现场》，带来了她最新专辑《Lost Weekend》中的两场表演。

paras.en: During the John Mulaney-hosted episode, the 32-year-old indie-rock singer-songwriter performed “Bobby” and “Still Standing,” both featured on her third album, which debuted at No. 2 on the Billboard 200 in August.
paras.zh: 在约翰·木兰尼 (John Mulaney) 主持的节目中，这位 32 岁的独立摇滚歌手兼作曲家演唱了《Bobby》和《Still Standing》，这两首歌曲都是她的第三张专辑中的特色歌曲，该专辑于 8 月首次亮相就在公告牌 200 强排行榜上排名第二。

paras.en: Bridgers’ SNL appearance follows the late October release of her five-track EP, Live at Madison Square Garden, recorded during her 2023 performance at the New York City venue.
paras.zh: 布里杰斯在《周六夜现场》亮相之前，她于 10 月底发行了五首 EP《Live at Madison Square Garden》，该专辑是她 2023 年在纽约市演出期间录制的。

paras.en: For her first performance, the musician took the stage with a full backing band for “Bobby,” a lovestruck track presumably inspired by her relationship with comedian Bo Burnham. The song, which Burnham co-wrote and is believed to be inspired by their relationship, finds Bridgers exploring the excitement of falling in love.
paras.zh: 在她的第一次表演中，这位音乐家在乐队的全力伴奏下登台表演了《Bobby》，这首充满爱情的歌曲的灵感大概是受到了她与喜剧演员博·伯纳姆 (Bo Burnham) 的关系的启发。这首歌是伯纳姆共同创作的，据信是受到他们的关系的启发，布里杰斯探索了坠入爱河的兴奋。

paras.en: The boygenius artist returned later in the show for a haunting performance of “Still Standing,” which explores her complicated relationship with her father. Wearing a flowing white dress that glowed under black lights, Bridgers revealed skeletal face makeup that transformed the performance into an eerie visual.
paras.zh: 这位天才艺术家后来在节目中回归，表演了令人难忘的“Still Standing”，探讨了她与父亲的复杂关系。布里杰斯穿着一件在黑光下闪闪发光的飘逸白色连衣裙，露出骷髅脸妆，将表演变成了一种怪异的视觉效果。

paras.en: The skeletal look has become a recurring part of Bridgers’ visual aesthetic, particularly during the Punisher era, when she frequently wore skeleton bodysuits onstage.
paras.zh: 骷髅造型已经成为布里杰斯视觉审美中反复出现的一部分，尤其是在惩罚者时代，当时她经常在舞台上穿着骷髅连体衣。

paras.en: The appearance marked another memorable SNL moment for Bridgers, who previously made headlines during her 2021 performance of “Kyoto” when she famously smashed her guitar against a stage monitor at the end of the song.
paras.zh: 这次亮相标志着布里杰斯在《周六夜现场》中又一个令人难忘的时刻，她此前曾在 2021 年演唱《京都》时登上头条，当时她在歌曲结尾时将吉他砸向舞台监视器。

paras.en: The NBC sketch comedy series is currently in its 52nd season, which premiered in September with New York Knicks star Jalen Brunson making his hosting debut and KATSEYE serving as musical guest.
paras.zh: NBC 喜剧小品系列目前已播出第 52 季，于 9 月首播，纽约尼克斯队球星贾伦·布伦森 (Jalen Brunson) 首次担任主持人，卡特西 (KATSEYE) 担任音乐嘉宾。

paras.en: SNL will now take a three-week break before returning Dec. 5 with Amanda Seyfried as host and Don Toliver as musical guest. The episode will mark Seyfried’s hosting debut and Toliver’s first appearance on the show.
paras.zh: SNL 现在将休息三周，然后于 12 月 5 日回归，阿曼达·塞弗里德 (Amanda Seyfried) 担任主持人，唐·托利弗 (Don Toliver) 担任音乐嘉宾。这一集将标志着塞弗里德首次主持节目，也是托利弗首次出现在该节目中。

paras.en: Watch Phoebe Bridgers perform “Bobby” and “Still Standing” on SNL below.
paras.zh: 请观看下面菲比·布里杰斯 (Phoebe Bridgers) 在《周六夜现场》中表演的《Bobby》和《Still Standing》。

articles.title: ‘SNL’ Sets December Return With Amanda Seyfried as Host & Don Toliver as Musical Guest
articles.author: Mitchell Peters

paras.en: Saturday Night Live will return in December with two first-timers taking the stage.
paras.zh: 《周六夜现场》将于 12 月回归，两位首次登台。

paras.en: Amanda Seyfried will make her hosting debut, while Don Toliver will perform as musical guest for the first time during the Dec. 5 episode.
paras.zh: 阿曼达·塞弗里德 (Amanda Seyfried) 将首次担任主持人，而唐·托利弗 (Don Toliver) 将在 12 月 5 日的剧集中首次作为音乐嘉宾表演。

paras.en: The NBC sketch comedy series is taking a three-week break following its Nov. 14 episode, hosted by John Mulaney with musical guest Phoebe Bridgers.
paras.zh: NBC 喜剧小品系列节目在 11 月 14 日播出后将暂停三周，由约翰·穆拉尼 (John Mulaney) 和音乐嘉宾菲比·布里杰斯 (Phoebe Bridgers) 主持。

paras.en: Seyfried’s hosting debut comes amid a busy stretch for the actress, who recently appeared in Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim’s You Can See Everything, the documentary about former Theranos CEO Elizabeth Holmes.
paras.zh: 塞弗里德的主持首秀正值这位女演员忙碌的时期，她最近出现在内森·菲尔德 (Nathan Fielder) 和兰斯·奥本海姆 (Lance Oppenheim) 执导的关于希拉洛斯前首席执行官伊丽莎白·霍姆斯 (Elizabeth Holmes) 的纪录片《你可以看到一切》(You Can See Everything) 中。

paras.en: Toliver’s SNL debut comes after a busy year for the Houston-born rapper and singer, who has continued teasing his next project, NITROUS, most recently with the release of “Party With the Boys.”
paras.zh: 出生于休斯敦的说唱歌手兼歌手托利弗 (Toliver) 在 SNL 首秀之前，这位出​​生于休斯敦的说唱歌手和歌手度过了忙碌的一年，他继续戏弄他的下一个项目《NITROUS》，最近发布了《Party With the Boys》。

paras.en: The upcoming album follows OCTANE, which debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 in February, marking his first chart-topper. He later took the project on a North American arena tour and teamed up with Drake on tracks “Cold Shoulder” and “Solar Eclipse.”
paras.zh: 这张即将发行的专辑是在《OCTANE》之后发行的，该专辑于 2 月份首次亮相就在 Billboard 200 排行榜上排名第一，这标志着他首次登顶排行榜。后来他带着这个项目进行了北美巡演，并与 Drake 合作制作了歌曲“Cold Shoulder”和“Solar Eclipse”。

paras.en: Toliver also graced the cover of Billboard in March 2026, discussing his career, creative process and rise in hip-hop. He is also among the artists featured in Billboard‘s early predictions for the 2027 Grammy Awards’ best new artist category.
paras.zh: Toliver 还登上了 2026 年 3 月的 Billboard 封面，讨论了他的职业生涯、创作过程和嘻哈音乐的崛起。他也是 Billboard 早期预测 2027 年格莱美奖最佳新人奖的艺术家之一。

paras.en: The upcoming episode will be part of SNL‘s 52nd season, which premiered Sept. 26 with New York Knicks star Jalen Brunson making his hosting debut and KATSEYE serving as musical guest.
paras.zh: 即将播出的剧集将是《周六夜现场》第 52 季的一部分，该季于 9 月 26 日首播，纽约尼克斯队球星贾伦·布伦森 (Jalen Brunson) 首次担任主持人，卡特西 (KATSEYE) 担任音乐嘉宾。

paras.en: Since then, the show has welcomed Dakota Johnson, Shane Gillis, Inde Navarrette, Druski and Mulaney as hosts, with Turnstile, Rosalía, Gracie Abrams, The Strokes and Bridgers among the season’s musical guests.
paras.zh: 此后，该节目迎来了达科塔·约翰逊、肖恩·吉利斯、因德·纳瓦雷特、德鲁斯基和穆拉尼担任主持人，特恩斯泰尔、罗莎莉亚、格雷西·艾布拉姆斯、The Strokes 和 Bridgers 都是本季的音乐嘉宾。

articles.title: Pitch Perfect: The 20 Best Music Schools in the World
articles.author: Lexy Perez

paras.en: Conservatories, typically built around intensive studio training in performance and composition rather than the broad general education requirements of a traditional college, made a strong showing in THR‘s annual look at the world’s best music schools. But schools with well-regarded media scoring programs, which teach composing for film, TV, video and gaming — USC Thornton, Eastman, Berklee and Columbia Chicago — retain their influence in Hollywood and beyond.
paras.zh: 音乐学院通常围绕表演和作曲方面的密集工作室培训而不是传统学院广泛的通识教育要求而建立，在 THR 年度全球最佳音乐学校评选中表现出色。但拥有备受推崇的媒体评分项目、教授电影、电视、视频和游戏作曲的学校——南加州大学桑顿分校、伊士曼分校、伯克利分校和哥伦比亚大学芝加哥分校——仍然在好莱坞及其他地区保持着影响力。

paras.en: David Serkin Ludwig, dean and director of the music division at Juilliard, which continues to expand its opportunities for media scoring, says that the grounding conservatories give their students is important in a world where AI is encroaching even on creative disciplines like music. “A great hedge against the replacement aspect of AI is having a very deep and thorough training, because you want depth of knowledge and experience for people using the tools,” he says. “So I’m happy with the direction we’re going, and we just have to keep staying current.”
paras.zh: 茱莉亚音乐学院院长兼音乐部门主任戴维·瑟金·路德维希（David Serkin Ludwig）表示，在人工智能甚至正在侵蚀音乐等创造性学科的世界里，音乐学院为学生提供的基础知识非常重要。该学院继续扩大媒体评分的机会。 “防止人工智能替代方面的一个重要手段是进行非常深入和彻底的培训，因为你需要使用这些工具的人拥有深度的知识和经验，”他说。 “所以我对我们前进的方向感到满意，我们只需要保持最新状态即可。”

paras.en: To see where that type of training is happening, we turned to the people working in the field. Contributing to this year’s ranked list via survey: the Society of Composers and Lyricists, the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences’ music branch, the Alliance for Women Film Composers and the Composers Diversity Collective. Thanks go to Ray Costa and Costa Communications for their help in distributing THR‘s survey.
paras.zh: 为了了解此类培训在哪里进行，我们向该领域的工作人员求助。通过调查对今年的排名做出贡献的有：作曲家和作词家协会、电影艺术与科学学院音乐分会、女性电影作曲家联盟和作曲家多元化集体。感谢 Ray Costa 和 Costa Communications 帮助分发 THR 的调查。

paras.en: Long a holdout on media scoring instruction, Juilliard now offers several courses, including Composing for Visual Media, which gives students the fundamental skills they need to compose for film and TV, as well as commercials and video games, with focuses on both traditional and more diverse contemporary approaches. Scoring to Picture is a two-credit course offered through the school’s extension division that covers spotting, or placement of music and sound in a project, scoring brief media excerpts and enhancing drama in film with music.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The school also has renovated and upgraded its film scoring labs and classrooms. “We’re aspiring to stay on the cutting edge of available technologies for them, so we’re doing a lot in interactive music technology as well,” says Serkin Ludwig, the dean and director of the music division. “So looking into motion sensors, other kinds of digital response tools but also just the software itself, and making platforms available for our students: laptops, cameras, all the devices and tools they need to create their own media.”
paras.zh: 学校还翻新和升级了电影配乐实验室和教室。 “我们渴望为他们保持在可用技术的最前沿，因此我们在互动音乐技术方面也做了很多工作，”音乐部门的院长兼总监 Serkin Ludwig 说。 “因此，我们不仅要研究运动传感器、其他类型的数字响应工具，还要研究软件本身，并为我们的学生提供可用的平台：笔记本电脑、相机以及他们创建自己的媒体所需的所有设备和工具。”

paras.en: NOTABLE ALUMNI John Williams (Star Wars); Philip Glass (The Hours)
paras.zh: 著名校友约翰·威廉姆斯（星球大战）；菲利普·格拉斯（时时刻刻）

paras.en: USC Thornton continues to thrive at the center of the Hollywood music community and offers a two-semester master’s degree program in screen scoring that recruits about 20 students a year for a deep dive into composition, orchestration, programming, conducting, producing and editing music for screen-based media. The program has been chaired by Jeanine Cowen since 2022. “We’re really trying to take advantage of our relationship with the cinema school,” Cowen says. “In September, we did a massive mock scoring session with 25 Thornton musicians and our composers, and we were just doing it so everybody could get a sense of what a scoring session is. The filmmakers are amazed because most of them have no idea what a live ensemble can do for their picture. So we’ll probably keep doing that because it was such a huge success.”
paras.zh: 南加州大学桑顿分校继续在好莱坞音乐界的中心蓬勃发展，并提供为期两个学期的屏幕配乐硕士学位课程，每年招收约 20 名学生，深入研究用于屏幕媒体的作曲、编曲、编程、指挥、制作和编辑音乐。该项目自 2022 年起一直由珍妮·考恩 (Jeanine Cowen) 主持。“我们确实在努力利用我们与电影学校的关系，”考恩说。 “9 月份，我们与 25 名桑顿音乐家和我们的作曲家进行了一次大规模的模拟配乐会议，我们这样做只是为了让每个人都能了解什么是配乐会议。电影制片人很惊讶，因为他们中的大多数人都不知道现场合奏可以为他们的影片带来什么。所以我们可能会继续这样做，因为它取得了巨大的成功。”

paras.en: While Los Angeles has faced challenges in employment and keeping jobs in town, Cowen says Hollywood’s creative culture is still vital: “Every session we’ve had so far, the pro studio players are all busy, so we’re not able to get our first call all the time, and it’s because there’s a lot going on in town that’s keeping musicians busy.”
paras.zh: 虽然洛杉矶在就业和保住工作方面面临挑战，但考恩表示，好莱坞的创意文化仍然至关重要：“到目前为止，我们举办的每一场演出，专业工作室的演奏者都很忙，所以我们无法一直接到第一个电话，这是因为城里发生了很多事情，让音乐家们很忙。”

paras.en: NOTABLE ALUMNI Bear McCreary (The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power); James Newton Howard (The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes)
paras.zh: 著名校友 Bear McCreary（《指环王：权力指环》）；詹姆斯·牛顿·霍华德（饥饿游戏：鸣禽与蛇之歌）

paras.en: University of Rochester’s Eastman School of Music continues to offer students both intensive conservatory training in performance and composition, as well as a renowned program for film and media scoring with funding and participation from prolific composer Jeff Beal (House of Cards, Monk) for the school’s Beal Institute for Film Music and Contemporary Media. Next year will see the school broaden the institute’s approach, as associate professor of music and technology Dennis DeSantis explains: “In an ever-evolving technological world, Eastman’s Beal Institute for Film Music and Contemporary Media is excited to reach beyond the traditional methods of composition by launching a new major in music creation and technology in fall 2027. With this program, we invite technologically curious musicians to explore new ways of creating and experiencing music, keeping Eastman’s world-class curriculum at the forefront of musical innovation.”
paras.zh: 罗切斯特大学伊士曼音乐学院继续为学生提供表演和作曲方面的强化音乐学院培训，以及由多产作曲家杰夫·比尔（《纸牌屋》、《蒙克》）资助和参与的著名电影和媒体配乐课程，该学院的比尔电影音乐和当代媒体学院也参与其中。明年，学校将扩大学院的研究范围，正如音乐和技术副教授丹尼斯·德桑蒂斯 (Dennis DeSantis) 所解释的那样：“在不断发展的技术世界中，伊士曼比尔电影音乐和当代媒体学院很高兴能够在 2027 年秋季开设音乐创作和技术新专业，从而超越传统的作曲方法。通过这个项目，我们邀请对技术充满好奇的音乐家探索创作和体验音乐的新方式，使伊士曼的世界一流课程始终处于音乐学科的前沿。创新”。

paras.en: NOTABLE ALUMNI Maria Schneider (Grammy-winning composer); Lew Soloff (jazz trumpeter)
paras.zh: 著名校友玛丽亚·施奈德（格莱美获奖作曲家）；卢·索洛夫（爵士小号手）

paras.en: Sean McMahon continues in his role as chair of screen scoring at Berklee, which includes two programs, Film and Media Scoring and Game and Interactive Media Scoring, both of which are four-year bachelor of music degrees. The school’s Next Gen Composer Lab is an immersive, five-day collaboration among Berklee Screen Scoring, the Boston Conservatory and the Vienna Symphonic Library. “Nine composers each get to conduct and record their original music with the 84-piece Vienna Synchron Orchestra, while two elite conservatory instrumentalists sit inside the orchestra itself, recording shoulder to shoulder with Europe’s finest session players,” McMahon says.
paras.zh: 肖恩·麦克马洪 (Sean McMahon) 继续担任伯克利分校的屏幕配乐系主任，其中包括两个项目：电影和媒体配乐以及游戏和互动媒体配乐，这两个项目都是四年制音乐学士学位。该校的下一代作曲家实验室是伯克利屏幕评分公司、波士顿音乐学院和维也纳交响乐图书馆之间为期五天的沉浸式合作项目。 “九位作​​曲家每人都可以与 84 名维也纳同步交响乐团一起指挥和录制他们的原创音乐，而两位精英音乐学院乐器演奏家则坐在乐团内部，与欧洲最优秀的演奏家并肩录制，”麦克马洪说。

paras.en: Berklee now also offers a Master of Arts in music supervision, the first of its kind in the world: a one-year, fully online graduate program covering the art of selecting, licensing and integrating music into TV, games and advertising and taught by music supervisor pros like Julia Michels (The Devil Wears Prada).
paras.zh: 伯克利现在还提供音乐监督文学硕士学位，这是世界上第一个此类课程：为期一年的完全在线研究生课程，涵盖音乐选择、许可以及将音乐融入电视、游戏和广告的艺术，由朱莉娅·米歇尔斯（《穿普拉达的女王》）等音乐总监专业人士教授。

paras.en: NOTABLE ALUMNI Alex Lacamoire (Tony winner for Hamilton); Howard Shore (The Lord of the Rings)
paras.zh: 著名校友 Alex Lacamoire（汉密尔顿托尼奖得主）；霍华德·肖尔（指环王）

paras.en: The Herb Alpert School offers media scoring training through its composition and theory program, in which student composers receive instruction in studio recording, counterpoint, global musicianship and orchestration. Students are encouraged to take advantage of interdisciplinary crossovers to collaborate with live performers, student film and media directors, and cross-cultural ensembles inspired by ethnomusicology and world jazz styles. New students must complete a music theory assessment examination to achieve placement in global musicianship and formal music theory classes.
paras.zh: 赫伯阿尔珀特学校通过其作曲和理论课程提供媒体配乐培训，学生作曲家在其中接受录音室录音、对位法、全球音乐技巧和管弦乐方面的指导。鼓励学生利用跨学科交叉的机会，与现场表演者、学生电影和媒体导演以及受民族音乐学和世界爵士乐风格启发的跨文化乐团合作。新生必须完成音乐理论评估考试，才能进入全球音乐和正式音乐理论课程。

paras.en: NOTABLE ALUMNI Joseph Trapanese (The Greatest Showman); Quincy Jones (Thriller)
paras.zh: 著名校友约瑟夫·特拉帕内塞（Joseph Trapanese）（《最伟大的表演家》）；昆西·琼斯（惊悚片）

paras.en: If you’re extremely talented, looking for premier conservatory training in the Los Angeles area and hard up for cash, Colburn offers elite undergraduate, graduate and postgraduate programs that concentrate on classical performance and repertoire — and a generous price break. All students receive a full-tuition scholarship and grants that cover room and board. Undergraduate programs include a four-year bachelor of music degree that offers studio performance training and courses on musical theory, music history, ear training and the humanities, with students completing both junior and senior solo recitals. The Performance Diploma is a four-year nondegree program for students with ambitions of professional performance but who do not yet have a bachelor’s degree. It’s essentially courses in theory, performance and ear training without the humanities requirements. Colburn also offers graduate programs including a two-year master of music with a focus on high-level instrumental mastery and advanced seminars in music history, theory and composition.
paras.zh: 如果您才华横溢，正在寻找洛杉矶地区一流的音乐学院培训，但又缺乏现金，科尔伯恩提供专注于古典表演和曲目的精英本科、研究生和研究生课程，并且价格优惠。所有学生都将获得全额学费奖学金和包括食宿费的助学金。本科课程包括四年制音乐学士学位，提供工作室表演培训以及音乐理论、音乐史、听力训练和人文课程，学生可以完成初级和高级独奏音乐会。表演文凭是一个为期四年的非学位课程，面向有专业表演抱负但尚未获得学士学位的学生。它本质上是理论、表演和视唱练耳的课程，没有人文学科的要求。科尔伯恩还提供研究生课程，包括为期两年的音乐硕士课程，重点关注高水平的乐器掌握以及音乐史、理论和作曲方面的高级研讨会。

paras.en: NOTABLE ALUMNI Kris Bowers (Bridgerton); Elias Peter Brown (conductor)
paras.zh: 著名校友克里斯·鲍尔斯（布里奇顿）；埃利亚斯·彼得·布朗（指挥）

paras.en: Royal College of Music offers a master’s degree in composition with a specialism in composition for screen — an advanced program that trains composers for professional careers through workshops, master classes, performance projects and collaborations with professional artists. The program is tailored to individual student needs and ambitions, with instruction from world-class professors and visiting artists. Electives include classes in orchestration, experimental music, conducting, music education, analysis and practical skills to keep students up to speed with constantly evolving digital technology and global perspectives. The school’s exchange program allows students to audition for the chance to study abroad during the fall term of their second year at the school.
paras.zh: 皇家音乐学院提供作曲硕士学位，专攻银幕作曲，这是一项高级课程，通过研讨会、大师班、表演项目以及与专业艺术家的合作，对作曲家进行专业职业培训。该项目根据学生的个人需求和抱负量身定制，并接受世界一流教授和访问艺术家的指导。选修课包括管弦乐、实验音乐、指挥、音乐教育、分析和实践技能课程，让学生跟上不断发展的数字技术和全球视野。学校的交换计划允许学生在第二年秋季学期试镜出国留学的机会。

paras.en: Each year, the school hosts a Composition for Screen Showcase featuring a live ensemble performing music written by students accompanying films projected on the big screen; it’s attended by the public and industry professionals.
paras.zh: 每年，学校都会举办一场屏幕作曲展示会，现场合奏团将演奏由学生创作的音乐，伴随着大屏幕上放映的电影；公众和行业专业人士出席。

paras.en: NOTABLE ALUMNI Andrew Lloyd Webber (The Phantom of the Opera); James Horner (Titanic)
paras.zh: 著名校友安德鲁·劳埃德·韦伯（《歌剧魅影》）；詹姆斯·霍纳（泰坦尼克号）

paras.en: In addition to its venerable Ivy League name, Yale boasts proximity to New York, Boston and the town of New Haven, giving students a rich cultural and artistic environment in which to take advantage of the school’s prestigious conservatory training. Yale offers a master of music, master of musical arts, doctor of musical arts and artist diploma in composition, with courses taught by concert hall composers including Katherine Balch, Martin Bresnick and Aaron Jay Kernis. While the school does not offer degree programs in media scoring, Yale’s Center for Collaborative Arts and Media helps students combine music with film, video, computer science and the visual arts.
