paras.zh: The Motley Fool 拥有 Visa 的股份并推荐该公司。

articles.title: The most beautiful sections of China's Great Wall

paras.en: Editor’s Note: Monthly Ticket is a CNN Travel series that spotlights some of the most fascinating topics in the travel world. In September, we’re celebrating superlatives as we look at some of the world’s biggest, tallest and most expensive attractions and destinations.
paras.zh: 编者注：《月票》是 CNN 的旅游系列节目，重点关注旅游界一些最有趣的话题。九月，当我们参观世界上一些最大、最高和最昂贵的景点和目的地时，我们正在庆祝最高级。

paras.en: Having lived in Beijing for almost 12 years, I’ve had plenty of time to travel widely in China.
paras.zh: 在北京生活了近12年，我有足够的时间去中国各地旅行。

paras.en: I’ve visited more than 100 cities, not to mention countless towns and villages throughout the mainland’s 31 provinces.
paras.zh: 我去过100多个城市，更不用说遍布大陆31个省份的无数城镇和村庄。

paras.en: Looking back, I’ve come to realize it was my frequent visits to different parts of the Great Wall in Beijing that were a driving force behind my desire to explore the rest of the country and, along with it, the many sections of wall that lie outside the capital’s boundaries.
paras.zh: 回想起来，我逐渐意识到，正是我对北京长城不同部分的频繁访问，推动了我探索中国其他地区以及首都边界之外的许多长城的愿望。

paras.en: Work on the Great Wall began more than 2,500 years ago, its origins dating back to China’s Spring and Autumn Period of around 770 BCE to 476 BCE. Various sections were added in subsequent eras as competing dynasties and factions sought to exert their control.
paras.zh: 长城的修建始于 2500 多年前，其起源可以追溯到公元前 770 年至公元前 476 年左右的中国春秋时期。在随后的时代中，随着相互竞争的王朝和派系试图施加控制，各个部分被添加。

paras.en: Work eventually stopped in the 17th century.
paras.zh: 工程最终于 17 世纪停止。

paras.en: Though not a single, unbroken structure, the wall spans over 21,000 kilometers, winding through 15 provinces, 97 prefectures and 404 counties.
paras.zh: 长城虽然不是一个完整的结构，但全长超过 21,000 公里，蜿蜒穿过 15 个省、97 个地区和 404 个县。

paras.en: And while certain sections have been incredibly popular among tourists, many parts have slipped into obscurity, disrepair and sometimes oblivion.
paras.zh: 虽然某些部分非常受游客欢迎，但许多部分却变得默默无闻、年久失修，有时甚至被遗忘。

paras.en: Whether you’re planning to visit the Great Wall for the first time or the 50th, the following destinations are sure to make your trip to China even more worthwhile. (Check out the above video for dramatic aerial footage of some of these amazing sites.)
paras.zh: 无论您是第一次还是第 50 次游览长城，以下目的地一定会让您的中国之旅更加值得。 （查看上面的视频，了解其中一些令人惊叹的景点的戏剧性航拍镜头。）

paras.en: The Great Wall is not simply a brick and mortar bulwark; in certain places, towers on jagged mountain peaks, fortress towns or even wide rivers count as sections of “wall.”
paras.zh: 长城不仅仅是一座砖砌的堡垒，更是一座砖砌的堡垒。在某些地方，锯齿状山峰上的塔楼、要塞城镇甚至宽阔的河流都算作“墙”的一部分。

paras.en: The Turtle City, built in the Ming Dynasty (1368-1644) as part of the Great Wall’s “Yellow River Defense Line,” was completed in 1608 and was home to around 2,000 infantrymen and 500 cavalry units during peak use.
paras.zh: 龟城建于明朝（1368-1644 年），是长城“黄河防线”的一部分，于 1608 年竣工，在高峰期可容纳约 2,000 名步兵和 500 名骑兵。

paras.en: Today, this fortress city is located in the Sitan Township of Jingtai County in north central Gansu province.
paras.zh: 如今，这座要塞城市位于甘肃省中北部景泰县泗滩乡。

paras.en: While there aren’t many real turtles in the “Turtle City,” the garrison town got its nickname due to its unique shape.
paras.zh: 虽然“龟城”中真正的乌龟不多，但这座驻军小镇因其独特的造型而得名。

paras.en: The south gate acts as the head and the west and east gates as the flippers. The town’s oval wall is the body, while the north gate acts as its tail. As one of the most well-preserved and truly authentic walled cities left in China today, it’s definitely worth your time.
paras.zh: 南门为头，西门、东门为脚蹼。椭圆形城墙为城身，北门为城尾。作为当今中国保存最完好、最真实的城墙之一，这里绝对值得您花时间。

paras.en: Staying in the Jingtai County center is recommended. The ancient city is only a 30-minute cab ride from your lodgings, so you can visit whenever the light is best for photos.
paras.zh: 推荐住在景泰县城中心。从您的住处乘坐出租车仅需 30 分钟即可到达古城，因此您可以在光线最适合拍照的时候前往游览。

paras.en: When in Jingtai, try local specialties such as the five Buddha tofu and the Jingtai cold mixed noodles – both are spicy vegetarian dishes. A walk through the sprawling night market in Jingtai County People’s Square, which boasts more than 50 snack stalls, is also recommended for adventurous foodies.
paras.zh: 到了景泰，一定要尝尝当地的特色菜，比如五佛豆腐和景泰冷拌面——都是麻辣素菜。景泰县人民广场的夜市拥有 50 多个小吃摊位，值得喜欢冒险的美食家们前往逛一逛。

paras.en: Getting there: Lanzhou, the capital of Gansu province, has a major international airport and high-speed train connections from many cities in China. The drive to Yongtai Turtle City from downtown Lanzhou takes about 2.5 hours (195 kilometers). From Lanzhou Zhongchuan Airport, it’s only 1.5 hours (125 kilometers).
paras.zh: 交通：兰州是甘肃省的省会，拥有一个主要的国际机场和连接中国许多城市的高速列车。从兰州市区驾车至永泰龟城，车程约2.5小时（195公里）。距兰州中川机场仅1.5小时（125公里）。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are two parts of the same Stone Dragon – two contiguous sections of the Great Wall that together stretch for roughly 25 kilometers along Beijing’s mountaintops.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口是同一条石龙的两个部分——长城的两个连续部分，沿着北京的山顶绵延约 25 公里。

paras.en: Historical records show that millions of men spent centuries constructing the Great Wall. Stand atop the wall at either Mutianyu or Jiankou, and you’ll begin to comprehend the gravity of this statement.
paras.zh: 历史记录表明，数百万人花费了几个世纪的时间建造长城。站在慕田峪或剑口的城墙上，你就会开始理解这句话的严重性。

paras.en: These two sections are arguably the two most classic examples of Ming Dynasty Great Wall surviving today, and climbing either is guaranteed to be a life-changing experience.
paras.zh: 这两段可以说是现存明代长城中最经典的两个例子，攀登其中任何一段都将是一次改变人生的经历。

paras.en: Mutianyu is the best portion of the “tourist wall.” Restored in the 1980s, it’s very commercial but also superbly beautiful. Visitors not up for the hike can take a cable car to the top.
paras.zh: 慕田峪是“旅游墙”中最好的部分。它于 20 世纪 80 年代修复，非常商业化，但也非常美丽。不适合徒步的游客可以乘坐缆车到达山顶。

paras.en: To the west of Mutianyu, Jiankou is colloquially known as the “wild wall” – no ticket needed and not commercialized. That being said, as of 2020, hiking at Jiankou has become somewhat frowned upon by the local government because of safety concerns.
paras.zh: 慕田峪以西的剑口俗称“野墙”，不需门票，不商业化。尽管如此，从2020年开始，出于安全考虑，当地政府对剑口徒步有些不满。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are less than a 90-minute drive (without traffic) from downtown Beijing, yet it’s highly recommended to enjoy a night in the countryside if time allows.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口距离北京市中心不到 90 分钟车程（不堵车），但如果时间允许，强烈建议在乡村享受一晚。

paras.en: Jiankou can be accessed via Xizhazi village; if dates align, you might even be able to spend a few days with William Lindesay, world-renowned Great Wall historian, and his wonderful family at The Barracks, their wall-side courtyard home.
paras.zh: 经西栅子村可到达剑口；如果日期一致，您甚至可以与世界著名的长城历史学家威廉·林德赛 (William Lindesay) 和他的家人一起在军营 (The Barracks) 度过几天，这是他们位于墙边的庭院住宅。

paras.en: For lodgings around Mutianyu, The Brickyard is a superbly comfortable choice.
paras.zh: 对于慕田峪周边的住宿而言，瓦厂是一个非常舒适的选择。

paras.en: In fall and spring, shades of the wall’s gray brick contrast with nature’s vibrant colors. Peak autumn foliage and spring cherry blossoms provide stunning backdrops for photos.
paras.zh: 在秋季和春季，灰色砖墙的色调与大自然鲜艳的色彩形成鲜明对比。秋天的枫叶和春天的樱花为照片提供了令人惊叹的背景。

paras.en: For winter sports enthusiasts, there’s skiing and skating next to the Wall at locations not far from Mutianyu.
paras.zh: 对于冬季运动爱好者来说，距离慕田峪不远的长城旁有滑雪场和滑冰场。

paras.en: Getting to Mutianyu: Restrictions on applying for temporary driving licenses in China were relaxed in September 2019, so renting a car as a foreign tourist is entirely possible. (International driving licenses are not accepted in China.)
paras.zh: 前往慕田峪：2019年9月，中国放宽了申请临时驾驶执照的限制，因此外国游客完全可以租车。 （中国不接受国际驾照。）

paras.en: You can also hire a car with a driver for the day or take the Mutianyu Special Tourism Bus from the Dongzhimen Wai Bus Station.
paras.zh: 您也可以当天租一辆带司机的汽车，或者从东直门外汽车站乘坐慕田峪旅游专线巴士。

paras.en: Getting to Jiankou: Renting a car or booking private transport is recommended. As Xizhazi is a small village, buses are scarce so it can take up to five hours to get there by public transport, as opposed to 90 minutes by car.
paras.zh: 前往剑口：建议租车或预订私人交通工具。由于西栅子是一个小村庄，公交车很少，因此乘坐公共交通工具最多需要 5 个小时才能到达那里，而开车则需要 90 分钟。

paras.en: Bataizi village sits just inside the Motianling section of the Great Wall and is home to the ruins of a Gothic church built in 1876 under the direction of a German missionary.
paras.zh: 八台子村位于磨天岭长城内，是一座哥特式教堂的遗址，这座教堂建于 1876 年，由一位德国传教士主持建造。

paras.en: The church has been damaged and repaired numerous times in its nearly 150-year history; the bell tower is the only part still standing.
paras.zh: 这座教堂在近150年的历史中曾多次遭到损坏和修复。钟楼是唯一仍然矗立的部分。

paras.en: The juxtaposition of its ruins against the rammed-earth Great Wall makes Bataizi a unique place to spend a morning or afternoon.
paras.zh: 其遗址与夯土长城并列，使八台子成为度过早晨或下午的独特场所。

paras.en: After finishing your hike along the wall and visiting the church ruins, drop in to the village’s “new” church to say hello to Father Pan; if you speak Chinese, he can answer any questions about the village’s long connection with Catholicism.
paras.zh: 完成沿着城墙的徒步旅行并参观教堂遗址后，顺便去村里的“新”教堂向潘神父问好；如果你会说中文，他可以回答有关该村与天主教的悠久联系的任何问题。

paras.en: Besides Bataizi, Datong should also be on your tourist map; visiting the Yungang Grottoes (a UNESCO world heritage site) and the Hengshan Hanging Temple will make your trip even more memorable.
paras.zh: 除了八台子，大同也应该出现在你的旅游地图上；参观云冈石窟（联合国教科文组织世界遗产）和恒山悬空寺将使您的旅行更加难忘。

paras.en: Late summer is an ideal time to visit Bataizi, as you’ll see a wonderful contrast between the Great Wall and the lush green hills.
paras.zh: 夏末是游览八台子的理想时机，因为您会看到长城和郁郁葱葱的青山之间的美妙对比。

paras.en: Getting there: Bataizi village is 80 kilometers west of Datong, one of Shanxi province’s largest and most famous cities. Zuoyun County is only 22 kilometers away from Bataizi – about a 35-minute drive.
paras.zh: 交通：八台子村位于山西省最大、最著名的城市之一大同以西 80 公里处。左云县距八台子仅22公里，车程约35分钟。

paras.en: Datong is easily accessible by plane or high-speed train from other cities in China; a taxi from downtown Datong to Bataizi should cost roughly 300 yuan (about $43).
paras.zh: 从中国其他城市乘坐飞机或高铁可轻松抵达大同；从大同市中心到八台子的出租车费用约为 300 元（约合 43 美元）。

paras.en: Alternatively, you can make your way to Zuoyun County by bus then hop in a taxi.
paras.zh: 或者，您也可以乘坐巴士前往左云县，然后乘坐出租车。

paras.en: In Datong, luxury seekers will want to head for the five-star Yunzhong Traditional Courtyard Hotel. Zuoyun County has one hotel that can accept foreigners: Zuoyun Jinshan International Hotel. Both can be found on popular hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: 在大同，追求奢华的游客将会前往五星级的云中传统四合院酒店。左云县有一家可以接待外国人的酒店：左云金山国际酒店。两者都可以在热门酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Laoniuwan (aka the Old Ox Bend Great Wall)
paras.zh: 老牛湾（又名老牛弯长城）

paras.en: As the locals say, Laoniuwan is where the Great Wall and the mighty Yellow River shake hands.
paras.zh: 当地人说，老牛湾是长城与浩瀚黄河握手的地方。

paras.en: The Laoniuwan Fortress was built in 1467, while the most famous tower of the Great Wall in this area, Wanghe Tower (literally meaning river-watching tower), was constructed in 1544.
paras.zh: 老牛湾城建于1467年，而该地区最著名的长城塔望河楼则建于1544年。

paras.en: Laoniuwan village is located in Pianguan County, part of Xinzhou city in Shanxi province, just across the river from Inner Mongolia.
paras.zh: 老牛湾村位于山西省忻州市偏关县，与内蒙古隔江相望。

paras.en: Late summer or early fall is a great time to visit, as you’ll avoid the potentially dangerous mountain roads during spring rainstorms, or being uncomfortably cold in a place without great infrastructure.
paras.zh: 夏末或初秋是游览的好时机，因为您可以避开春季暴雨期间潜在危险的山路，或者在没有良好基础设施的地方感到不舒服的寒冷。

paras.en: Along the Great Wall, there are only a few places where it meets bodies of water; of all those, this is the most stunning.
paras.zh: 长城沿线只有少数地方与水体交汇；其中，这是最令人惊叹的。

paras.en: A boat ride along the river is highly recommended. You’ll be able to soak in the natural beauty of the Yellow River Gorge while marveling at the steadfast resolve of these ancient architects.
paras.zh: 强烈推荐沿河乘船游览。您将能够沉浸在黄河峡谷的自然美景中，同时惊叹于这些古代建筑师的坚定决心。

paras.en: Getting there: Laoniuwan is difficult to get to by public transportation. The best option is to rent or book a car to take you from Datong to Laoniuwan via Bataizi – this way, you’ll be able to see two incredible locations along the Great Wall in one trip.
paras.zh: 交通：老牛湾乘坐公共交通不太方便。最好的选择是租赁或预订一辆车，从大同经八台子前往老牛湾——这样，您将能够在一次旅行中看到长城沿线的两个令人难以置信的景点。

paras.en: Pianguan is the nearest city, about one hour away. Pianguan does not have a train station or an airport. The only option is to arrive by bus. Shuozhou, 140 kilometers from Laoniuwan, has an airport opening later this year.
paras.zh: 偏关是最近的城市，大约一小时车程。偏关没有火车站和机场。唯一的选择是乘坐巴士到达。距离老牛湾 140 公里的朔州机场将于今年晚些时候开业。

paras.en: Construction on the Great Wall in Simatai began in 1373. It was expanded and reinforced periodically throughout the Ming Dynasty.
paras.zh: 司马台长城始建于 1373 年。明代期间不断扩建和加固。

paras.en: The Fairy Tower is one of the best-known towers of the wall at Simatai but also one of the least visited due to how difficult it is to access.
paras.zh: 仙塔是司马台最著名的城墙塔楼之一，但由于难以进入，也是参观人数最少的塔楼之一。

paras.en: Instead, aim to take in incredible views of the Fairy Tower from Wangjing Tower (just a few hundred meters away). It’s a journey that will satiate even the most adventurous hikers, yet can be done without any ropes, ladders or other essential safety gear.
paras.zh: 相反，您的目标是从望京塔（仅数百米外）欣赏仙女塔的壮丽景色。这是一次即使是最具冒险精神的徒步旅行者也能满足的旅程，而且无需任何绳索、梯子或其他必要的安全装备即可完成。

paras.en: As with a visit to Mutianyu/Jiankou, this section of wall is guaranteed to deliver stunning views any time of year. My only suggestion is to wait for a clear day (usually visibility is great the day after it rains or snows), as the view from Wangjing Tower is unobstructed in every direction.
paras.zh: 与游览慕田峪/剑口一样，这一段城墙保证在一年中的任何时候都能呈现出令人惊叹的景色。我唯一的建议是等待晴天（通常下雨或下雪后的第二天能见度很好），因为从望京塔的各个方向都一览无余。

paras.en: The hike to the Fairy Tower will leave you in awe of the Northern Barbarians’ supposed determination to reach the capital; the mountains are nearly impassable on foot, let alone by horse, with sheer cliff faces on either side.
paras.zh: 徒步前往仙塔，会让您对北蛮人到达首都的决心感到敬畏；这些山脉几乎无法步行通过，更不用说骑马了，两侧都是陡峭的悬崖。

paras.en: It makes for absolutely world-class hiking and an interesting history lesson.
paras.zh: 它绝对是世界一流的徒步旅行和有趣的历史课。

paras.en: Five-star lodgings are available at Hobo Farm; they also have an incredible restaurant that serves delicious Western and Chinese fare. For 4.5 star lodgings with a lower price tag, try Yatou’s Homestay. Both can be found on major hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: Hobo农场提供五星级住宿；他们还有一家令人难以置信的餐厅，供应美味的西餐和中餐。如果想要价格较低的 4.5 星级住宿，可以试试丫头民宿。两者都可以在主要的酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Getting there: Both the Fairy Tower and Wangjing Tower should be accessed via Tangjiazhai village, located in Beijing’s Miyun district.
paras.zh: 交通：仙女塔和望京塔均需经由位于北京密云区的唐家寨村到达。

paras.en: Tangjiazhai village is 140 kilometers from downtown Beijing, depending on your route. Booking a private car from the city is probably the most time-effective way to get there.
paras.zh: 唐家寨距离北京市中心 140 公里，具体取决于您的路线。从市区预订私家车可能是到达那里最省时的方式。

paras.en: You can also take a high-speed train from Beijing Station to Miyun district and switch to a bus or taxi from there.
paras.zh: 您也可以从北京站乘坐高铁到密云区，然后从那里换乘公交车或出租车。

paras.en: Constructed during the reign of Emperor Jiajing (1507-1567), this single-wall section stands seven meters tall in some spots – no small feat considering it was made by piling stones.
paras.zh: 这座单墙建筑建于嘉靖年间（1507-1567 年），有些地方高达 7 米，考虑到它是用石头堆砌而成，这可不是一件小事。

paras.en: It’s located just across the road from the town of Dushikou, in Chicheng in Hebei province.
paras.zh: 它位于河北省赤城独市口镇的马路对面。

paras.en: The piled-stone wall at Dushikou is unique, as many other sections of the Great Wall close to Beijing were constructed using kiln-fired bricks.
paras.zh: 独市口的石堆墙是独一无二的，因为许多靠近北京的长城都是用窑烧砖建造的。

paras.en: Dushikou is best visited in the summer, specifically July and August, when the rolling hills of the surrounding grasslands are peak green. Cool evenings make for perfect outdoor barbecue/bonfire weather.
paras.zh: 独石口的最佳旅游时间是夏季，特别是七月和八月，此时周围草原连绵起伏的山丘呈现出翠绿的景色。凉爽的夜晚是完美的户外烧烤/篝火天气。

paras.en: You’ll be able to find clean and comfortable farmhouse lodgings in Dushikou town; alternatively, Chicheng, 45 minutes away, has a range of hotels to choose from.
paras.zh: 在都市口镇你可以找到干净舒适的农家住宿；或者，距酒店 45 分钟路程的赤城也有多家酒店可供选择。

paras.en: Lamb skewers and roast leg of lamb are specialties in these parts, as this part of Hebei is very close to the border with Inner Mongolia. Noodle lovers should also try the local oat noodles, which are delicious.
paras.zh: 河北这一地区靠近内蒙古边境，羊肉串、烤羊腿是这些地区的特色菜。喜欢吃面食的人还应该尝尝当地的燕麦面，味道鲜美。

paras.en: Getting there: Thanks to all the infrastructure built for the 2022 Winter Olympics, the drive to Dushikou has been shortened by almost two hours. If you prefer not to drive, hop on a bus to Chicheng from the Liuliqiao Transport Hub in Beijing and take a 45-minute taxi ride to Dushikou.
paras.zh: 交通：得益于为 2022 年冬奥会建设的所有基础设施，前往都市口的车程缩短了近两个小时。如果您不想开车，可以从北京六里桥交通枢纽搭乘巴士前往赤城，然后乘坐出租车 45 分钟即可到达独市口。

paras.en: Note that public transportation will take one or two hours longer than private car.
paras.zh: 请注意，公共交通将比私家车多花一到两个小时。

articles.title: Chiefs' Chris Jones explains why opinions 'are like buttholes' on national television

paras.en: The NFL is at the epicenter of media and fan attention like no other professional sports league in America, and Kansas City Chiefs defensive lineman Chris Jones understands that.
paras.zh: 与美国其他职业体育联盟不同，NFL 是媒体和球迷关注的焦点，堪萨斯城酋长队防守前锋克里斯·琼斯明白这一点。

paras.en: Jones, 32 and in his 11th season, has heard it all – the Chiefs' dynasty is over, the championship window is closed, the defense is struggling.
paras.zh: 32 岁的琼斯已经是他职业生涯的第 11 个赛季了，他已经听到了这一切——酋长王朝已经结束，总冠军窗口已经关闭，防守陷入困境。

paras.en: There are a lot of opinions about the Chiefs out there.
paras.zh: 关于酋长的说法有很多。

paras.en: And Jones was asked about all those opinions out there on the CBS pregame show Sunday before Kansas City's game at the Atlanta Falcons.
paras.zh: 周日，在堪萨斯城对阵亚特兰大猎鹰队的比赛之前，琼斯在哥伦比亚广播公司赛前节目中被问及所有这些观点。

paras.en: "I learned opinions are like buttholes," Jones said live on air. "We all got 'em, they all stink."
paras.zh: “我知道意见就像屁眼，”琼斯在直播中说道。 “我们都有它们，它们都很臭。”

paras.en: The Chiefs are not necessarily the team to beat in the AFC this season. That could be the Jacksonville Jaguars, who are 14-3 in their last 17 games dating to last season, and quarterback Trevor Lawrence is playing very well.
paras.zh: 酋长队不一定是本赛季亚冠比赛中击败的球队。那可能是杰克逊维尔美洲虎队，自上赛季以来，他们在过去 17 场比赛中取得了 14 胜 3 负的战绩，四分卫特雷弗·劳伦斯 (Trevor Lawrence) 打得非常好。

paras.en: But the Chiefs are relevant, folks. That has not changed.
paras.zh: 但酋长们是相关的，伙计们。这一点没有改变。

paras.en: They may be locked in a battle for the AFC West with the Denver Broncos, but come the postseason, they cannot be dismissed even as their most recent trip to the Super Bowl in the 2024 season gets smaller in the rearview mirror.
paras.zh: 他们可能会与丹佛野马队争夺亚冠西部冠军，但到了季后赛，他们不能被忽视，即使他们最近一次在 2024 年赛季的超级碗之旅在后视镜中变得越来越小。

paras.en: Now, please, do not ask Chris Jones about that opinion.
paras.zh: 现在，请不要向克里斯·琼斯询问这个观点。

articles.title: Wyatt Hammond makes kayak fishing history with third straight national title and KBF record

paras.en: When I caught up with professional kayak angler Wyatt Hammond on Wednesday, he was in Guntersville, Ala., preparing for a pretty big weekend at the Kayak Bass Fishing (KBF) National Championship.
paras.zh: 周三，当我见到专业皮划艇钓鱼者怀亚特·哈蒙德 (Wyatt Hammond) 时，他正在阿拉巴马州甘特斯维尔 (Guntersville) 准备参加皮划艇巴斯钓鱼 (KBF) 全国锦标赛，度过一个相当重要的周末。

paras.en: "I've won it the past two years. I'm trying to see if I can do it three years in a row," Hammond told OutKick OutDoors.
paras.zh: “我在过去的两年里赢得了它。我正在尝试看看我是否可以连续三年获得这个冠军，”哈蒙德告诉 OutKick OutDoors。

paras.en: Not only did Hammond complete the historic three-peat on Friday, but he also claimed the 2026 KBF Challenge Series Championship, earned Angler of the Year honors and set a new KBF record for the highest three-day total.
paras.zh: 哈蒙德不仅在周五完成了历史性的三连冠，还获得了 2026 年 KBF 挑战系列赛冠军，赢得了年度钓鱼者荣誉，并创造了新的 KBF 三天总成绩最高记录。

paras.en: Hammond, who also won the 2025 Bassmaster Kayak Series National Championship, now has four national titles on his résumé. And his latest victory might have been his most impressive yet.
paras.zh: 哈蒙德还赢得了 2025 年低音大师皮划艇系列全国冠军，现在他的简历上已经有四个全国冠军。他最近的胜利可能是他迄今为止最令人印象深刻的胜利。

paras.en: Three days, three massive limits and one historic finish
paras.zh: 三天，三个极限赛和一个历史性的终点

paras.en: Hammond wasted no time getting to work at the KBF Championships on Lakes Guntersville and Wheeler.
paras.zh: 哈蒙德立即赶赴甘特斯维尔湖和惠勒湖举行的 KBF 锦标赛。

paras.en: He opened Wednesday's Challenge Series Championship with a 106-inch five-fish limit, building a commanding 9.75-inch lead over the rest of the field.
paras.zh: 他以 106 英寸的五条鱼限制拉开了周三挑战系列锦标赛的序幕，领先于其他选手 9.75 英寸。

paras.en: Watch Wyatt Hammond's full interview with OutKick OutDoors here:
paras.zh: 在此观看 Wyatt Hammond 对 OutKick OutDoors 的完整采访：

paras.en: For those unfamiliar with competitive kayak fishing, anglers are scored by the total length of their five longest bass rather than weight. Fish are measured, photographed and released instead of being transported to a traditional weigh-in.
paras.zh: 对于那些不熟悉竞技性皮划艇钓鱼的人来说，垂钓者根据五条最长的鲈鱼的总长度而不是重量来评分。鱼被测量、拍照并释放，而不是被运送到传统的称重处。

paras.en: On Thursday, Hammond followed up with another impressive limit of 102.25 inches, bringing his two-day total to 208.25 inches.
paras.zh: 周四，哈蒙德又创下了 102.25 英寸的令人印象深刻的极限，使他两天的总高度达到 208.25 英寸。

paras.en: That was enough to win the Challenge Series Championship by a whopping 15.75 inches over runner-up Jody Queen.
paras.zh: 这足以以 15.75 英寸的优势赢得挑战系列赛冠军，而亚军乔迪·奎恩 (Jody Queen) 则领先了 15.75 英寸。

paras.en: But the biggest prize was still up for grabs.
paras.zh: 但最大的奖品仍然悬而未决。

paras.en: For Friday's KBF National Championship, the leaderboard reset to zero, meaning Hammond's massive lead from the previous two days meant absolutely nothing. He would have to do it all over again.
paras.zh: 在周五的 KBF 全国锦标赛中，排行榜重置为零，这意味着哈蒙德前两天的巨大领先优势毫无意义。他必须重新做一遍。

paras.en: Hammond landed another five-fish limit totaling 101.75 inches, narrowly edging out Rus Snyders, who finished with 100.50 inches. Abby Abbondanza took third with 99.25 inches.
paras.zh: 哈蒙德再次以 101.75 英寸的总长度达到了 5 条鱼的极限，以微弱优势击败了以 100.50 英寸完成比赛的罗斯·斯奈德斯 (Rus Snyders)。艾比·阿邦丹扎 (Abby Abbondanza) 以 99.25 英寸的成绩获得第三名。

paras.en: Just 1.25 inches separated first and second place.
paras.zh: 第一名和第二名仅相差 1.25 英寸。

paras.en: The victory made Hammond the first angler in KBF history to win three consecutive national championships.
paras.zh: 这场胜利使哈蒙德成为 KBF 历史上第一位连续三届全国冠军的钓鱼选手。

paras.en: And if that weren't enough, his combined total of 310 inches over the three days established a new KBF record. That's 15 scoring bass averaging more than 20 inches apiece.
paras.zh: 如果这还不够，他在三天内总共跑了 310 英寸，创造了新的 KBF 纪录。这是 15 条平均每条超过 20 英寸的得分鲈鱼。

paras.en: From a heartbreaking two-inch loss to making history
paras.zh: 从令人心碎的两英寸损失到创造历史

paras.en: What makes Hammond's latest accomplishment even more remarkable is what happened just a few weeks earlier.
paras.zh: 几周前发生的事情让哈蒙德的最新成就更加引人注目。

paras.en: In October, he came within two inches of defending his Bassmaster Kayak Series National Championship at Lake Murray in South Carolina.
paras.zh: 10 月，他在南卡罗来纳州默里湖 (Lake Murray) 距离卫冕低音大师皮划艇系列全国冠军仅差两英寸。

paras.en: Hammond told OutKick OutDoors that a slow start on Day 1 ultimately cost him, despite recording the largest single-day limit of the tournament on Day 2.
paras.zh: 哈蒙德告诉 OutKick OutDoors，尽管在第二天创下了赛事的最大单日限制，但第一天的缓慢开局最终让他付出了代价。

paras.en: "I kind of got in my own head and kind of spun myself out," he explained.
paras.zh: “我有点陷入了自己的头脑，然后又把自己旋转了出来，”他解释道。

paras.en: But after settling down and sticking to his game plan, he finished strong. It just wasn't quite enough to catch eventual champion Ewing Minor.
paras.zh: 但在安定下来并坚持自己的比赛计划后，他表现出色。这还不足以追上最终的冠军尤因·米诺 (Ewing Minor)。

paras.en: During our conversation Wednesday, Hammond also opened up about the pressure that comes with being a national champion and how that pressure nearly burned him out on fishing altogether.
paras.zh: 在我们周三的谈话中，哈蒙德还谈到了作为全国冠军所带来的压力，以及这种压力几乎让他在钓鱼方面几乎精疲力尽。

paras.en: "I was really putting a lot of stress on myself. Like, I have to do well because, you know, I won a national championship," he said. "I have to continue doing well."
paras.zh: “我真的给自己施加了很大的压力。就像，我必须做得很好，因为，你知道，我赢得了全国冠军，”他说。 “我必须继续表现出色。”

paras.en: Eventually, Hammond realized he needed to stop worrying so much about the results and get back to enjoying the sport.
paras.zh: 最终，哈蒙德意识到他需要停止过于担心结果并重新享受这项运动。

paras.en: "I did a lot better whenever I enjoyed what I was doing," he said.
paras.zh: “只要我喜欢我所做的事情，我就会做得更好，”他说。

paras.en: Judging by this week's results, that approach seems to be working out pretty well.
paras.zh: 从本周的结果来看，这种方法似乎效果很好。

paras.en: What's next for the four-time national champion?
paras.zh: 四届全国冠军的下一步是什么？

paras.en: When I asked Hammond about his goals for 2027, he already had his sights set on another familiar rival.
paras.zh: 当我问哈蒙德 2027 年的目标时，他已经把目光投向了另一个熟悉的竞争对手。

paras.en: "I'm gonna see if I can take something from Ewing [Minor] next year. I can't let him win everything all over again," he joked.
paras.zh: “我会看看明年我是否可以从尤因[Minor]那里得到一些东西。我不能让他再次赢得一切，”他开玩笑说。

paras.en: Hammond said winning Bassmaster's Angler of the Year award would be a dream, and he's particularly excited about upcoming tournaments at Lake Champlain and Sam Rayburn Reservoir.
paras.zh: 哈蒙德表示，赢得 Bassmaster 年度钓鱼者奖将是一个梦想，他对即将在尚普兰湖和萨姆雷伯恩水库举行的锦标赛感到特别兴奋。

paras.en: Three consecutive KBF national championships. Four national titles overall. A Challenge Series championship, an Angler of the Year award and a new KBF record.
paras.zh: 连续三届KBF全国冠军。总共有四个国家冠军。挑战系列赛冠军、年度钓鱼者奖和新的 KBF 记录。

paras.en: Love all things fishing and outdoors? Follow OutKick OutDoors on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube!
paras.zh: 喜欢钓鱼和户外活动吗？在 Instagram、TikTok 和 YouTube 上关注 OutKick OutDoors！

articles.title: Duffy: Investigators examining 2 routers after nationwide FAA ground stop, no signs of foreign cyberattack

paras.en: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said Sunday that two routers from FAA facilities in Texas and Arkansas are undergoing extensive testing as investigators examine whether faulty equipment or an installation problem triggered the nation's longest nationwide ground stop in 25 years.
paras.zh: 运输部长肖恩·达菲 (Sean Duffy) 周日表示，联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 位于德克萨斯州和阿肯色州的两台路由器正在接受广泛测试，调查人员正在检查是否有故障的设备或安装问题引发了美国 25 年来最长的全国性地面停留。

paras.en: Appearing on "Fox News Sunday," Duffy said that investigators have found no indication of a foreign cyberattack, although the FBI and other federal law enforcement partners remain involved in the probe.
paras.zh: 达菲在“福克斯周日新闻”节目中表示，尽管联邦调查局和其他联邦执法合作伙伴仍在参与调查，但调查人员尚未发现外国网络攻击的迹象。

paras.en: "We think it was the installation or the router that was the bad actor," Duffy said. "But we're open, if we see something else, we're gonna continue to investigate with our federal partners and law enforcement."
paras.zh: “我们认为是安装或路由器造成了不良影响，”达菲说。 “但我们持开放态度，如果我们看到其他情况，我们将继续与联邦合作伙伴和执法部门一起调查。”

paras.en: In an update posted on X, Duffy said contractor L3Harris had secured the two routers from remote FAA facilities in Texas and Arkansas and was conducting "deep diagnostics testing" at its headquarters in Florida, with engineers from the FAA, Juniper and Cisco assisting.
paras.zh: 在 X 上发布的最新消息中，Duffy 表示，承包商 L3Harris 已从德克萨斯州和阿肯色州的远程 FAA 设施中获取了两台路由器，并在 FAA、瞻博网络和思科的工程师的协助下，在佛罗里达州总部进行“深度诊断测试”。

paras.en: The investigation follows Friday's nationwide ground stop, which halted air traffic for more than four hours and contributed to disruptions affecting roughly 15,000 flights Friday and Saturday.
paras.zh: 这项调查是在周五全国范围内的地面停飞之后进行的，该停飞导致空中交通中断了四个多小时，并导致周五和周六大约 15,000 架次航班受到干扰。

paras.en: The fallout continued Sunday, with 3,798 flights delayed and another 1,638 canceled within, into or out of the United States as of noon ET, according to flight-tracking website FlightAware. Among the hardest-hit airports according to the provided data were Atlanta's Hartsfield-Jackson International Airport, with 376 delays, and Dallas Fort Worth International Airport, with 363 delays and 195 cancellations.
paras.zh: 根据航班跟踪网站 FlightAware 的数据，截至周日中午，美国境内、进出美国的航班有 3,798 架次延误，另有 1,638 架次取消。根据提供的数据，受影响最严重的机场包括亚特兰大哈茨菲尔德-杰克逊国际机场（有 376 次延误）和达拉斯沃斯堡国际机场（有 363 次延误和 195 次取消）。

paras.en: The shutdown occurred as L3Harris was replacing aging copper wiring with fiber-optic technology in the FAA's communications system. The work led to intermittent communications and radar gaps, prompting officials to halt flights nationwide.
paras.zh: 此次关闭是在 L3Harris 正在 FAA 通信系统中用光纤技术取代老化的铜线时发生的。这项工作导致通讯和雷达出现断断续续的缺口，促使官员停止全国范围内的航班。

paras.en: Duffy said President Donald Trump convened federal officials on Friday as the administration investigated whether the disruption could have involved malicious interference.
paras.zh: 达菲表示，唐纳德·特朗普总统周五召集了联邦官员，政府调查这次中断是否可能涉及恶意干扰。

paras.en: "President Trump actually had the whole of government on the phone on Friday," Duffy said. "Was anyone seeing footprints? Was anyone hearing chatter? Was this a cyber attack from a foreign nation?"
paras.zh: “特朗普总统实际上在周五给整个政府通了电话，”达菲说。 “有人看到脚印吗？有人听到谈话声吗？这是来自外国的网络攻击吗？”

paras.en: "We have no indication that that was at play here," he added.
paras.zh: “我们没有任何迹象表明这在这里起作用，”他补充道。

paras.en: Duffy defended the decision to issue the nationwide ground stop, emphasizing that passenger safety takes precedence when problems emerge in the FAA's communications network.
paras.zh: 达菲为在全国范围内发出地面停车令的决定进行了辩护，强调当美国联邦航空管理局的通信网络出现问题时，乘客的安全是第一位的。

paras.en: "When we have inconsistencies in our network we're going to shut it down," Duffy said.
paras.zh: “当我们的网络出现不一致时，我们将关闭它，”达菲说。

paras.en: The transportation secretary also warned that the FAA's communications infrastructure remains outdated despite ongoing efforts to replace copper wiring with fiber-optic technology.
paras.zh: 这位交通部长还警告说，尽管美国联邦航空管理局正在努力用光纤技术取代铜线，但其通信基础设施仍然过时。

paras.en: "We're still using an old 1980 architecture for telecom," Duffy said. "I need a brand new telecom system."
paras.zh: “我们仍在使用 1980 年的旧电信架构，”Duffy 说。 “我需要一个全新的电信系统。”

paras.en: Duffy said AT&T, Verizon and Lumen are prepared to help build a replacement network, but additional congressional funding is needed to move forward.
paras.zh: 达菲表示，AT&T、Verizon 和 Lumen 已准备好帮助建设替代网络，但需要国会提供额外资金才能推进。

paras.en: The request has drawn scrutiny from congressional Democrats, who argue the administration has yet to spend billions already allocated for air traffic control modernization. Duffy countered that the existing funds were designated for specific upgrades, including radar, radios and electronic flight strips, rather than a new communications network.
paras.zh: 这一请求引起了国会民主党人的审查，他们认为政府尚未花费已分配用于空中交通管制现代化的数十亿美元。达菲反驳说，现有资金被指定用于特定升级，包括雷达、无线电和电子跑道，而不是新的通信网络。

paras.en: Meanwhile, FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford said Saturday that "the worst is behind us," with air travel expected to return to normal by the end of Sunday.
paras.zh: 与此同时，美国联邦航空局局长布莱恩·贝德福德周六表示，“最糟糕的情况已经过去”，航空旅行预计将在周日结束前恢复正常。

paras.en: The nationwide ground stop was the first since January 2023 and only the second since the Sept. 11, 2001, terrorist attacks.
paras.zh: 这是自 2023 年 1 月以来的第一次全国性地面停留，也是自 2001 年 9 月 11 日恐怖袭击以来的第二次。

articles.title: Iran launches drone attacks against US military base in Bahrain
articles.author: Rory Carroll and agencies

paras.en: Iran has launched drone attacks against a US military base in Bahrain, casting further doubt on peace talks between Tehran and Washington and raising the spectre of escalation.
paras.zh: 伊朗对美国在巴林的军事基地发动无人机袭击，使德黑兰与华盛顿之间的和平谈判进一步受到质疑，并引发了局势升级的担忧。

paras.en: Blasts sounded over the Gulf nation on Sunday in the second Iranian drone attack in three days in retaliation for US strikes in Iran.
paras.zh: 周日，爆炸声在这个海湾国家上空响起，这是伊朗三天内的第二次无人机袭击，以报复美国对伊朗的袭击。

paras.en: Meanwhile, in Yemen, Iran’s Houthi allies advanced against pro-government forces in the south, opening a potential route to Aden. Iran also claimed that a mine sank an oil supertanker in the strait of Hormuz.
paras.zh: 与此同时，在也门，伊朗的胡塞盟友向南部的亲政府军发起进攻，开辟了通往亚丁的潜在路线。伊朗还声称，霍尔木兹海峡的一枚地雷导致一艘超级油轮沉没。

paras.en: The developments deepened gloom about the chances of any diplomatic breakthrough in the region.
paras.zh: 这些事态发展加深了对该地区外交突破机会的悲观情绪。

paras.en: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps said they launched six drones targeting a US air defence radar at the Al-Rifaa helicopter base in retaliation for “hostile US actions”. Authorities in Bahrain said air defences intercepted the drones before they reached their targets.
paras.zh: 伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队表示，他们发射了六架无人机瞄准里法直升机基地的美国防空雷达，以报复“美国的敌对行动”。巴林当局表示，防空系统在无人机到达目标之前拦截了它们。

paras.en: At a press conference in Tehran the foreign ministry spokesperson, Esmaeil Baghaei, said Iran would continue to respond to any military aggression by the US or other states. Asked if the latest strikes indicated a change in Iranian direction as negotiations with the US have stalled, he said Iran was “not waiting for anyone” and was focused on its security.
paras.zh: 在德黑兰举行的新闻发布会上，外交部发言人埃斯梅尔·巴加伊表示，伊朗将继续对美国或其他国家的任何军事侵略做出反应。当被问及最近的袭击是否表明伊朗在与美国的谈判陷入僵局时方向发生了变化时，他表示伊朗“不会等待任何人”，而是专注于自身安全。

paras.en: US forces have conducted a series of strikes against Iranian targets in recent weeks, including Qeshm Island in the strait of Hormuz.
paras.zh: 最近几周，美军对伊朗目标进行了一系列打击，其中包括霍尔木兹海峡的格什姆岛。

paras.en: Donald Trump last week called them minor strikes and said Saudi Arabia and other Gulf states had cautioned him against large-scale combat operations.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普上周称这些袭击为小规模袭击，并表示沙特阿拉伯和其他海湾国家已警告他不要进行大规模战斗行动。

paras.en: However, the president also said Washington was no longer seeking a deal with Iran and that he had instructed the vice-president, JD Vance, to switch his focus to alleged corruption and fraud in Democrat-run cities and states.
paras.zh: 然而，总统还表示，华盛顿不再寻求与伊朗达成协议，他已指示副总统万斯将注意力转向民主党管理的城市和州涉嫌腐败和欺诈的问题。

paras.en: Vance – who blamed the Republicans’ loss of Congress in midterm elections on the Iran war – had requested a personal meeting with Iranian negotiators to discuss peace terms.
paras.zh: 万斯将共和党在中期选举中输掉国会归咎于伊朗战争，他要求与伊朗谈判代表进行个人会面，讨论和平条款。

paras.en: A conflict that began with joint US and Israeli attacks against Iran in February remains at an impasse, with the US maintaining a naval blockade and Iran its chokehold over the strait of Hormuz.
paras.zh: 始于二月份美国和以色列联合袭击伊朗的冲突目前仍处于僵局，美国维持海上封锁，而伊朗则控制着霍尔木兹海峡。

paras.en: In a separate development, Iran’s Revolutionary Guards claimed that two ships hit mines in the strait of Hormuz and that one, an oil supertanker with 2m barrels of oil, sank. The ships suffered “massive explosions and fire”, said the statement.
paras.zh: 在另一起事态发展中，伊朗革命卫队声称两艘船在霍尔木兹海峡触雷，其中一艘是一艘载有 200 万桶石油的超级油轮沉没。声明称，这些船只遭受了“大规模爆炸和火灾”。

paras.en: There was no immediate independent verification. The US military recently claimed it had cleared all mines from main routes through the waterway.
paras.zh: 没有立即进行独立核实。美国军方最近声称已清除了该水道主要路线上的所有水雷。

paras.en: The strikes against Bahrain suggested Iran has decided on a tit-for-tat response to US attacks.
paras.zh: 对巴林的袭击表明伊朗已决定对美国的袭击做出针锋相对的回应。

paras.en: Bahrain hosts significant US bases, including a forward base that was home to the US Fifth Fleet and US Naval Forces Central Command, operating as a central support hub for military operations in the Middle East.
paras.zh: 巴林拥有重要的美国基地，包括美国第五舰队和美国海军中央司令部所在地的前沿基地，作为中东军事行动的中央支持中心。

paras.en: Tehran repeatedly targeted the kingdom until September, when there was a lull in attacks. That ended on Friday when Iran launched drones against a US radar facility. US Central Command said it shot down two drones without any injury or damage.
paras.zh: 德黑兰多次以该国为目标，直到 9 月份袭击才停止。周五，伊朗向美国雷达设施发射无人机，这一事件就此结束。美国中央司令部表示，击落了两架无人机，没有造成人员伤亡或财产损失。

paras.en: The attacks on Sunday prompted sirens and alerts from Bahrain’s authorities urging residents to seek shelter.
paras.zh: 周日的袭击事件引发了巴林当局的警报和警报，敦促居民寻求庇护。

paras.en: “It’s exactly what I was hoping wouldn’t happen: Iranian attacks starting again, with all the worry and uncertainty that go with them,” resident Hayat Ibrahim, 65, told Agence France Presse.
paras.zh: 65 岁的居民哈亚特·易卜拉欣 (Hayat Ibrahim) 告诉法新社：“这正是我希望不会发生的事情：伊朗的袭击再次开始，伴随着所有的担忧和不确定性。”

paras.en: Bahrain’s foreign ministry called the resumption of attacks “heinous aggression” and a flagrant violation of international law.
paras.zh: 巴林外交部称恢复袭击是“令人发指的侵略”，是对国际法的公然违反。

paras.en: The kingdom rejected Tehran’s “flimsy pretexts and baseless claims” to target its territory, it said in a statement. “The kingdom also rejects the transformation of its territory into an arena for settling scores and holds Iran fully responsible for these attacks and their consequences.”
paras.zh: 沙特在一份声明中表示，拒绝德黑兰针对其领土的“站不住脚的借口和毫无根据的主张”。 “沙特王国还拒绝将其领土转变为算账的场所，并要求伊朗对这些袭击及其后果承担全部责任。”

paras.en: Jordan, Egypt, Saudi Arabia, and Qatar condemned the attacks and expressed solidarity with Bahrain.
paras.zh: 约旦、埃及、沙特阿拉伯和卡塔尔谴责袭击事件，并对巴林表示声援。

paras.en: In Yemen, Saudi Arabia’s campaign against the Iranian-aligned Houthi rebels reeled when forces fighting on behalf of the Yemeni government retreated from the Bab el-Mandeb strait to defend Aden on the southern coast.
paras.zh: 在也门，当代表也门政府作战的部队从曼德海峡撤退以保卫南部海岸的亚丁时，沙特阿拉伯针对与伊朗结盟的胡塞叛军的行动陷入了困境。

paras.en: “The Southern Armed Forces announce the implementation of a redeployment operation for its forces from Dhubab Airport and the Bab el-Mandeb area, west of Taiz Governorate,” the main military force fighting for Yemen’s government in the south said in a statement.
paras.zh: 在南部为也门政府作战的主要军事力量在一份声明中表示，“南方武装部队宣布从杜巴布机场和塔伊兹省以西的曼德布地区实施重新部署部队行动。”

paras.en: The admission signalled the apparent failure of a six-week government counteroffensive to drive the Houthis from the mouth of the Red Sea to secure a key oil route.
paras.zh: 这一承认标志着政府为将胡塞武装赶出红海口以确保一条重要石油路线而进行的为期六周的反攻显然失败了。

paras.en: A Houthi missile strike near Aden killed people and wounded 12 near Aden, AFP reported, citing military and government sources.
paras.zh: 据法新社援引军方和政府消息来源报道，胡塞武装在亚丁附近发动导弹袭击，造成 12 人死亡、12 人受伤。

articles.title: Hundreds of thousands of Czechs protest in Prague over media freedom
articles.author: Rory Carroll

paras.en: Hundreds of thousands of Czechs have rallied in Prague to protest against a perceived government attempt to stifle media freedom.
paras.zh: 数十万捷克人在布拉格集会，抗议政府试图扼杀媒体自由。

paras.en: The gathering on Sunday to save the mandatory licence fees that fund Czechia’s public broadcasters drew more than 350,000 people, making it one of the biggest in the country’s history, organisers said.
paras.zh: 组织者称，周日为节省捷克公共广播公司强制许可费而举行的集会吸引了超过 35 万人参加，成为该国历史上规模最大的集会之一。

paras.en: Many people wore triangular paper hats similar to an animated TV character called Večerníček, a children’s bedtime story mascot who has become a symbol of the protest. Others carried banners saying: “We won’t give media away.”
paras.zh: 许多人戴着类似于动画电视角色 Večerníček 的三角形纸帽，Večerníček 是一个儿童睡前故事吉祥物，已成为抗议活动的象征。其他人举着横幅，上面写着：“我们不会放弃媒体。”

paras.en: The event was held at the capital’s Letná Plain, the cradle of the 1989 Velvet Revolution which ended more than 40 years of communist rule in the country.
paras.zh: 该活动在首都莱特纳平原举行，该平原是 1989 年天鹅绒革命的摇篮，这场革命结束了该国 40 多年的共产主义统治。

paras.en: It marked the latest challenge to the prime minister, Andrej Babiš, and his coalition of populist, hard-right nationalist and Eurosceptic parties, and follows weeks of demonstrations in towns and cities and a strike by staff at Czech TV and Czech Radio.
paras.zh: 这是对总理安德烈·巴比什及其民粹主义、极右翼民族主义和欧洲怀疑论政党联盟的最新挑战，此前城镇和城市进行了数周的示威活动，捷克电视台和捷克广播电台的工作人员也举行了罢工。

paras.en: Protesters say the plan to scrap licence fees and fund the broadcasters from the state budget would give ministers more leverage over newsrooms and follows the example of Hungary, Poland, Serbia and Slovakia, where current and previous rightwing populist governments eroded media independence.
paras.zh: 抗议者表示，取消许可费并从国家预算中为广播公司提供资金的计划将使部长们对新闻编辑室拥有更大的影响力，并效仿了匈牙利、波兰、塞尔维亚和斯洛伐克的例子，这些国家的现任和前任右翼民粹主义政府侵蚀了媒体独立性。

paras.en: A series of protests has been held since late October, when the first reading of the bill to scrap the licence fees was pushed through in the middle of the night.
paras.zh: 自10月下旬取消牌照费法案一读在半夜获得通过以来，已经发生了一系列抗议活动。

paras.en: The Million Moments for Democracy group, which organised the demonstration, said the authorities would now grasp the level of opposition. “We do witness here something extraordinary today,” said Mikuláš Minář, the lead organiser. “It’s just a beginning.”
paras.zh: 组织这次示威活动的“民主百万时刻”组织表示，当局现在将了解反对的程度。 “今天我们确实在这里见证了一些非同寻常的事情，”主要组织者米库拉斯·米纳日 (Mikuláš Minář) 说道。 “这只是一个开始。”

paras.en: In a statement, the group demanded that the government withdraw its plan and expressed concern that Babiš and his coalition partners posed a threat to democracy. “Babiš and his government obviously think they will get away with anything … that they can ignore experts, silence critics and treat democratic institutions like their property,” the group said.
paras.zh: 该组织在一份声明中要求政府撤回其计划，并对巴比什及其联盟伙伴对民主构成威胁表示担忧。该组织表示：“巴比什和他的政府显然认为，他们会做任何事情都不会受到惩罚……他们可以无视专家、压制批评者并像对待自己的财产一样对待民主机构。”

paras.en: “We refuse the Slovak scenario,” said one protest banner. “Hands off the media,” said another.
paras.zh: “我们拒绝斯洛伐克的情景，”一条抗议横幅上写着。另一位网友表示：“别插手媒体。”

paras.en: Šárka Dumišincová, a singer, said for her the media represented freedom. “The fact that someone here is trying to control that freedom is unacceptable to me. That’s why I’m here today,” she told the Associated Press.
paras.zh: 歌手萨卡·杜米辛科瓦 (Šárka Dumišincová) 表示，对她来说，媒体代表着自由。 “这里有人试图控制自由，这一事实对我来说是不可接受的。这就是我今天来这里的原因，”她告诉美联社。

paras.en: “We need to keep media independent. The government is taking steps to control them, cut their funding and affect what they broadcast,” computer programmer Jan Snasel told AFP at the rally.
paras.zh: “我们需要保持媒体独立。政府正在采取措施控制他们，削减他们的资金并影响他们的广播内容，”计算机程序员扬·斯纳塞尔在集会上告诉法新社。

paras.en: The proposed changes, which would cut state television and radio budgets by about 15%, have drawn fire from international media organisations.
paras.zh: 拟议的改革将把国家电视台和广播电台的预算削减约 15%，此举引起了国际媒体组织的批评。

paras.en: The European Broadcasting Union, the European Federation of Journalists, Reporters Without Borders and the International Press Institute have also criticised the government’s media plan, likening it to controversial moves by Slovakia’s prime minister, Robert Fico, and Hungary’s former premier Viktor Orbán.
paras.zh: 欧洲广播联盟、欧洲记者联合会、无国界记者组织和国际新闻学院也批评了政府的媒体计划，将其比作斯洛伐克总理罗伯特·菲科和匈牙利前总理维克托·欧尔班有争议的举动。

paras.en: Babiš, a billionaire who returned to power last year, said protesters were riling up the public with unfounded claims about threats to media freedom.
paras.zh: 去年重新掌权的亿万富翁巴比什表示，抗议者以毫无根据的言论威胁媒体自由，激怒了公众。

paras.en: Last week, he published an op-ed on what he called the “seven lies” being peddled by the opposition over the licence fees, which together add up to 205 koruna (£7) a month.
paras.zh: 上周，他发表了一篇专栏文章，讨论反对派在许可费问题上兜售的“七个谎言”，这些许可费加起来每月达 205 克朗（7 英镑）。

paras.en: “Anyone who talks about ‘nationalisation’ [of public media] is deliberately lying,” he wrote, describing the criticism as “hysterical outbursts”. “Under no circumstances will we interfere in editorial work.”
paras.zh: “任何谈论[公共媒体]‘国有化’的人都是故意撒谎，”他写道，并将这些批评描述为“歇斯底里的爆发”。 “在任何情况下我们都不会干涉编辑工作。”

paras.en: Babiš heads a coalition that includes his ANO, or YES, movement, the rightwing Motorists for Themselves and the anti-migrant and pro-Russian Freedom and Direct Democracy party. Despite the protests, ANO still enjoys the backing of about 30% in opinion polls.
paras.zh: 巴比什领导的联盟包括他的 ANO（或 YES）运动、右翼自驾车党以及反移民和亲俄罗斯的自由与直接民主党。尽管遭到抗议，ANO 在民意调查中仍获得约 30% 的支持。

articles.title: Estonia to close all border crossings with Russia after attack on drone maker
articles.author: Jakub Krupa

paras.en: Estonia will close all its border crossings with Russia from 1 December after a suspected sabotage attack on a drone maker in the Baltic state over the weekend, which authorities said was ordered by Russia’s GRU military intelligence service.
paras.zh: 爱沙尼亚将从 12 月 1 日起关闭与俄罗斯的所有过境点，此前波罗的海国家的一家无人机制造商周末遭到疑似破坏袭击，当局称这是俄罗斯格鲁乌军事情报部门下令的。

paras.en: On Saturday morning, eight people were detained during an attempted attack on Threod Systems, a defence company that manufactures long-range attack and reconnaissance drones. No injuries or damage were reported after the company’s security team responded to the incident.
paras.zh: 周六上午，生产远程攻击和侦察无人机的国防公司 Threod Systems 遭到未遂袭击，八人被拘留。该公司的安全团队对事件做出回应后，没有人员受伤或损坏的报告。

paras.en: Estonia’s internal security service, Kapo, said on Sunday the attack was carried out “with the aim of causing an explosion and setting the building on fire”. Authorities have requested a court order for five of those detained to remain in custody, Estonia’s public broadcaster ERR reported.
paras.zh: 爱沙尼亚内部安全部门卡波周日表示，此次袭击“的目的是引起爆炸并点燃建筑物”。据爱沙尼亚公共广播公司 ERR 报道，当局已请求法院下令继续拘留其中五名被拘留者。

paras.en: The Estonian prime minister, Kristen Michal, said the border closure was needed to reduce the risk of further attacks and “send a clear message that attacks on Estonia’s defence industry and defence capabilities” were unacceptable.
paras.zh: 爱沙尼亚总理克里斯汀·米哈尔表示，需要关闭边境，以减少进一步袭击的风险，并“发出明确的信息，即对爱沙尼亚国防工业和国防能力的袭击是不可接受的”。

paras.en: He linked the attacks with Estonia’s continuing support for Ukraine. “Russia’s aim is to make us afraid, make us hesitate and weaken our support for Ukraine. Estonia’s response is the opposite. We will strengthen our security, work even more closely with businesses and our allies, increase pressure on Russia and continue supporting Ukraine,” Michal said.
paras.zh: 他将这些袭击与爱沙尼亚对乌克兰的持续支持联系起来。 “俄罗斯的目的是让我们感到害怕、让我们犹豫并削弱我们对乌克兰的支持。爱沙尼亚的反应恰恰相反。我们将加强我们的安全，与企业和盟友更加密切地合作，加大对俄罗斯的压力，并继续支持乌克兰，”米哈尔说。

paras.en: The Estonian foreign minister, Margus Tsahkna, echoed the warning, saying: “Russia must understand that hostile actions against Estonia come with consequences. Attempts to intimidate, destabilise, or undermine our security will not go unanswered.”
paras.zh: 爱沙尼亚外交部长马格斯·查克纳(Margus Tsahkna)回应了这一警告，他说：“俄罗斯必须明白，针对爱沙尼亚的敌对行动会带来后果。恐吓、破坏稳定或破坏我们安全的企图不会得不到回应。”

paras.en: Estonia operates three border crossings with Russia – Narva in the north, and Koidula and Luhamaa in the south. The authorities did not specify how long the closure would be.
paras.zh: 爱沙尼亚与俄罗斯设有三个过境点——北部的纳尔瓦，南部的科伊杜拉和卢哈马。当局没有具体说明关闭的时间。

paras.en: It is the second attempted attack on an Estonian defence firm that authorities have attributed to Russia, following an arson attack at Milrem Robotics in August.
paras.zh: 这是继 8 月份 Milrem Robotics 发生纵火袭击后，当局将其归咎于俄罗斯的第二次针对爱沙尼亚国防公司的未遂袭击。

paras.en: In September, Kapo said it was confident that incident was “a deliberate and pre-planned attack carried out on behalf of Russian special services”. The agency also said it fitted a pattern of Russian attacks targeting defence and drone companies, particularly those with links to Ukraine.
paras.zh: 9月，卡波表示确信该事件是“代表俄罗斯特种部门进行的一次蓄意且预先计划的袭击”。该机构还表示，它符合俄罗斯针对国防和无人机公司的攻击模式，特别是那些与乌克兰有联系的公司。

paras.en: At the time Estonia summoned Russia’s chargé d’affaires over the attack, but the Kremlin denied any link to Russia, saying it was a “baseless” and “ill-considered” accusation “with absolutely no relation to reality”.
paras.zh: 当时爱沙尼亚就此次袭击事件召见了俄罗斯临时代办，但克里姆林宫否认与俄罗斯有任何联系，称这是“毫无根据”和“考虑不周”的指控，“与现实完全无关”。

paras.en: Several European intelligence services have repeatedly warned of potential attacks against defence companies and growing Russian attempts to recruit citizens in EU and Nato countries on messaging platforms online to carry out acts of sabotage.
paras.zh: 一些欧洲情报机构一再警告称，国防公司可能受到攻击，俄罗斯越来越多地试图通过在线消息平台招募欧盟和北约国家的公民进行破坏活动。

paras.en: Michal noted that the weekend’s arrests came after security agencies told the defence industry of potential risks. “We do not warn about these threats without reason. Preparedness matters, and this time it clearly paid off,” he said.
paras.zh: 米哈尔指出，周末的逮捕行动是在安全机构向国防工业告知潜在风险之后进行的。 “我们不会无缘无故地警告这些威胁。做好准备很重要，这一次显然得到了回报，”他说。

articles.title: Suspected China spy linked to Nvidia's ex-boss left in 2025, Megaspeed says

paras.en: Alice Huang, a suspected China spy who has been linked to Nvidia's former boss Jensen Huang, left her executive role at Megaspeed in August last year, the company says.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，与英伟达前老板黄仁勋有联系的涉嫌中国间谍的爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 于去年 8 月辞去 Megaspeed 的高管职务。

paras.en: Jensen Huang resigned as chief executive of the AI chip-making giant Nvidia after it emerged he had allegedly had affairs with Alice Huang as well as with one of his employees.
paras.zh: 黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 辞去了人工智能芯片制造巨头英伟达 (Nvidia) 首席执行官的职务，因为他涉嫌与 Alice Huang 及其一名员工有染。

paras.en: Megaspeed is the biggest buyer of Nvidia chips in south-east Asia and the scandal at Nvidia has raised questions about the possibility that high-end AI chips may have ended up in China despite US export restrictions.
paras.zh: Megaspeed 是 Nvidia 芯片在东南亚的最大买家，Nvidia 的丑闻引发了人们的质疑，即尽管美国实施出口限制，高端 AI 芯片最终可能会销往中国。

paras.en: The Singapore-based company said on Sunday it had launched an internal investigation into its business.
paras.zh: 这家总部位于新加坡的公司周日表示，已对其业务展开内部调查。

paras.en: It said it was aware of reports "containing assertions about our business, supply chain and global operations that are not supported by verifiable evidence".
paras.zh: 该公司表示，它知道有报道“包含有关我们业务、供应链和全球运营的断言，但这些断言没有可验证的证据支持”。

paras.en: It added that it "conducts legitimate and lawful business" and has "retained external legal counsel to conduct a thorough internal investigation".
paras.zh: 它补充说，它“开展合法合法的业务”，并“聘请了外部法律顾问来进行彻底的内部调查”。

paras.en: On Friday, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent blamed fellow Trump cabinet colleague Howard Lutnick's commerce department for failing to properly oversee the export of high-end chips.
paras.zh: 周五，美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特指责特朗普内阁同事霍华德·卢特尼克的商务部未能妥善监管高端芯片的出口。

paras.en: Bessent told CNBC that several agencies "were in favour of putting Megaspeed on the entity list for months... but Commerce has the pen... and you will have to ask them about their internal process".
paras.zh: Bessent 告诉 CNBC，数家机构“几个月来一直赞成将 Megaspeed 列入实体名单……但商务部有笔……你必须询问他们的内部流程”。

paras.en: The so-called entity list restricts US trade with overseas firms and individuals.
paras.zh: 所谓的实体清单限制美国与海外公司和个人的贸易。

paras.en: Lutnick has been called to testify before the Senate Banking Committee next month over his department's role in allowing Nvidia to export its advanced chips.
paras.zh: 卢特尼克下个月被要求在参议院银行委员会就其部门在允许英伟达出口其先进芯片方面所扮演的角色作证。

paras.en: Other congressional committees have asked both Lutnick and his department to retain all records relating to Nvidia and Jensen Huang.
paras.zh: 其他国会委员会已要求卢特尼克和他的部门保留与 Nvidia 和黄仁勋有关的所有记录。

paras.en: Megaspeed is suspected of giving backdoor access to Nvidia chips to Chinese companies via its data centres in Malaysia, Indonesia and Thailand.
paras.zh: Megaspeed 涉嫌通过其位于马来西亚、印度尼西亚和泰国的数据中心向中国公司提供对 Nvidia 芯片的后门访问。

paras.en: Nvidia has been banned from selling its advanced chips to China.
paras.zh: 英伟达已被禁止向中国出售其先进芯片。

paras.en: While Singapore does not prohibit the transfer of advanced AI chips to companies abroad, such moves can breach US export controls.
paras.zh: 虽然新加坡并不禁止向海外公司转让先进的人工智能芯片，但此类举动可能违反美国的出口管制。

paras.en: Singapore has said that while it does not enforce "unilateral export controls imposed by other countries" it expects all companies in its jurisdiction to respect such regulations.
paras.zh: 新加坡表示，虽然它不执行“其他国家实施的单方面出口管制”，但希望其管辖范围内的所有公司都遵守此类规定。

paras.en: Megaspeed said it "designs and maintains its global operational and supply-chain control frameworks to comply with all applicable laws and regulatory regimes". It said this includes "US export control requirements and local jurisdiction rules in every market where we operate".
paras.zh: Megaspeed 表示，它“设计和维护其全球运营和供应链控制框架，以遵守所有适用的法律和监管制度”。它表示，这包括“我们经营所在的每个市场的美国出口管制要求和当地管辖规则”。

paras.en: China has denied that Alice Huang is a spy and warned the US not to use the scandal as a "pretext for imposing a technological blockade" on AI technology.
paras.zh: 中国否认黄爱丽是间谍，并警告美国不要利用该丑闻作为对人工智能技术实施技术封锁的借口。

articles.title: Czechs rally against plan to switch funding of public media

paras.en: Thousands of people have gathered in central Prague to protest against the Czech government's plans to scrap the licence fee and use the state budget to fund public media.
paras.zh: 数千人聚集在布拉格市中心，抗议捷克政府取消许可费并使用国家预算资助公共媒体的计划。

paras.en: Critics say the plans would allow politicians to stifle media freedom.
paras.zh: 批评者称，这些计划将允许政客扼杀媒体自由。

paras.en: The coalition government - which consists of the populist ANO party and two right-wing Eurosceptic parties - insists the change will not affect editorial independence, but wants broadcasters to cut costs.
paras.zh: 由民粹主义 ANO 党和两个右翼欧洲怀疑论党组成的联合政府坚称这一变化不会影响编辑独立性，但希望广播公司削减成本。

paras.en: Parliament passed the first draft of the proposal late last month. Since then, thousands of Czechs have taken part in protests.
paras.zh: 议会上个月末通过了该提案的初稿。此后，数千名捷克人参加了抗议活动。

paras.en: Czech households currently pay â 205 crowns ($9.44; Â£7.06) a month for TV and radio.
paras.zh: 捷克家庭目前每月为电视和广播支付 205 克朗（9.44 美元；7.06 英镑）。

paras.en: Sunday's protest was organised by the Million Moments for Democracy association which said "roughly 400,000" people had attended.
paras.zh: 周日的抗议活动是由“民主百万时刻”协会组织的，该协会称“大约有 40 万人”参加了抗议活动。

paras.en: "I know that our entire Czech Television is a guarantee of truth and objectivity," pensioner Milana Rudolfova, 72, told Reuters news agency.
paras.zh: 72 岁的养老金领取者米拉娜·鲁多尔芙娃 (Milana Rudolfova) 告诉路透社：“我知道我们整个捷克电视台都是真实性和客观性的保证。”

paras.en: "If we do not have public television and radio then unfortunately we will not be able to believe anything anymore."
paras.zh: “如果我们没有公共电视和广播，那么不幸的是我们将无法再相信任何事情。”

paras.en: Prime Minister Andrej Babis has insisted the government does not want to control public media.
paras.zh: 总理安德烈·巴比斯坚称政府不想控制公共媒体。

paras.en: "The funding system is changing, no one wants to control public media, no one wants to dictate to them what they should say and do, no one wants to nationalise them," Babis told the Czech News Agency.
paras.zh: 巴比斯告诉捷克通讯社：“资助体系正在发生变化，没有人想控制公共媒体，没有人想向他们发号施令，他们应该说什么和做什么，没有人想将他们国有化。”

paras.en: "We are doing this because the system is already outdated and most of Europe is going the same way today and others are joining in," he added.
paras.zh: “我们这样做是因为这个系统已经过时了，欧洲大部分地区今天也在走同样的路，其他国家也正在加入，”他补充道。

paras.en: Some European countries, including France and Norway, have moved away from the public licence fee model in the last few years.
paras.zh: 包括法国和挪威在内的一些欧洲国家在过去几年中已经放弃了公共许可费模式。

paras.en: France removed it in 2022 and its public media, which also carries advertising, is now funded by a portion of the income from VAT.
paras.zh: 法国于 2022 年取消了这一政策，其公共媒体（也有广告）现在由增值税收入的一部分提供资金。

paras.en: Norway abolished its license fee in 2020 and moved its public broadcaster's funding into the national budget.
paras.zh: 挪威于 2020 年取消了牌照费，并将其公共广播公司的资金纳入国家预算。

paras.en: Some protesters wore pointed hats folded out of newspapers as a tribute to an animated character, Vecernicek, who has introduced Czech Television's nightly children's bedtime stories for decades.
paras.zh: 一些抗议者戴着用报纸折叠起来的尖顶帽子，以向动画人物韦切尔尼切克致敬，几十年来，他一直介绍捷克电视台每晚的儿童睡前故事。

paras.en: Critics have compared the government's media bill to changes in Hungary under former Prime Minister Viktor OrbÃ¡n, who tightly controlled state media when he was in power.
paras.zh: 批评者将政府的媒体法案与匈牙利前总理欧尔班·维克托(Viktor Orbán)领导下发生的变化进行比较，后者在执政期间严格控制国家媒体。

paras.en: Prime Minister Andrej Babis was appointed in December in 2025, and has faced criticism over his coalition's attacks on Czech media.
paras.zh: 总理安德烈·巴比斯 (Andrej Babis) 于 2025 年 12 月被任命，并因其联盟对捷克媒体的攻击而面临批评。

paras.en: "Political attacks against private and public media have become one of the hallmarks of Andrej Babis' premiership," said Pavol Szalai, Prague Bureau director of international press freedom organisation Reporters Without Borders, in June.
paras.zh: 国际新闻自由组织无国界记者布拉格分社主任帕沃尔·萨莱 (Pavol Szalai) 6 月表示：“针对私人和公共媒体的政治攻击已成为安德烈·巴比斯 (Andrej Babis) 总理任期的标志之一。”

articles.title: Zelensky urges US and Musk to lift Starlink restrictions and be on 'right side of history'

paras.en: A crucial US satellite internet service is still operating too slowly and affecting Ukraine's ability to stop Russian attacks, President Volodymyr Zelensky has said.
paras.zh: 总统泽连斯基表示，美国一项重要的卫星互联网服务运行速度仍然太慢，影响了乌克兰阻止俄罗斯袭击的能力。

paras.en: "We are counting on these restrictions being lifted. The protection of lives and Ukraine's energy infrastructure ahead of winter directly depends on this," he said.
paras.zh: “我们指望这些限制能够被取消。冬季到来之前对生命和乌克兰能源基础设施的保护直接取决于这一点，”他说。

paras.en: The issue over the speed of the Starshield system - a military military-grade Starlink service owned by Elon Musk and provided to Ukraine by the US government - has been rumbling on for weeks.
paras.zh: 关于“星盾”系统（由埃隆·马斯克拥有、由美国政府向乌克兰提供的军用级星链服务）的速度问题已经持续了数周。

paras.en: Zelensky said he had asked officials "to work as closely as possible" with the US government and Musk's company. "It is important to be on the right side of history," he said.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，他已要求官员与美国政府和马斯克的公司“尽可能密切合作”。 “站在历史正确的一边很重要，”他说。

paras.en: Ukraine uses the normal Starlink service for communications on the battlefield, while Starshield is used for the interception of missiles and drones in Ukraine airspace.
paras.zh: 乌克兰使用普通的星链服务进行战场通信，而星盾则用于拦截乌克兰领空的导弹和无人机。

paras.en: The issue of speed restrictions was first identified in October. It led to conflicting accounts by both Elon Musk and US President Donald Trump.
paras.zh: 限速问题于 10 月份首次被发现。这导致埃隆·马斯克和美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的说法相互矛盾。

paras.en: Musk said the US government was responsible as Starshield was controlled by them, but Trump denied being responsible and said he had told the billionaire owner to "put it back".
paras.zh: 马斯克表示，美国政府应对星盾负责，因为星盾是由他们控制的，但特朗普否认对此负责，并表示他已告诉这位亿万富翁老板“把它放回去”。

paras.en: It appeared to be returning to normal after a week, following which Ukraine said the restrictions were still being implemented.
paras.zh: 一周后情况似乎恢复正常，随后乌克兰表示仍在实施限制。

paras.en: The connection issues coincided with a tense diplomatic stand-off between Zelensky and Trump over Ukrainian strikes on oil infrastructure within Russia.
paras.zh: 这些连接问题恰逢泽伦斯基和特朗普之间因乌克兰袭击俄罗斯境内石油基础设施而陷入紧张的外交对峙。

paras.en: Trump said the strikes on Russian oil refineries, which Kyiv says are crucial to stemming the main revenue source for Moscow's war effort, had pushed global prices higher.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，对俄罗斯炼油厂的袭击推高了全球油价，基辅称这对于阻止莫斯科战争的主要收入来源至关重要。

paras.en: On Sunday Zelensky said Ukraine was struggling to intercept Russian jet-powered drones targeting electricity substations because "restrictions on the operating speed of Starshield terminals along the front line and in the temporarily occupied territories are still there".
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基周日表示，乌克兰正在努力拦截针对变电站的俄罗斯喷气式无人机，因为“前线和临时占领领土上的星盾终端运行速度仍然受到限制”。

paras.en: "Our interceptor drones lose connection with their operators at a speed of 161km/h (100mph) and simply cannot catch up with Russian jet-powered 'shaheds'," he posted, referring to the drones that follow an Iranian design.
paras.zh: “我们的拦截无人机以 161 公里/小时（100 英里/小时）的速度与操作员失去联系，根本无法追上俄罗斯喷气动力‘沙赫德’，”他指的是遵循伊朗设计的无人机。

paras.en: Ukraine has also been beset by a shortage of US-made Patriot interceptors used to defend against Russian missiles - a situation that Russia has exploited to intensify strikes on Ukrainian targets.
paras.zh: 乌克兰还受到用于防御俄罗斯导弹的美制爱国者拦截机短缺的困扰，俄罗斯利用这种情况加强了对乌克兰目标的打击。

paras.en: Overnight and into Sunday morning Russia hit energy infrastructure in Zaporizhzhia and the Sumy, Odesa, Zhytomyr, and Kirovohrad regions, Ukraine said.
paras.zh: 乌克兰称，从一夜之间到周日早上，俄罗斯袭击了扎波罗热、苏梅、敖德萨、日托米尔和基洛沃拉德地区的能源基础设施。

paras.en: It also struck railway infrastructure in the Dnipro, Kharkiv, and Zaporizhzhia regions.
paras.zh: 它还袭击了第聂伯罗、哈尔科夫和扎波罗热地区的铁路基础设施。

paras.en: Scores of people are said to have been hurt in those attacks, as well as two in the Donetsk and Kyiv regions.
paras.zh: 据称，数十人在这些袭击中受伤，顿涅茨克和基辅地区也有两人受伤。

paras.en: Two people were killed in an attack on an infrastructure facility in Chernihiv Region's Mena, governor Vyacheslav Chaus said.
paras.zh: 切尔尼戈夫州梅纳州州长维亚切斯拉夫·乔斯 (Vyacheslav Chaus) 表示，切尔尼戈夫州梅纳州一处基础设施遭到袭击，造成两人死亡。

paras.en: Multiple strikes were also delivered on energy facilities across the region, he added on Telegram.
paras.zh: 他在 Telegram 上补充道，该地区的能源设施也遭受了多次袭击。

paras.en: Ukraine meanwhile said it had carried out strikes on a petrochemical plant and an oil refinery in the central Russian city of Nizhnekamsk.
paras.zh: 与此同时，乌克兰表示对俄罗斯中部城市下卡姆斯克的一家石化厂和一家炼油厂进行了袭击。

paras.en: "On the night of November 15, units of Ukraine's Defence Forces reached Nizhnekamsk in Tatarstan," the military said on Telegram.
paras.zh: 军方在 Telegram 上表示：“11 月 15 日晚，乌克兰国防军部队抵达鞑靼斯坦的下卡姆斯克。”

paras.en: "Two enterprises that feed the Russian war with raw materials and fuel came under attack."
paras.zh: “两家为俄罗斯战争提供原材料和燃料的企业受到了攻击。”

paras.en: Other Ukrainian strikes killed one person in Taganrog, an industrial port city near the border, regional governor Yuri Slyusar said.
paras.zh: 地区州长尤里·斯柳萨尔 (Yuri Slyusar) 表示，乌克兰边境附近的工业港口城市塔甘罗格的其他袭击造成一人死亡。

paras.en: In the occupied Luhansk region a lorry driver and an elderly woman were also killed, Leonid Pasechnik, the regional leader installed by Moscow said.
paras.zh: 莫斯科任命的地区领导人列昂尼德·帕谢奇尼克(Leonid Pasechnik)表示，在被占领的卢甘斯克地区，一名卡车司机和一名老年妇女也被杀。

paras.en: Meanwhile Estonia has announced it will shut its border crossing points with Russia from 1 December following a suspected sabotage attack on a defence company.
paras.zh: 与此同时，爱沙尼亚宣布，在一家国防公司遭受疑似破坏袭击后，将从 12 月 1 日起关闭与俄罗斯的过境点。

paras.en: Eight people were detained over an attempted arson attack on drone maker Threod Systems.
paras.zh: 八人因企图纵火袭击无人机制造商 Threod Systems 而被拘留。

paras.en: The Estonian authorities say they had been ordered by Russia's GRU military intelligence service to try and carry out the attack. Russia has not commented.
paras.zh: 爱沙尼亚当局表示，俄罗斯格鲁乌军事情报部门命令他们尝试实施这次袭击。俄罗斯尚未发表评论。

paras.en: "Russia must understand that hostile actions against Estonia come with consequences," Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna said.
paras.zh: “俄罗斯必须明白，针对爱沙尼亚的敌对行动会带来后果，”外交部长马古斯·查克纳说。

articles.title: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian

paras.en: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian

SK Wellman, a company specializing in the production of brake and frictions components for off-highway, has a lively DNA. A historical reality in Orzinuovi (Bs), where the plant is still located, over the years it has undergone transformations and changes that have contributed to making it what it is today: an evolved company, able to grow in loyalty to the local Italian territory and to innovate its sector with creativity and flexibility worldwide. Today, as part of the CentroMotion Group and its Carlisle Brake & Friction division, SK Wellman is a leader in its segment, recognized and chosen by major brands in earthmoving, agricultural and construction machinery. Engineer Alessandro Gamba, Global Director of Friction Engineering, tells us about the ongoing growth.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: "S.K. Wellman S.R.L. has 340 employees and a turnover of 127 million by 2023," Gamba begins. In the last five years, a strong push has come from the market but above all from the characteristics of SK, such as creativity, innovation, flexibility, which, in the final analysis, are the result of the greatest wealth of this company: people". They are the ones who make the Brescia-based company an authentic and tenacious company, to the point of being able to export not only their products successfully, but also their skills and design skills to the other plants of the Carlisle Brake & Friction division. The year 2023, which has just ended, confirms a positive performance in turnover for sales revenues alone, recording a slight decrease of -5% compared to the previous exceptional 2022 financial year; A year, the latter, probably unrepeatable for many realities of the Brescia and non-Brescia economy. In fact, 2023 was undoubtedly the year of change that helped people develop a greater ability to manage uncertainty, accepting and dealing with unexpected situations with more resilience.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: "At the base of success there is a matrix organization developed thanks to group governance - explains the engineer -: a verticality driven on all functions and skills, able to define and guide processes on a global scale and generate best practices. And that's not all," adds Gamba, "we are one of the companies with the lowest level of turnover, and this allows us to transfer the experience of those who have been with us for a long time to young people, on whom we particularly focus. Added to this is a company population of 15 different nationalities, whose strong collaboration creates a truly serene working climate," says the HR Manager. It is no coincidence that the direction of growth is particularly social responsibility.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: "Among the main projects of SK Wellman and Carlisle - he observes - stands out Enactus, an international non-profit organization that, thanks to its activity, involves university students in the creation of sustainable entrepreneurial projects, helping to bridge the gap between university and business; and then Treedom, which involves the company's commitment to planting 1,600 trees in three years, involving its stakeholders in the project". Two more rare gems for the metalworking industry? A level of accidents at work that borders on zero, and the centrality of talent development. Towards excellence and beyond.

articles.title: A Holiday Season of Giving

paras.en: This holiday season, Carlisle Brake & Friction’s Medina location is proud to support 15 children of our colleagues who could use a little extra cheer. Our employees have generously donated toys, clothing, and other essential items to bring joy to these young lives.

By coming together as a team, we’re demonstrating our commitment to making a positive impact on our community. We’re grateful for the kindness and generosity of our employees, and we hope this initiative will bring warmth and happiness to the children who receive these gifts.

articles.title: Sales, marketing and operations dominate Q3 aftermarket hiring – GCA
articles.author: Andrew

paras.en: Sales, marketing and operations dominate Q3 aftermarket hiring – GCA

Sales, marketing and operations roles accounted for 88 per cent of all appointments made by specialist recruiter Glen Callum Associates (GCA) during the third quarter of 2026, reflecting a strong industry focus on winning new business, retaining clients and maintaining supply chain momentum.

According to GCA’s latest quarterly report, automotive businesses represented 74 per cent of total placements, with allied sectors making up the remaining 26 per cent, and Central England emerging as the most active hiring region. Customer-facing positions led demand, with field-based roles comprising 71 per cent of appointments, compared with 23 per cent for office or on-site positions and 6 per cent for fully remote roles. articles.title: ClickMechanic helps experienced technician transition to self-employment
articles.author: Andrew

paras.en: ClickMechanic helps experienced technician transition to self-employment

Online vehicle repair marketplace ClickMechanic is helping experienced automotive technicians overcome the financial and administrative hurdles of launching independent mobile businesses, according to the co-founder of a North West-based operator.

After 15 years managing independent garages, Luke Blyth established L&O Vehicle Services a year ago, utilising ClickMechanic’s commission-only platform to secure consistent bookings without incurring fixed monthly overheads or marketing costs. Operating across the North West, the business typically completes five to six platform jobs per week – ranging from routine maintenance to high-value clutches, cambelts, and diagnostics – to complement its direct retail work.

Beyond lead generation, ClickMechanic’s automated quoting and customer approval tools significantly reduce evening administrative workloads, allowing mobile technicians to maximise billable hours. The platform also enforces strict entry standards, requiring at least five years of experience, an NVQ Level 2 or City & Guilds qualification, and comprehensive public liability and motor trade road-risk insurance.

Highlighting the platform’s role in his launch, Blyth said: “I’d always wanted to work for myself, but the timing never felt right. In the end, I got talking to someone who later became my business partner. We just decided to go for it, and ClickMechanic was the push that gave us the confidence to step out on our own. Knowing there were jobs sitting there waiting for us meant we didn’t have to lie awake worrying, ‘Where is the next job coming from?’ if the phone went quiet.”
By offering flexible, quota-free access to work, ClickMechanic continues to provide a low-risk springboard for skilled mechanics entering self-employment.

articles.title: Two automakers change security systems two hours after alerted of vulnerability
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Two automakers changed their security systems within hours after a team of hackers notified them of a vulnerability that allowed remote access to unlock and start the automakers’ vehicles.

Shubham Shaw and Sam Curry, white hat hackers, found vulnerabilities on ForgeRock servers that allowed them access to customer logins for two automakers, according to a Nov. 7 post from the hackers. White hat hackers look for vulnerabilities in systems before the weakness can be used for malicious purposes.
The post doesn’t identify the automakers.
The affected system served customers in multiple regions, but the hackers say they only tested U.S. accounts and vehicles.

“In the past few years, we’d found ways to remotely control vehicles from Honda, Acura, Nissan, Infiniti, Hyundai, Genesis, Ford, Porsche, Kia, and Subaru, but we’d never found a vulnerability that enabled remote access to either an Automaker #1 or Automaker #2 vehicles,” the post states.

Once in the app, the hackers say they could see every vehicle VIN that the owner had in their garage, along with its location, mileage, fuel, battery range, tire pressure, door and window state, vehicle health, alerts, and subscription status.

According to the hackers, they first downloaded the Android version of the apps for both automakers and traced their authentication flows back to ForgeRock. The post describes ForgeRock as an identity platform used by both automakers to manage customer accounts and logins.

In the post, the hackers identified a series of steps they took to disable and enter the security system. This included replacing credentials and changing a user’s email and password to log in to ForgeRock.

“Changing the email address and password did not invalidate the account owner’s existing app session,” the post states. “During our authorized test, the owner’s app remained logged in while our new session worked alongside it.”
According to the hackers, they dug deeper into the identity stack than they originally expected.

“Production identity access extended across the affected directories for both automakers in multiple regions, and we validated the complete account-to-vehicle chain with live US accounts and vehicles,” the post adds.
The hackers accessed the vehicles in early 2026, the post states. The automakers were also notified of the vulnerability via a report provided to their product security teams in early 2026.
“Both automakers remediated the vulnerability approximately two hours after receiving the report,” the post states. “The proof bundle was removed, and the affected credentials were rotated.”
During a July Collision Industry Conference (CIC) meeting, Andrea Amico, Privacy4Cars founder and CEO, said the average car in the past 10 years has about 250 sensors.
“Cars have become the third personal computing device that consumers use every day,” he added.
However, vehicles typically lack encryption or hidden controls compared to phones or computers, he said.
Vehicles can collect personal data through cameras, microphones, GPS, and synced phones, he said. Data collected by vehicles includes call logs, garage codes, biometrics, contacts, and passwords.
During a separate CIC presentation, Tracy Dombrowski of Collision Advice provided an example of a woman who sold her vehicle to a dealer without disconnecting it from her app.

“She was able to follow that vehicle from the sale of the vehicle to Florida to Texas,” Dombrowski said. “She is still able to remote start that vehicle; she is still able to access that vehicle at any given time.”
The job of data removal typically falls on the consumer, she said. But shops can help consumers as a courtesy.
Dombrowski provided OEM webpages that offer resources for removing PPI.

articles.title: Nasdaq chief economist: Inflation will likely fade and interest rates will lower
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: Phil Mackintosh, Nasdaq chief economist and senior vice president, painted a picture of a resilient economy during the annual MSO Symposium held Nov. 2 and shared his predictions for the year ahead, including lower interest rates.

Mackintosh said the markets have “powered through” three big challenges over the last year: tariffs, the war in Iran, and interest rate changes. There are no recessions in the world, and “growth might be slow, but it’s positive enough to weather the shocks like we’ve been seeing,” he said.

“We’re definitely seeing the economy sort of turn around; things get more positive or less negative depending on which side of the economy you’re on,” Mackintosh said. “And because of that, in the labor market, we are starting to see a little bit of strength. [At] the start of the year, this was meant to be a really good tailwind for the stock market and a really good tailwind for company profits. It turns out the tailwind is still happening. Hiring is starting to pick back up.”
According to Mackintosh, tariffs didn’t create a big dent in the global economy, and have somewhat stabilized.
“Initially there was that huge spike in the average tariff rate. It’s actually been coming down,” he said.
Interest rates have also generally been coming down.

“They didn’t affect the economy as much as you think, even though for a lot of companies they definitely created a lot of uncertainty,” he said. “In terms of your industry, whether tariffs have impacted inflation much… the answer is not much at all.”

“The general trend in this industry in inflation is you’re on a deflationary trend, and now you’ve become deflationary, so the impact of tariffs from this industry onto the CPI [Consumer Price Index] actually is pretty small,” he said.

Effects on the oil market from the Iran War were digested much better than might’ve been expected, according to Mackintosh. He said that despite 20 million barrels a day missing from global supply, and the biggest shock to oil supply caused by wars dating back to the 1950s, the price of oil didn’t go up that much.
And that doesn’t seem to be getting better when looking at shipping data, he noted.
“The war is still active from an economic and supply perspective,” Mackintosh said.

As for interest rates, he said they have gone from definitely falling to definitely rising, if you trust the market, and the reason for that is inflation. Mackintosh said interest rates are now hiking quickly because the Federal Reserve waited so long for transitory oil-driven inflation to go away.

“The Fed is not sitting there going, ‘Well, oil prices could easily come down to $70 or $60 if we resolve the war and the supply chain fixes,'” he said. “Instead, the Fed is trying to slow the economy down just in case.”
And long-term borrowing is starting to cost consumers and companies money, he said. Several developed countries, in addition to the U.S., have seen long-term interest rates increase.

“If interest rates and debt both go up, they both add to the amount of costs that we’re all going to have to pay out of our tax receipts or tax bills, so you can see net interest costs becomes bigger and bigger as a problem,” Mackintosh said.
He noted that households are trying to stretch how long they’ll own a car, increasing the number of months on a new car loan.
“It’s going up and up and up as people try to buy a car that’s going to last longer than the usual cycle,” he said.

Mackintosh called himself a contrarian for his prediction that interest rates will be lower in 12 months. He said worsening Middle East conflict causing real supply shock would be the only reason his prediction would be wrong.

“I actually think we’re more likely to see inflation fade,” he said. “If the conflict in Iran doesn’t get worse, then the oil price won’t keep going up, which means it stops being inflationary. Imagine if it goes away and the oil price comes down, then you get deflation from oil, and all of a sudden we could be talking about 2% inflation pretty quickly.”
Another deflationary factor is the aging population against a shrinking workforce.

“There’s more people retired than there are with babies needing new houses and new cars and more clothes, so the demand kind of comes out of the economy,” Mackintosh said. “Interest rates don’t need to be very high in an economy where the population is shrinking.”
Much more risk would be in play if the heat came out of the economy naturally and inflation decreased on its own, he added.
Mackintosh said layoffs near historic lows are one facet that has helped the economy. Meanwhile, hiring has softened.

“We have what we’re calling a ‘no hire, no fire’ market, so everyone feels pretty secure, but the job creation slowed down quite a lot,” he said. “People that are unemployed and staying unemployed is starting to fall, so that’s good news as well. People are actually getting into work slowly rather than seeing people lose jobs.”
Tariffs, he added, are basically done, and the price increases they caused are last year’s story. Mackintosh predicts tariff increases won’t show in the CPI in a couple more months.
Mackintosh also covered the AI boom and its effect on the national and global economies. He predicts that AI could become deflationary if it makes us more productive.
According to his data, Mackintosh said AI capital expenditures are a large proportion of what’s currently driving the U.S. gross domestic product (GDP).

“The stock market basically reacted to AI this year rather than to the economy,” he said. “AI as a sector is contributing more and more to that growth in GDP, and so it’s become a really important economic factor to the market and the economy as a whole.
Chip demand will be much higher than ever because of the high demand for data centers, along with a phenomenal demand for electricity, Mackintosh added.
For example, he said that the Meta data center being built in Louisiana needs about 30% of the electricity the state currently produces.
“This is why it’s driving the economy too, though,” he said, adding that with AI there are “a lot of known unknowns.”

“We are still building AI; we’re still making it work in products,” he said. “We’re still trying to work out what it really can deliver. On the positive side, you’ve got the growth in token volumes or the growth in actual AI queries. It just keeps going up. …the revenues have started to plateau.

“I think from an economic perspective, there’s plenty of reasons to say that it’s worth all of us doing this. And the reason I say that is if you look at the internet boom, there was a heap of CapEx, almost the same kind of scale of CapEx to the GDP in the ’90s when we were building out the internet. All the connectivity they created, the fact that we can have CarPlay in our cars and GPS, all that cool stuff is because of the internet.”
He predicts the companies that will benefit from AI might be building products we haven’t imagined.
